Built once via `build_cut_link_list_2d(q_wall_h)`\non host, copied to the target backend.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    CutLinkList{AT}\n\nCompact device-side representation of the cut links flagged by\n`q_wall > 0` — `list_i`, `list_j`, `list_q`, `list_qw` are parallel\narrays of length `Nlinks`. Built once via `build_cut_link_list_2d(q_wall_h)`\non host, copied to the target backend.\n\"\"\"\nstruct CutLinkList{IT<:AbstractVector{Int32}, WT<:AbstractVector}\n    list_i::IT\n    list_j::IT\n    list_q::IT\n    list_qw::WT\n    Nlinks::Int\nend\n```"), (name = :CutLinkList3D, signature = "struct CutLinkList3D{IT<:AbstractVector{Int32}, WT<:AbstractVector}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    CutLinkList3D\n\nPublic type or module in the kernel-level LBM operation.\nConstruct or dispatch on this type according to the field layout and methods defined below.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nKraken.CutLinkList3D\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    CutLinkList3D\n\nPublic type or module in the kernel-level LBM operation.\nConstruct or dispatch on this type according to the field layout and methods defined below.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nKraken.CutLinkList3D\n```\n\"\"\"\nstruct CutLinkList3D{IT<:AbstractVector{Int32}, WT<:AbstractVector}\n    list_i::IT; list_j::IT; list_k::IT; list_q::IT\n    list_qw::WT\n    Nlinks::Int\nend\n```"), (name = :build_cut_link_list_2d, signature = "function build_cut_link_list_2d(q_wall_h::AbstractArray{T,3}; backend=CPU()) where {T}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    build_cut_link_list_2d(q_wall_h::Array{T,3}; backend=CPU())\n                          -> CutLinkList\n\nScan a host `q_wall_h[Nx, Ny, 9]` array, collect the coordinates of\nevery cut link, and upload to `backend`. O(Nx·Ny) once at setup.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    build_cut_link_list_2d(q_wall_h::Array{T,3}; backend=CPU())\n                          -> CutLinkList\n\nScan a host `q_wall_h[Nx, Ny, 9]` array, collect the coordinates of\nevery cut link, and upload to `backend`. O(Nx·Ny) once at setup.\n\"\"\"\nfunction build_cut_link_list_2d(q_wall_h::AbstractArray{T,3}; backend=CPU()) where {T}\n    Nx, Ny, _ = size(q_wall_h)\n    is_h = Int32[]; js_h = Int32[]; qs_h = Int32[]; qws_h = T[]\n    @inbounds for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx, q in 2:9\n        if q_wall_h[i,j,q] > 0\n            push!(is_h, i); push!(js_h, j); push!(qs_h, q)\n            push!(qws_h, q_wall_h[i,j,q])\n        end\n    end\n    N = length(is_h)\n    li = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Int32, N)\n    lj = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Int32, N)\n    lq = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Int32, N)\n    lw = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T,      N)\n    copyto!(li, is_h); copyto!(lj, js_h)\n    copyto!(lq, qs_h); copyto!(lw, qws_h)\n    return CutLinkList(li, lj, lq, lw, N)\nend\n```"), (name = :build_cut_link_list_3d, signature = "function build_cut_link_list_3d(q_wall_h::AbstractArray{T,4}; backend=CPU()) where {T}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    build_cut_link_list_3d(q_wall_h::AbstractArray{T,4}; backend=CPU()) where {T}\n\nPublic function in the kernel-level LBM operation.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.build_cut_link_list_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    build_cut_link_list_3d(q_wall_h::AbstractArray{T,4}; backend=CPU()) where {T}\n\nPublic function in the kernel-level LBM operation.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.build_cut_link_list_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction build_cut_link_list_3d(q_wall_h::AbstractArray{T,4}; backend=CPU()) where {T}\n    Nx, Ny, Nz, _ = size(q_wall_h)\n    is_h = Int32[]; js_h = Int32[]; ks_h = Int32[]; qs_h = Int32[]; qws_h = T[]\n    @inbounds for k in 1:Nz, j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx, q in 2:19\n        if q_wall_h[i,j,k,q] > 0\n            push!(is_h, i); push!(js_h, j); push!(ks_h, k); push!(qs_h, q)\n            push!(qws_h, q_wall_h[i,j,k,q])\n        end\n    end\n    N = length(is_h)\n    li = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Int32, N)\n    lj = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Int32, N)\n    lk = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Int32, N)\n    lq = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Int32, N)\n    lw = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T,      N)\n    copyto!(li, is_h); copyto!(lj, js_h); copyto!(lk, ks_h)\n    copyto!(lq, qs_h); copyto!(lw, qws_h)\n    return CutLinkList3D(li, lj, lk, lq, lw, N)\nend\n```"), (name = :compute_temperature_2d!, signature = "function compute_temperature_2d!(Temp, g)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    compute_temperature_2d!(Temp, g)\n\nPublic function in the kernel-level LBM operation.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations. Uses Λ = 3/16 by default (Ginzburg-magic bounce-back).\nPass `Λ = Inf` (or any large value) for pure BGK behaviour —\n`s_plus → 0` yields `a = s_minus/2`, which is NOT BGK. To recover BGK\nexactly, pass `Λ = (1/s − 0.5)²` with s = 1/(3ν+0.5), or equivalently\ncall `fused_bgk_step!`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    fused_trt_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ν; Λ=3/16)\n\nSingle fused GPU kernel: stream + halfway bounce-back + TRT collide +\nmacroscopic. Uses Λ = 3/16 by default (Ginzburg-magic bounce-back).\nPass `Λ = Inf` (or any large value) for pure BGK behaviour —\n`s_plus → 0` yields `a = s_minus/2`, which is NOT BGK. To recover BGK\nexactly, pass `Λ = (1/s − 0.5)²` with s = 1/(3ν+0.5), or equivalently\ncall `fused_bgk_step!`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction fused_trt_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ν;\n                          Λ::Real=3/16)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    ET = eltype(f_in)\n    s_plus, s_minus = trt_rates(ν; Λ=Λ)\n    kernel! = fused_trt_step_kernel!(backend)\n    kernel!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid, Nx, Ny,\n            ET(s_plus), ET(s_minus); ndrange=(Nx, Ny))\nend\n```"), (name = :trt_rates, signature = "function trt_rates(ν::Real; Λ::Real=3/16)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    trt_rates(ν; Λ=3/16) -> (s_plus, s_minus)\n\nCompute the TRT relaxation rates from kinematic viscosity `ν` and the\nmagic parameter `Λ`. Following Ginzburg & d'Humières 2003 (PRE 68,\n066614) and Krüger et al. 2017 (ch. 10.5):\n\n- `s_plus` — rate of the SYMMETRIC (even) mode (f_q + f_q̄)/2. Sets\n  the kinematic shear viscosity via `ν = (1/s_plus − 1/2) / 3`, so\n  `s_plus = 1/(3ν + 1/2)`.\n- `s_minus` — rate of the ANTISYMMETRIC (odd) mode (f_q − f_q̄)/2.\n  Set by the magic parameter via `(1/s_plus − 1/2)(1/s_minus − 1/2) = Λ`,\n  so `s_minus = 1/(Λ/(3ν) + 1/2)`.\n\nThe fused TRT/BGK collide in this file applies `s_plus` to the even\nmode and `s_minus` to the odd mode — consistent with this convention.\nDefault `Λ = 3/16` makes the halfway bounce-back error\nviscosity-independent (Ginzburg & d'Humières 2003).\n\nHistorical note: commits before 2026-04-15 returned the two rates with\nlabels swapped (`s_plus` set from Λ, `s_minus` from ν). The collide\nformula then applied the Λ-derived rate to the even mode, giving an\neffective viscosity `ν_eff = Λ/(9ν)` ≈ 13×ν at Λ=3/16, ν=0.04. This\ninflated the real Re by ~13× and silently over-dragged every\nbenchmark that relied on `trt_rates`. Fixed here.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    trt_rates(ν; Λ=3/16) -> (s_plus, s_minus)\n\nCompute the TRT relaxation rates from kinematic viscosity `ν` and the\nmagic parameter `Λ`. Following Ginzburg & d'Humières 2003 (PRE 68,\n066614) and Krüger et al. 2017 (ch. 10.5):\n\n- `s_plus` — rate of the SYMMETRIC (even) mode (f_q + f_q̄)/2. Sets\n  the kinematic shear viscosity via `ν = (1/s_plus − 1/2) / 3`, so\n  `s_plus = 1/(3ν + 1/2)`.\n- `s_minus` — rate of the ANTISYMMETRIC (odd) mode (f_q − f_q̄)/2.\n  Set by the magic parameter via `(1/s_plus − 1/2)(1/s_minus − 1/2) = Λ`,\n  so `s_minus = 1/(Λ/(3ν) + 1/2)`.\n\nThe fused TRT/BGK collide in this file applies `s_plus` to the even\nmode and `s_minus` to the odd mode — consistent with this convention.\nDefault `Λ = 3/16` makes the halfway bounce-back error\nviscosity-independent (Ginzburg & d'Humières 2003).\n\nHistorical note: commits before 2026-04-15 returned the two rates with\nlabels swapped (`s_plus` set from Λ, `s_minus` from ν). The collide\nformula then applied the Λ-derived rate to the even mode, giving an\neffective viscosity `ν_eff = Λ/(9ν)` ≈ 13×ν at Λ=3/16, ν=0.04. This\ninflated the real Re by ~13× and silently over-dragged every\nbenchmark that relied on `trt_rates`. Fixed here.\n\"\"\"\nfunction trt_rates(ν::Real; Λ::Real=3/16)\n    s_plus  = 1.0 / (3ν + 0.5)\n    s_minus = 1.0 / (Λ / (3ν) + 0.5)\n    return s_plus, s_minus\nend\n```"), (name = :fused_trt_libb_step!, signature = "function fused_trt_libb_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    fused_trt_libb_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                          q_wall, uw_x, uw_y, Nx, Ny, ν; Λ=3/16)\n\nFused GPU step: pull-stream + halfway BB on domain edges + TRT\ncollision + interpolated bounce-back (Bouzidi) on flagged cut links.\n`q_wall[i,j,q]` holds the wall-cut fraction per link (0 if no\ncrossing, (0,1] otherwise). `uw_x`, `uw_y` are per-cell prescribed\nwall velocities; pass zero arrays for stationary walls.\n\nSets the symmetric rate via TRT magic `Λ = 3/16` by default, making\nthe bounce-back error viscosity-independent (Ginzburg 2003). Pass a\ndifferent `Λ` for other choices.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    fused_trt_libb_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                          q_wall, uw_x, uw_y, Nx, Ny, ν; Λ=3/16)\n\nFused GPU step: pull-stream + halfway BB on domain edges + TRT\ncollision + interpolated bounce-back (Bouzidi) on flagged cut links.\n`q_wall[i,j,q]` holds the wall-cut fraction per link (0 if no\ncrossing, (0,1] otherwise). `uw_x`, `uw_y` are per-cell prescribed\nwall velocities; pass zero arrays for stationary walls.\n\nSets the symmetric rate via TRT magic `Λ = 3/16` by default, making\nthe bounce-back error viscosity-independent (Ginzburg 2003). Pass a\ndifferent `Λ` for other choices.\n\"\"\"\nfunction fused_trt_libb_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                               q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n                               Nx, Ny, ν; Λ::Real=3/16)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    ET = eltype(f_in)\n    s_plus, s_minus = trt_rates(ν; Λ=Λ)\n    kernel! = fused_trt_libb_step_kernel!(backend)\n    kernel!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n            q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n            Nx, Ny, ET(s_plus), ET(s_minus);\n            ndrange=(Nx, Ny))\nend\n```"), (name = :fused_trt_libb_v2_step!, signature = "function fused_trt_libb_v2_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    fused_trt_libb_v2_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                             q_wall, uw_x, uw_y, Nx, Ny, ν; Λ=3/16)\n\nRefactored TRT + LI-BB step that fixes the double-BC bug of\n`fused_trt_libb_step!`. Λ=3/16, source_scale=1)\n\nExperimental LI-BB V2 step with the polymer Hermite stress source fused into\nthe TRT collision. `source_scale=1` gives the local Liu/Yu in-collision\namplitude; `source_scale=1/(1-s_plus/2)` gives the standalone CE-corrected\namplitude used by the post-collision source.\n\"\"\"\nfunction fused_trt_libb_v2_hermite_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                                           q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n                                           tau_p_xx, tau_p_xy, tau_p_yy,\n                                           Nx, Ny, ν; Λ::Real=3/16,\n                                           source_scale::Real=1,\n                                           source_on_cutlinks::Bool=true)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    ET = eltype(f_in)\n    s_plus, s_minus = trt_rates(ν; Λ=Λ)\n    kernel! = build_lbm_kernel(backend, _TRT_LIBB_V2_HERMITE_SPEC)\n    kernel!(f_out, ρ, ux, uy, f_in, is_solid,\n            q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n            Nx, Ny, ET(s_plus), ET(s_minus),\n            tau_p_xx, tau_p_xy, tau_p_yy,\n            ET(source_scale), source_on_cutlinks;\n            ndrange=(Nx, Ny))\nend\n```"), (name = :fused_trt_libb_v2_guo_field_step!, signature = "function fused_trt_libb_v2_guo_field_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    fused_trt_libb_v2_guo_field_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                                       q_wall, uw_x, uw_y, Fx, Fy,\n                                       Nx, Ny, ν; It is intended for cell-centered log-FV polymer coupling.\n\"\"\"\nfunction fused_trt_libb_v2_guo_field_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                                            q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n                                            Fx_field, Fy_field,\n                                            Nx, Ny, ν; Λ::Real=3/16,\n                                            wall_bc::Symbol=:halfwayBB)\n    wall_bc in (:halfwayBB, :bouzidi_fl, :bouzidi_fl_twopass) ||\n        throw(ArgumentError(\"wall_bc must be :halfwayBB, :bouzidi_fl, or :bouzidi_fl_twopass\"))\n    @trace_enter :lbm_step\n    return _fused_trt_libb_v2_guo_field_step!(\n        Val(wall_bc), f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n        q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, Fx_field, Fy_field,\n        Nx, Ny, ν; Λ=Λ,\n    )\nend\n```"), (name = :fused_trt_libb_v2_step_3d!, signature = "function fused_trt_libb_v2_step_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    fused_trt_libb_v2_step_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,\n                                q_wall, uw_x, uw_y, uw_z,\n                                Nx, Ny, Nz, ν; Λ=3/16)\n\nSingle D3Q19 step: pull-stream + SolidInert on solid cells, or\nApplyLiBBPrePhase + TRT collision on fluid cells. Ginzburg-exact for\nhalfway-BB + TRT Λ = 3/16 on Couette; handles arbitrary q_w ∈ (0, 1]\nvia the full Bouzidi formula.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    fused_trt_libb_v2_step_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,\n                                q_wall, uw_x, uw_y, uw_z,\n                                Nx, Ny, Nz, ν; Λ=3/16)\n\nSingle D3Q19 step: pull-stream + SolidInert on solid cells, or\nApplyLiBBPrePhase + TRT collision on fluid cells. Ginzburg-exact for\nhalfway-BB + TRT Λ = 3/16 on Couette; handles arbitrary q_w ∈ (0, 1]\nvia the full Bouzidi formula.\n\"\"\"\nfunction fused_trt_libb_v2_step_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,\n                                      q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, uw_link_z,\n                                      Nx, Ny, Nz, ν; Λ::Real=3/16)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    ET = eltype(f_in)\n    s_plus, s_minus = trt_rates(ν; Λ=Λ)\n    kernel! = build_lbm_kernel(backend, _TRT_LIBB_V2_SPEC_3D)\n    kernel!(f_out, ρ, ux, uy, uz, f_in, is_solid,\n            q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, uw_link_z,\n            Nx, Ny, Nz, ET(s_plus), ET(s_minus);\n            ndrange=(Nx, Ny, Nz))\nend\n```"), (name = :precompute_q_wall_cylinder, signature = "function precompute_q_wall_cylinder(Nx::Int, Ny::Int,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_cylinder(Nx, Ny, cx, cy, R; FT=Float64)\n                               -> (q_wall, is_solid)\n\nAnalytically precompute the wall-cut fraction `q_wall[i, j, q]` for a\ncylinder centred at `(cx, cy)` with radius `R`, embedded in an `Nx×Ny`\nlattice whose node `(i, j)` sits at physical coordinates `(i−1, j−1)`.\n\nThe returned `q_wall` is a `Float` array of size `(Nx, Ny, 9)` with the\nconvention:\n\n  * `q_wall[i, j, q] = 0` → link `q` out of node `(i, j)` stays in the\n    fluid (no wall crossing).\n  * `q_wall[i, j, q] ∈ (0, 1]` → link `q` crosses the wall at that\n    fraction of the link length from the fluid node.\n\nThe companion `is_solid[i, j]` boolean mask flags fluid nodes that are\nactually inside the cylinder (and therefore treated with plain\nbounce-back in the fused kernel).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_cylinder(Nx, Ny, cx, cy, R; FT=Float64)\n                               -> (q_wall, is_solid)\n\nAnalytically precompute the wall-cut fraction `q_wall[i, j, q]` for a\ncylinder centred at `(cx, cy)` with radius `R`, embedded in an `Nx×Ny`\nlattice whose node `(i, j)` sits at physical coordinates `(i−1, j−1)`.\n\nThe returned `q_wall` is a `Float` array of size `(Nx, Ny, 9)` with the\nconvention:\n\n  * `q_wall[i, j, q] = 0` → link `q` out of node `(i, j)` stays in the\n    fluid (no wall crossing).\n  * `q_wall[i, j, q] ∈ (0, 1]` → link `q` crosses the wall at that\n    fraction of the link length from the fluid node.\n\nThe companion `is_solid[i, j]` boolean mask flags fluid nodes that are\nactually inside the cylinder (and therefore treated with plain\nbounce-back in the fused kernel).\n\"\"\"\nfunction precompute_q_wall_cylinder(Nx::Int, Ny::Int,\n                                     cx::Real, cy::Real, R::Real;\n                                     FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    cxT, cyT, RT = FT(cx), FT(cy), FT(R)\n    R² = RT * RT\n    is_solid = zeros(Bool, Nx, Ny)\n    q_wall = zeros(FT, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    cxs = velocities_x(D2Q9())\n    cys = velocities_y(D2Q9())\n\n    @inbounds for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        xf = FT(i - 1); yf = FT(j - 1)\n        dx_f = xf - cxT; dy_f = yf - cyT\n        if dx_f * dx_f + dy_f * dy_f ≤ R²\n            is_solid[i, j] = true\n            continue\n        end\n        for q in 2:9\n            cqx = FT(cxs[q]); cqy = FT(cys[q])\n            # Neighbour along link q — only consider if it lies inside\n            # the cylinder (otherwise the link is not cut)\n            xn = xf + cqx; yn = yf + cqy\n            dx_n = xn - cxT; dy_n = yn - cyT\n            if dx_n * dx_n + dy_n * dy_n > R²\n                continue\n            end\n            # Solve |x_f + t c_q − c_wall|² = R² for t ∈ (0, 1]\n            a = cqx * cqx + cqy * cqy\n            b = FT(2) * (dx_f * cqx + dy_f * cqy)\n            c = dx_f * dx_f + dy_f * dy_f - R²\n            disc = b * b - FT(4) * a * c\n            if disc < zero(FT)\n                continue\n            end\n            sd = sqrt(disc)\n            t1 = (-b - sd) / (FT(2) * a)\n            t2 = (-b + sd) / (FT(2) * a)\n            t = t1 > zero(FT) ? t1 : t2\n            if t > zero(FT) && t ≤ one(FT)\n                q_wall[i, j, q] = t\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    return q_wall, is_solid\nend\n```"), (name = :dq_wall_dR_cylinder, signature = "function dq_wall_dR_cylinder(Nx::Int, Ny::Int,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    dq_wall_dR_cylinder(Nx, Ny, cx, cy, R; FT=Float64)\n        -> dq_dR::Array{FT, 3}\n\nAnalytic derivative of `q_wall[i,j,q]` with respect to cylinder radius\n`R`. For a cut link with quadratic `a·t²+b·t+c=0` where `c = |P-C|²-R²`:\n\n    dt/dR = ∓ 2R / √(b²-4ac)\n\nSign depends on which root was selected (t1 vs t2). Returns zero for\nnon-cut links and for links where the discriminant is non-positive.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    dq_wall_dR_cylinder(Nx, Ny, cx, cy, R; FT=Float64)\n        -> dq_dR::Array{FT, 3}\n\nAnalytic derivative of `q_wall[i,j,q]` with respect to cylinder radius\n`R`. For a cut link with quadratic `a·t²+b·t+c=0` where `c = |P-C|²-R²`:\n\n    dt/dR = ∓ 2R / √(b²-4ac)\n\nSign depends on which root was selected (t1 vs t2). Returns zero for\nnon-cut links and for links where the discriminant is non-positive.\n\"\"\"\nfunction dq_wall_dR_cylinder(Nx::Int, Ny::Int,\n                              cx::Real, cy::Real, R::Real;\n                              FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    cxT, cyT, RT = FT(cx), FT(cy), FT(R)\n    R² = RT * RT\n    cxs = velocities_x(D2Q9())\n    cys = velocities_y(D2Q9())\n\n    dq_dR = zeros(FT, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    @inbounds for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        xf = FT(i - 1); yf = FT(j - 1)\n        dx_f = xf - cxT; dy_f = yf - cyT\n        dx_f * dx_f + dy_f * dy_f ≤ R² && continue\n        for q in 2:9\n            cqx = FT(cxs[q]); cqy = FT(cys[q])\n            xn = xf + cqx; yn = yf + cqy\n            dx_n = xn - cxT; dy_n = yn - cyT\n            dx_n * dx_n + dy_n * dy_n > R² && continue\n\n            a = cqx * cqx + cqy * cqy\n            b_coeff = FT(2) * (dx_f * cqx + dy_f * cqy)\n            c_coeff = dx_f * dx_f + dy_f * dy_f - R²\n            disc = b_coeff * b_coeff - FT(4) * a * c_coeff\n            disc ≤ zero(FT) && continue\n\n            sd = sqrt(disc)\n            t1 = (-b_coeff - sd) / (FT(2) * a)\n            if t1 > zero(FT)\n                dq_dR[i,j,q] = -FT(2) * RT / sd\n            else\n                dq_dR[i,j,q] =  FT(2) * RT / sd\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    return dq_dR\nend\n```"), (name = :precompute_q_wall_sphere_3d, signature = "function precompute_q_wall_sphere_3d(Nx::Int, Ny::Int, Nz::Int,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_sphere_3d(Nx, Ny, Nz, cx, cy, cz, R; FT=Float64)\n        -> (q_wall, is_solid)\n\nAnalytical sub-cell `q_w` for a sphere of radius `R` centred at\n`(cx, cy, cz)` on an `Nx×Ny×Nz` D3Q19 grid with unit lattice spacing.\nFor every fluid node whose link `q` crosses the sphere, solves the\nquadratic `|x_f + t · c_q − c|² = R²` for the smallest positive\n`t ∈ (0, 1]` and stores that as `q_wall[i,j,k,q]`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_sphere_3d(Nx, Ny, Nz, cx, cy, cz, R; FT=Float64)\n        -> (q_wall, is_solid)\n\nAnalytical sub-cell `q_w` for a sphere of radius `R` centred at\n`(cx, cy, cz)` on an `Nx×Ny×Nz` D3Q19 grid with unit lattice spacing.\nFor every fluid node whose link `q` crosses the sphere, solves the\nquadratic `|x_f + t · c_q − c|² = R²` for the smallest positive\n`t ∈ (0, 1]` and stores that as `q_wall[i,j,k,q]`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction precompute_q_wall_sphere_3d(Nx::Int, Ny::Int, Nz::Int,\n                                      cx::Real, cy::Real, cz::Real,\n                                      R::Real;\n                                      FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    cxT, cyT, czT, RT = FT(cx), FT(cy), FT(cz), FT(R)\n    R² = RT * RT\n    is_solid = zeros(Bool, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    q_wall = zeros(FT, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    cxs = velocities_x(D3Q19())\n    cys = velocities_y(D3Q19())\n    czs = velocities_z(D3Q19())\n\n    @inbounds for k in 1:Nz, j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        xf = FT(i - 1); yf = FT(j - 1); zf = FT(k - 1)\n        dx_f = xf - cxT; dy_f = yf - cyT; dz_f = zf - czT\n        if dx_f * dx_f + dy_f * dy_f + dz_f * dz_f ≤ R²\n            is_solid[i, j, k] = true\n            continue\n        end\n        for q in 2:19\n            cqx = FT(cxs[q]); cqy = FT(cys[q]); cqz = FT(czs[q])\n            xn = xf + cqx; yn = yf + cqy; zn = zf + cqz\n            dx_n = xn - cxT; dy_n = yn - cyT; dz_n = zn - czT\n            if dx_n * dx_n + dy_n * dy_n + dz_n * dz_n > R²\n                continue\n            end\n            a = cqx * cqx + cqy * cqy + cqz * cqz\n            b = FT(2) * (dx_f * cqx + dy_f * cqy + dz_f * cqz)\n            c = dx_f * dx_f + dy_f * dy_f + dz_f * dz_f - R²\n            disc = b * b - FT(4) * a * c\n            disc < zero(FT) && continue\n            sd = sqrt(disc)\n            t1 = (-b - sd) / (FT(2) * a)\n            t2 = (-b + sd) / (FT(2) * a)\n            t = t1 > zero(FT) ? t1 : t2\n            if t > zero(FT) && t ≤ one(FT)\n                q_wall[i, j, k, q] = t\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    return q_wall, is_solid\nend\n```"), (name = :compute_drag_libb_3d, signature = "function compute_drag_libb_3d(f_post, q_wall, Nx::Int, Ny::Int, Nz::Int)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    compute_drag_libb_3d(f_post, q_wall, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n        -> (Fx, Fy, Fz)\n\nD3Q19 MEA drag/lift for a stationary LI-BB wall. Same halfway-BB\nconvention as the 2D version (`F = 2·c_q·f_q(post-coll)`).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    compute_drag_libb_3d(f_post, q_wall, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n        -> (Fx, Fy, Fz)\n\nD3Q19 MEA drag/lift for a stationary LI-BB wall. Same halfway-BB\nconvention as the 2D version (`F = 2·c_q·f_q(post-coll)`).\n\"\"\"\nfunction compute_drag_libb_3d(f_post, q_wall, Nx::Int, Ny::Int, Nz::Int)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_post)\n    if backend isa KernelAbstractions.CPU\n        return _compute_drag_libb_3d_host(f_post, q_wall, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    else\n        return _compute_drag_libb_3d_gpu_cached(f_post, q_wall, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    end\nend\n```"), (name = :precompute_q_wall_annulus, signature = "function precompute_q_wall_annulus(Nx::Int, Ny::Int,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_annulus(Nx, Ny, cx, cy, R_inner, R_outer; FT=Float64)\n                              -> (q_wall, is_solid, is_inner_wall)\n\nPrecompute cut fractions for a Taylor-Couette-style annular fluid\ndomain: fluid in `R_inner < r < R_outer`, solid elsewhere. Each cut\nlink `q_wall[i, j, q] ∈ (0, 1]` records the fraction to the first wall\nthe link crosses. `is_inner_wall[i, j, q]` is `true` if that wall is\nthe inner cylinder (so a moving-wall correction applies there), else\n`false` for the outer cylinder.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_annulus(Nx, Ny, cx, cy, R_inner, R_outer; FT=Float64)\n                              -> (q_wall, is_solid, is_inner_wall)\n\nPrecompute cut fractions for a Taylor-Couette-style annular fluid\ndomain: fluid in `R_inner < r < R_outer`, solid elsewhere. Each cut\nlink `q_wall[i, j, q] ∈ (0, 1]` records the fraction to the first wall\nthe link crosses. `is_inner_wall[i, j, q]` is `true` if that wall is\nthe inner cylinder (so a moving-wall correction applies there), else\n`false` for the outer cylinder.\n\"\"\"\nfunction precompute_q_wall_annulus(Nx::Int, Ny::Int,\n                                    cx::Real, cy::Real,\n                                    R_inner::Real, R_outer::Real;\n                                    FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    R_inner < R_outer || error(\"precompute_q_wall_annulus: R_inner < R_outer required\")\n    cxT, cyT = FT(cx), FT(cy)\n    Ri², Ro² = FT(R_inner)^2, FT(R_outer)^2\n    is_solid = zeros(Bool, Nx, Ny)\n    q_wall = zeros(FT, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    is_inner_wall = zeros(Bool, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    cxs = velocities_x(D2Q9())\n    cys = velocities_y(D2Q9())\n\n    @inbounds for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        xf = FT(i - 1); yf = FT(j - 1)\n        dx_f = xf - cxT; dy_f = yf - cyT\n        r² = dx_f * dx_f + dy_f * dy_f\n        if r² ≤ Ri² || r² ≥ Ro²\n            is_solid[i, j] = true\n            continue\n        end\n        for q in 2:9\n            cqx = FT(cxs[q]); cqy = FT(cys[q])\n            xn = xf + cqx; yn = yf + cqy\n            dx_n = xn - cxT; dy_n = yn - cyT\n            rn² = dx_n * dx_n + dy_n * dy_n\n            # Only flag if the neighbour is inside a solid region\n            if rn² > Ri² && rn² < Ro²\n                continue\n            end\n            # Solve quadratic |x_f + t c_q − c|² = R² for both radii,\n            # keep the smallest positive root in (0, 1].\n            a = cqx * cqx + cqy * cqy\n            b = FT(2) * (dx_f * cqx + dy_f * cqy)\n            t_best = FT(Inf)\n            hit_inner = false\n            for (R², is_inner) in ((Ri², true), (Ro², false))\n                c = r² - R²\n                disc = b * b - FT(4) * a * c\n                disc < zero(FT) && continue\n                sd = sqrt(disc)\n                t1 = (-b - sd) / (FT(2) * a)\n                t2 = (-b + sd) / (FT(2) * a)\n                for tc in (t1, t2)\n                    if tc > zero(FT) && tc ≤ one(FT) && tc < t_best\n                        t_best = tc\n                        hit_inner = is_inner\n                    end\n                end\n            end\n            if t_best ≤ one(FT)\n                q_wall[i, j, q] = t_best\n                is_inner_wall[i, j, q] = hit_inner\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    return q_wall, is_solid, is_inner_wall\nend\n```"), (name = :wall_velocity_rotating_cylinder, signature = "function wall_velocity_rotating_cylinder(q_wall::AbstractArray{T, 3},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    wall_velocity_rotating_cylinder(q_wall, cx, cy, Ω; FT=Float64)\n                                    -> (uw_link_x, uw_link_y)\n\nFor each cut link flagged by `q_wall`, evaluate the rigid-body\nrotation velocity `u_w(x) = Ω × (x − c)` at the wall-intersection point\n`x_w = x_f + q_w · c_q` (positive Ω is CCW).\n\nReturns two `(Nx, Ny, 9)` arrays ready for `fused_trt_libb_step!`.\nFor stationary walls, pass `Ω = 0` — the result is zero everywhere.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    wall_velocity_rotating_cylinder(q_wall, cx, cy, Ω; FT=Float64)\n                                    -> (uw_link_x, uw_link_y)\n\nFor each cut link flagged by `q_wall`, evaluate the rigid-body\nrotation velocity `u_w(x) = Ω × (x − c)` at the wall-intersection point\n`x_w = x_f + q_w · c_q` (positive Ω is CCW).\n\nReturns two `(Nx, Ny, 9)` arrays ready for `fused_trt_libb_step!`.\nFor stationary walls, pass `Ω = 0` — the result is zero everywhere.\n\"\"\"\nfunction wall_velocity_rotating_cylinder(q_wall::AbstractArray{T, 3},\n                                          cx::Real, cy::Real, Ω::Real) where {T}\n    Nx, Ny, _ = size(q_wall)\n    cxT, cyT, ΩT = T(cx), T(cy), T(Ω)\n    uw_link_x = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    uw_link_y = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    cxs = velocities_x(D2Q9())\n    cys = velocities_y(D2Q9())\n    @inbounds for q in 2:9, j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        qw = q_wall[i, j, q]\n        qw == zero(T) && continue\n        xw = T(i - 1) + qw * T(cxs[q])\n        yw = T(j - 1) + qw * T(cys[q])\n        uw_link_x[i, j, q] = -ΩT * (yw - cyT)\n        uw_link_y[i, j, q] =  ΩT * (xw - cxT)\n    end\n    return uw_link_x, uw_link_y\nend\n```"), (name = :wall_velocity_rotating_inner, signature = "function wall_velocity_rotating_inner(q_wall::AbstractArray{T, 3},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    wall_velocity_rotating_inner(q_wall, is_inner_wall, cx, cy, Ω)\n                                 -> (uw_link_x, uw_link_y)\n\nFor an annulus with rotating inner cylinder + stationary outer one,\nset the per-link wall velocity to Ω × (x_w − c) on the inner wall and\nzero on the outer wall.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    wall_velocity_rotating_inner(q_wall, is_inner_wall, cx, cy, Ω)\n                                 -> (uw_link_x, uw_link_y)\n\nFor an annulus with rotating inner cylinder + stationary outer one,\nset the per-link wall velocity to Ω × (x_w − c) on the inner wall and\nzero on the outer wall.\n\"\"\"\nfunction wall_velocity_rotating_inner(q_wall::AbstractArray{T, 3},\n                                       is_inner_wall::AbstractArray{Bool, 3},\n                                       cx::Real, cy::Real, Ω::Real) where {T}\n    Nx, Ny, _ = size(q_wall)\n    cxT, cyT, ΩT = T(cx), T(cy), T(Ω)\n    uw_link_x = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    uw_link_y = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    cxs = velocities_x(D2Q9())\n    cys = velocities_y(D2Q9())\n    @inbounds for q in 2:9, j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        qw = q_wall[i, j, q]\n        (qw == zero(T) || !is_inner_wall[i, j, q]) && continue\n        xw = T(i - 1) + qw * T(cxs[q])\n        yw = T(j - 1) + qw * T(cys[q])\n        uw_link_x[i, j, q] = -ΩT * (yw - cyT)\n        uw_link_y[i, j, q] =  ΩT * (xw - cxT)\n    end\n    return uw_link_x, uw_link_y\nend\n```"), (name = :open_paraview, signature = "function open_paraview(output_dir::String; name::String=\"\")", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    open_paraview(output_dir::String; name::String=\"\")\n\nOpen ParaView on the `.pvd` time-series file found in `output_dir`.\n\nIf `name` is given, looks for `<name>.pvd`; otherwise picks the first `.pvd`\nfile in the directory.  Falls back to opening the directory itself if no `.pvd`\nis found (ParaView can browse `.vtr` files manually).\n\nRequires `paraview` to be on `PATH`.\n\n# Examples\n```julia\n# After running a simulation with VTK output:\nopen_paraview(\"output/\")\n\n# Specific PVD file:\nopen_paraview(\"output/\", name=\"cavity\")\n\n# Remote HPC: rsync then view locally\n# rsync -avz aqua:~/runs/cavity/output/ output/\n# open_paraview(\"output/\")\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    open_paraview(output_dir::String; name::String=\"\")\n\nOpen ParaView on the `.pvd` time-series file found in `output_dir`.\n\nIf `name` is given, looks for `<name>.pvd`; otherwise picks the first `.pvd`\nfile in the directory.  Falls back to opening the directory itself if no `.pvd`\nis found (ParaView can browse `.vtr` files manually).\n\nRequires `paraview` to be on `PATH`.\n\n# Examples\n```julia\n# After running a simulation with VTK output:\nopen_paraview(\"output/\")\n\n# Specific PVD file:\nopen_paraview(\"output/\", name=\"cavity\")\n\n# Remote HPC: rsync then view locally\n# rsync -avz aqua:~/runs/cavity/output/ output/\n# open_paraview(\"output/\")\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction open_paraview(output_dir::String; name::String=\"\")\n    dir = abspath(output_dir)\n    if !isdir(dir)\n        error(\"Output directory not found: \$dir\")\n    end\n\n    # Find .pvd file\n    if !isempty(name)\n        pvd = joinpath(dir, name * \".pvd\")\n    else\n        pvds = filter(f -> endswith(f, \".pvd\"), readdir(dir))\n        pvd = isempty(pvds) ? \"\" : joinpath(dir, first(pvds))\n    end\n\n    target = isempty(pvd) || !isfile(pvd) ? dir : pvd\n\n    # Detect ParaView executable\n    exe = if Sys.isapple()\n        # Try common macOS app locations (newest first)\n        candidates = [\n            \"/Applications/ParaView-6.0.0-RC1.app/Contents/MacOS/paraview\",\n            \"/Applications/ParaView-5.13.3.app/Contents/MacOS/paraview\",\n        ]\n        idx = findfirst(isfile, candidates)\n        idx !== nothing ? candidates[idx] : \"paraview\"\n    else\n        \"paraview\"\n    end\n\n    @info \"Opening ParaView on \$target\"\n    run(`\$exe \$target`; wait=false)\n    return target\nend\n```"), (name = :SanityIssue, signature = "struct SanityIssue", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    SanityIssue\n\nA single validation issue found by `sanity_check`.\n`level` is `:error`, `:warn`, or `:info`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    SanityIssue\n\nA single validation issue found by `sanity_check`.\n`level` is `:error`, `:warn`, or `:info`.\n\"\"\"\nstruct SanityIssue\n    level::Symbol      # :error, :warn, :info\n    category::Symbol   # :relaxation, :compressibility, :resolution, :thermal, :twophase, :rheology, :refinement\n    message::String\nend\n```"), (name = :sanity_check_sweep, signature = "function sanity_check_sweep(setups::Vector{SimulationSetup}; verbose::Bool=true)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    sanity_check_sweep(setups::Vector{SimulationSetup}; verbose=true) -> Vector{Vector{SanityIssue}}\n\nValidate all setups in a sweep. Prints a compact summary table and returns\nper-setup issues. Does NOT throw on :error — instead marks them so the caller\ncan decide whether to skip or abort.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    sanity_check_sweep(setups::Vector{SimulationSetup}; verbose=true) -> Vector{Vector{SanityIssue}}\n\nValidate all setups in a sweep. Prints a compact summary table and returns\nper-setup issues. Does NOT throw on :error — instead marks them so the caller\ncan decide whether to skip or abort.\n\"\"\"\nfunction sanity_check_sweep(setups::Vector{SimulationSetup}; verbose::Bool=true)\n    all_issues = Vector{SanityIssue}[]\n    rows = String[]\n\n    for (i, setup) in enumerate(setups)\n        issues = SanityIssue[]\n        _check_relaxation!(issues, setup)\n        _check_compressibility!(issues, setup)\n        _check_resolution!(issues, setup)\n        _check_thermal!(issues, setup)\n        _check_twophase!(issues, setup)\n        _check_rheology!(issues, setup)\n        _check_refinement!(issues, setup)\n        push!(all_issues, issues)\n\n        # Build compact row\n        params = setup.physics.params\n        ν = get(params, :nu, NaN)\n        τ = isnan(ν) ? NaN : 3ν + 0.5\n        Re = get(params, :Re, NaN)\n        U_ref = _probe_U_ref(setup.boundaries)\n        n_err = count(i -> i.level == :error, issues)\n        n_warn = count(i -> i.level == :warn, issues)\n        status = n_err > 0 ? \"✗\" : n_warn > 0 ? \"⚠\" : \"✓\"\n        re_str = isnan(Re) ? \"—\" : string(round(Re, digits=2))\n        push!(rows, \"\$status  #\$i  Re=\$re_str  τ=\$(round(τ, digits=3))  U=\$(round(U_ref, digits=4))  \" *\n                     \"err=\$n_err warn=\$n_warn\")\n    end\n\n    if verbose\n        @info \"Sweep sanity check (\$(length(setups)) cases)\\n  \" * join(rows, \"\\n  \")\n        # Emit warnings for problematic cases\n        for (i, issues) in enumerate(all_issues)\n            for issue in issues\n                if issue.level == :error\n                    @warn \"Case #\$i [\$(issue.category)]: \$(issue.message)\"\n                end\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    return all_issues\nend\n```"), (name = :LBMParams, signature = "struct LBMParams", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    LBMParams\n\nComputed lattice-Boltzmann parameters with feasibility assessment.\nReturned by [`lbm_params`](@ref).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    LBMParams\n\nComputed lattice-Boltzmann parameters with feasibility assessment.\nReturned by [`lbm_params`](@ref).\n\"\"\"\nstruct LBMParams\n    # --- Inputs (lattice units) ---\n    Re::Float64\n    N::Int\n    U_ref::Float64\n    # --- Derived ---\n    nu::Float64       # lattice viscosity\n    tau::Float64      # relaxation time\n    omega::Float64    # relaxation rate\n    Ma::Float64       # Mach number\n    # --- Quality assessment ---\n    feasible::Bool           # all hard constraints satisfied\n    regime::Symbol           # :optimal, :acceptable, :marginal, :diffusive, :infeasible\n    warnings::Vector{String} # human-readable diagnostics\n    # --- Recommendations ---\n    recommended_N::Int           # best N for this Re at default U_ref\n    recommended_U_ref::Float64   # best U_ref for this Re and N\nend\n```"), (name = :lbm_params, signature = "function lbm_params(; Re::Real, N::Integer, U_ref::Real=0.01, L_ref::Real=N)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    lbm_params(; Re, N, U_ref=0.01, L_ref=N)\n\nCompute all LBM lattice parameters from physical inputs and assess feasibility.\n\nReturns an [`LBMParams`](@ref) with derived quantities, regime classification,\ndiagnostics, and concrete recommendations.\n\n# Regimes (based on τ = 3ν + 0.5, where ν = U_ref × L_ref / Re)\n\n| Regime       | τ range       | Meaning                                    |\n|:-------------|:--------------|:-------------------------------------------|\n| `:optimal`   | 0.51 – 2.0    | BGK accurate, best precision               |\n| `:acceptable`| 2.0 – 10.0    | OK with MRT, some numerical diffusion       |\n| `:marginal`  | 0.5 – 0.51    | Nearly unstable, MRT mandatory              |\n| `:diffusive` | 10.0 – 100.0  | Collision quasi-inactive, MRT mandatory     |\n| `:infeasible`| < 0.5 or > 100| Cannot run — parameters must change         |\n\n# Additional constraints checked\n- **Mach number**: Ma = U_ref × √3 ≤ 0.17 (compressibility)\n- **CFL**: U_ref ≤ 0.3\n- **Float32 precision**: U_ref ≥ 1e-5\n- **Resolution**: N ≥ 10\n\n# Examples\n```julia\njulia> lbm_params(Re=100, N=128)         # standard case\njulia> lbm_params(Re=0.01, N=64)         # your problematic case\njulia> lbm_params(Re=0.01, N=64, U_ref=0.001)  # with adjusted velocity\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    lbm_params(; Re, N, U_ref=0.01, L_ref=N)\n\nCompute all LBM lattice parameters from physical inputs and assess feasibility.\n\nReturns an [`LBMParams`](@ref) with derived quantities, regime classification,\ndiagnostics, and concrete recommendations.\n\n# Regimes (based on τ = 3ν + 0.5, where ν = U_ref × L_ref / Re)\n\n| Regime       | τ range       | Meaning                                    |\n|:-------------|:--------------|:-------------------------------------------|\n| `:optimal`   | 0.51 – 2.0    | BGK accurate, best precision               |\n| `:acceptable`| 2.0 – 10.0    | OK with MRT, some numerical diffusion       |\n| `:marginal`  | 0.5 – 0.51    | Nearly unstable, MRT mandatory              |\n| `:diffusive` | 10.0 – 100.0  | Collision quasi-inactive, MRT mandatory     |\n| `:infeasible`| < 0.5 or > 100| Cannot run — parameters must change         |\n\n# Additional constraints checked\n- **Mach number**: Ma = U_ref × √3 ≤ 0.17 (compressibility)\n- **CFL**: U_ref ≤ 0.3\n- **Float32 precision**: U_ref ≥ 1e-5\n- **Resolution**: N ≥ 10\n\n# Examples\n```julia\njulia> lbm_params(Re=100, N=128)         # standard case\njulia> lbm_params(Re=0.01, N=64)         # your problematic case\njulia> lbm_params(Re=0.01, N=64, U_ref=0.001)  # with adjusted velocity\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction lbm_params(; Re::Real, N::Integer, U_ref::Real=0.01, L_ref::Real=N)\n    Re = Float64(Re)\n    N = Int(N)\n    U_ref = Float64(U_ref)\n    L_ref = Float64(L_ref)\n\n    # --- Derived quantities ---\n    ν   = U_ref * L_ref / Re\n    τ   = 3ν + 0.5\n    ω   = 1.0 / τ\n    cs  = 1.0 / sqrt(3.0)\n    Ma  = U_ref / cs\n\n    warnings = String[]\n    feasible = true\n\n    # --- Regime classification ---\n    regime = if τ < _TAU_UNSTABLE\n        feasible = false\n        push!(warnings, \"τ = \$(round(τ, digits=4)) < 0.5 — UNSTABLE (negative effective viscosity)\")\n        :infeasible\n    elseif τ < _TAU_MARGINAL\n        push!(warnings, \"τ = \$(round(τ, digits=4)) ≈ 0.5 — marginally stable, MRT mandatory\")\n        :marginal\n    elseif τ ≤ _TAU_OPTIMAL_HI\n        :optimal\n    elseif τ ≤ _TAU_ACCEPT_HI\n        push!(warnings, \"τ = \$(round(τ, digits=2)) — numerical diffusion significant, MRT recommended\")\n        :acceptable\n    elseif τ ≤ _TAU_ABSURD\n        push!(warnings, \"τ = \$(round(τ, digits=1)) — collision quasi-inactive (ω = \$(round(ω, digits=5))), \" *\n                        \"only \$(round(ω*100, digits=1))% relaxation per step\")\n        :diffusive\n    else\n        feasible = false\n        push!(warnings, \"τ = \$(round(τ, digits=0)) — absurd, advective physics dead \" *\n                        \"(ω = \$(round(ω, digits=6)))\")\n        :infeasible\n    end\n\n    # --- Mach / compressibility ---\n    if Ma > 0.3 * sqrt(3.0)\n        feasible = false\n        push!(warnings, \"Ma = \$(round(Ma, digits=3)) > 0.52 — CFL violation, will diverge\")\n    elseif Ma > 0.1 * sqrt(3.0)\n        push!(warnings, \"Ma = \$(round(Ma, digits=3)) > 0.17 — compressibility errors > 1%\")\n    end\n\n    # --- Float32 precision ---\n    if U_ref < 1e-5 && U_ref > 0\n        push!(warnings, \"U_ref = \$(U_ref) — round-off dominates in Float32 \" *\n                        \"(relative precision ~ \$(round(eps(Float32)/U_ref, digits=0)))\")\n    elseif U_ref < 1e-3 && U_ref > 0\n        push!(warnings, \"U_ref = \$(U_ref) — use Float64 for best accuracy\")\n    end\n\n    # --- Resolution ---\n    if N < 10\n        push!(warnings, \"N = \$N — insufficient spatial resolution\")\n    end\n    if Re > 0 && N / Re < 1.0\n        push!(warnings, \"N/Re = \$(round(N/Re, digits=2)) < 1 — boundary layer under-resolved\")\n    end\n\n    # --- Recommendations ---\n    # Goal: find (U_ref, N) that gives τ in optimal range [0.55, 2.0]\n    # Constraints: Ma ≤ 0.1 (U ≤ 0.058), U ≥ 1e-5, N ≥ 10\n    #\n    # τ = 3·U·N/Re + 0.5  ⟹  U·N = Re·(τ-0.5)/3\n    #\n    # Strategy: target τ = 1.0 (ideal). If that requires U < 1e-5 or N < 10,\n    # relax τ target upward until feasible, capping at τ = 10 (MRT acceptable).\n    U_max = 0.058  # Ma ≈ 0.1\n    U_min = 1e-5\n    N_min_rec = 10\n\n    # For recommended_N: fix U = min(0.01, U_max) and solve N\n    rec_U_fixed = min(0.01, U_max)\n    rec_N = _recommend_N(Re, rec_U_fixed, N_min_rec)\n\n    # For recommended_U: fix N and solve U\n    rec_U_for_N = _recommend_U(Re, N, U_min, U_max)\n\n    return LBMParams(Re, N, U_ref, ν, τ, ω, Ma, feasible, regime,\n                     warnings, rec_N, rec_U_for_N)\nend\n```"), (name = :lbm_params_table, signature = "function lbm_params_table(; Re::Real, N_range, U_ref::Real=0.01)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    lbm_params_table(; Re, N_range, U_ref=0.01)\n\nPrint a comparison table for multiple grid sizes at a given Re.\n\n# Example\n```julia\nlbm_params_table(Re=0.01, N_range=[8, 16, 32, 64, 128])\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    lbm_params_table(; Re, N_range, U_ref=0.01)\n\nPrint a comparison table for multiple grid sizes at a given Re.\n\n# Example\n```julia\nlbm_params_table(Re=0.01, N_range=[8, 16, 32, 64, 128])\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction lbm_params_table(; Re::Real, N_range, U_ref::Real=0.01)\n    Re = Float64(Re)\n    U_ref = Float64(U_ref)\n    cs = 1.0 / sqrt(3.0)\n    Ma = U_ref / cs\n\n    println(\"LBM parameter space for Re = \$Re, U_ref = \$U_ref (Ma = \$(round(Ma, digits=4)))\")\n    println(\"─\"^78)\n    println(rpad(\"N\", 6), rpad(\"ν\", 12), rpad(\"τ\", 10), rpad(\"ω\", 12),\n            rpad(\"regime\", 14), \"status\")\n    println(\"─\"^78)\n\n    for N in N_range\n        p = lbm_params(; Re=Re, N=Int(N), U_ref=U_ref)\n        status = p.feasible ? \"✓\" : \"✗\"\n        nw = length(p.warnings)\n        extra = nw > 0 && p.feasible ? \" (\$(nw) warning\$(nw>1 ? \"s\" : \"\"))\" : \"\"\n        println(rpad(N, 6),\n                rpad(round(p.nu, digits=6), 12),\n                rpad(round(p.tau, digits=4), 10),\n                rpad(round(p.omega, digits=6), 12),\n                rpad(p.regime, 14),\n                status, extra)\n    end\n\n    println(\"─\"^78)\n    # Show best achievable configuration\n    rec = lbm_params(; Re=Re, N=64, U_ref=U_ref)\n    rec_τ = 3.0 * 0.01 * rec.recommended_N / Re + 0.5\n    rec_regime = rec_τ < 0.51 ? \"marginal\" : rec_τ ≤ 2.0 ? \"optimal\" :\n                 rec_τ ≤ 10.0 ? \"acceptable\" : rec_τ ≤ 100.0 ? \"diffusive\" : \"infeasible\"\n    println(\"Best config: N = \$(rec.recommended_N), U_ref = 0.01 → τ = \$(round(rec_τ, digits=3)) (\$rec_regime)\")\n    if Re < 0.1\n        # Show the physical limit\n        τ_min_possible = 3.0 * 0.058 * 10 / Re + 0.5  # N=10, Ma=0.1\n        println(\"Low-Re limit: Re = \$Re < 0.1, best possible τ ≈ \$(round(τ_min_possible, digits=1)) (N=10, Ma=0.1)\")\n    end\nend\n```"), (name = :CurvilinearMesh, signature = "struct CurvilinearMesh{T<:AbstractFloat, AT<:AbstractMatrix{T}}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    CurvilinearMesh{T, AT}\n\nLogically structured `Nξ × Nη` mesh in computational space with a user-\nsupplied mapping to physical space. All metric arrays are precomputed\nhost-side; transfer to device happens at simulation start.\n\n# Fields\n- `type`: discriminator (`:polar`, `:stretched_box`, `:cartesian`, `:custom`)\n- `Nξ, Nη`: logical grid extents\n- `periodic_ξ, periodic_η`: wrap-around flags (true → ξ ∈ [0,1), false → [0,1])\n- `X, Y`: physical node coordinates `[Nξ, Nη]`\n- `dXdξ, dXdη, dYdξ, dYdη`: metric derivatives `[Nξ, Nη]`\n- `J`: Jacobian determinant `J = ∂X/∂ξ · ∂Y/∂η − ∂X/∂η · ∂Y/∂ξ`\n\n# Conventions\n- For `:polar`: ξ is angular (periodic, n_θ samples in [0, 2π)),\n  η is radial (non-periodic, n_r samples in [r_inner, r_outer]).\n- For `:stretched_box`: ξ is x-like, η is y-like.\n- Streaming runs on the logical (ξ, η) grid; physics quantities are\n  carried in physical units.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    CurvilinearMesh{T, AT}\n\nLogically structured `Nξ × Nη` mesh in computational space with a user-\nsupplied mapping to physical space. All metric arrays are precomputed\nhost-side; transfer to device happens at simulation start.\n\n# Fields\n- `type`: discriminator (`:polar`, `:stretched_box`, `:cartesian`, `:custom`)\n- `Nξ, Nη`: logical grid extents\n- `periodic_ξ, periodic_η`: wrap-around flags (true → ξ ∈ [0,1), false → [0,1])\n- `X, Y`: physical node coordinates `[Nξ, Nη]`\n- `dXdξ, dXdη, dYdξ, dYdη`: metric derivatives `[Nξ, Nη]`\n- `J`: Jacobian determinant `J = ∂X/∂ξ · ∂Y/∂η − ∂X/∂η · ∂Y/∂ξ`\n\n# Conventions\n- For `:polar`: ξ is angular (periodic, n_θ samples in [0, 2π)),\n  η is radial (non-periodic, n_r samples in [r_inner, r_outer]).\n- For `:stretched_box`: ξ is x-like, η is y-like.\n- Streaming runs on the logical (ξ, η) grid; physics quantities are\n  carried in physical units.\n\"\"\"\nstruct CurvilinearMesh{T<:AbstractFloat, AT<:AbstractMatrix{T}}\n    type::Symbol\n    Nξ::Int\n    Nη::Int\n    periodic_ξ::Bool\n    periodic_η::Bool\n    X::AT\n    Y::AT\n    dXdξ::AT\n    dXdη::AT\n    dYdξ::AT\n    dYdη::AT\n    J::AT\n    # Physical distance that corresponds to one lattice unit. Used by\n    # the semi-Lagrangian streaming step: departure point in physical\n    # space is P − c_q · dx_ref. For a uniform Cartesian mesh with\n    # isotropic spacing this equals the grid spacing, so SLBM reduces\n    # to standard LBM (integer departures, zero interpolation error).\n    dx_ref::T\nend\n```"), (name = :build_mesh, signature = "function build_mesh(mapping;", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    build_mesh(mapping; Nξ, Nη, periodic_ξ=false, periodic_η=false,\n               type=:custom, FT=Float64) -> CurvilinearMesh\n\nSample the mapping on the logical `Nξ × Nη` grid, computing physical\ncoordinates and metric derivatives at every node via ForwardDiff.\n\nThe computational coordinate `ξ` ranges over `[0, 1]` if `periodic_ξ` is\nfalse, or `[0, 1)` (last sample omitted) if periodic. Same for `η`.\n\nValidates: `J > 0` everywhere (asserts no mesh fold), warns on extreme\naspect ratios or near-degenerate orthogonality.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    build_mesh(mapping; Nξ, Nη, periodic_ξ=false, periodic_η=false,\n               type=:custom, FT=Float64) -> CurvilinearMesh\n\nSample the mapping on the logical `Nξ × Nη` grid, computing physical\ncoordinates and metric derivatives at every node via ForwardDiff.\n\nThe computational coordinate `ξ` ranges over `[0, 1]` if `periodic_ξ` is\nfalse, or `[0, 1)` (last sample omitted) if periodic. Same for `η`.\n\nValidates: `J > 0` everywhere (asserts no mesh fold), warns on extreme\naspect ratios or near-degenerate orthogonality.\n\"\"\"\nfunction build_mesh(mapping;\n                    Nξ::Int, Nη::Int,\n                    periodic_ξ::Bool=false, periodic_η::Bool=false,\n                    type::Symbol=:custom,\n                    dx_ref::Union{Real, Nothing}=nothing,\n                    skip_validate::Bool=false,\n                    FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    X = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη)\n    Y = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη)\n    dXdξ = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη)\n    dXdη = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη)\n    dYdξ = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη)\n    dYdη = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη)\n    J = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη)\n\n    denom_ξ = FT(periodic_ξ ? Nξ : Nξ - 1)\n    denom_η = FT(periodic_η ? Nη : Nη - 1)\n\n    for j in 1:Nη, i in 1:Nξ\n        ξ = FT(i - 1) / denom_ξ\n        η = FT(j - 1) / denom_η\n        xy = mapping(ξ, η)\n        X[i, j] = xy[1]\n        Y[i, j] = xy[2]\n        dXdξ_, dXdη_, dYdξ_, dYdη_, detJ = compute_metric(mapping, ξ, η)\n        dXdξ[i, j] = dXdξ_\n        dXdη[i, j] = dXdη_\n        dYdξ[i, j] = dYdξ_\n        dYdη[i, j] = dYdη_\n        J[i, j] = detJ\n    end\n\n    dxr = dx_ref === nothing ?\n          _default_dx_ref(dXdξ, dXdη, dYdξ, dYdη, Nξ, Nη, periodic_ξ, periodic_η, FT) :\n          FT(dx_ref)\n\n    mesh = CurvilinearMesh{FT, Matrix{FT}}(type, Nξ, Nη, periodic_ξ, periodic_η,\n                                            X, Y, dXdξ, dXdη, dYdξ, dYdη, J, dxr)\n    skip_validate || validate_mesh(mesh)\n    return mesh\nend\n```"), (name = :validate_mesh, signature = "function validate_mesh(mesh::CurvilinearMesh{T};", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    validate_mesh(mesh; min_orthog_deg=45.0, max_aspect=100.0)\n\nAssert positive Jacobian everywhere; warn on poor orthogonality or\nextreme aspect ratio. Pitfalls documented in Mei & Shyy 1998 §3,\nImamura 2005 Appendix A, Budinski 2014 §4.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    validate_mesh(mesh; min_orthog_deg=45.0, max_aspect=100.0)\n\nAssert positive Jacobian everywhere; warn on poor orthogonality or\nextreme aspect ratio. Pitfalls documented in Mei & Shyy 1998 §3,\nImamura 2005 Appendix A, Budinski 2014 §4.\n\"\"\"\nfunction validate_mesh(mesh::CurvilinearMesh{T};\n                       min_orthog_deg::Real=45.0,\n                       max_aspect::Real=100.0) where {T}\n    # Fold detection: J must be strictly non-zero and have a consistent\n    # sign across the entire mesh. Sign itself is irrelevant — it only\n    # encodes whether the (ξ, η) basis is right-handed in physical space.\n    Jmin = minimum(mesh.J)\n    Jmax = maximum(mesh.J)\n    Jabs_min = min(abs(Jmin), abs(Jmax))\n    if Jabs_min == zero(T) || (Jmin < zero(T) && Jmax > zero(T))\n        i, j = Tuple(argmin(abs.(mesh.J)))\n        error(\"CurvilinearMesh: degenerate Jacobian (sign change or zero) \" *\n              \"at (i=\$i, j=\$j): min|J|=\$(Jabs_min), Jmin=\$(Jmin), Jmax=\$(Jmax). \" *\n              \"Mesh has a fold or degenerate cell.\")\n    end\n\n    cos_min = one(T)\n    aspect_max = zero(T)\n    @inbounds for j in 1:mesh.Nη, i in 1:mesh.Nξ\n        ξ_len = sqrt(mesh.dXdξ[i, j]^2 + mesh.dYdξ[i, j]^2)\n        η_len = sqrt(mesh.dXdη[i, j]^2 + mesh.dYdη[i, j]^2)\n        if ξ_len > zero(T) && η_len > zero(T)\n            dot = (mesh.dXdξ[i, j] * mesh.dXdη[i, j] + mesh.dYdξ[i, j] * mesh.dYdη[i, j]) /\n                  (ξ_len * η_len)\n            cos_min = min(cos_min, abs(dot))\n            ar = max(ξ_len, η_len) / min(ξ_len, η_len)\n            aspect_max = max(aspect_max, ar)\n        end\n    end\n\n    angle_min_deg = rad2deg(acos(min(cos_min, one(T))))\n    if angle_min_deg < T(min_orthog_deg)\n        @warn \"CurvilinearMesh: minimum orthogonality angle \$(angle_min_deg)° < \$(min_orthog_deg)° \" *\n              \"(Budinski 2014 reports >30% Cd error below 60°).\"\n    end\n    if aspect_max > T(max_aspect)\n        @warn \"CurvilinearMesh: maximum cell aspect ratio \$(aspect_max) > \$(max_aspect) \" *\n              \"(Dorschner 2016 warns that regularised collision degrades above this).\"\n    end\n    return nothing\nend\n```"), (name = :compute_metric, signature = "function compute_metric(mapping, ξ::T, η::T) where {T<:AbstractFloat}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    compute_metric(mapping, ξ::T, η::T) -> (dXdξ, dXdη, dYdξ, dYdη, J)\n\nForward-mode AD evaluation of the mapping derivatives at one point.\nThe mapping must be a Julia function `(ξ, η) -> (X, Y)` returning a\n`Tuple` or `AbstractVector` of length 2, written in pure Julia so that\n`ForwardDiff.Dual` numbers propagate through it.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    compute_metric(mapping, ξ::T, η::T) -> (dXdξ, dXdη, dYdξ, dYdη, J)\n\nForward-mode AD evaluation of the mapping derivatives at one point.\nThe mapping must be a Julia function `(ξ, η) -> (X, Y)` returning a\n`Tuple` or `AbstractVector` of length 2, written in pure Julia so that\n`ForwardDiff.Dual` numbers propagate through it.\n\"\"\"\nfunction compute_metric(mapping, ξ::T, η::T) where {T<:AbstractFloat}\n    f = p -> begin\n        xy = mapping(p[1], p[2])\n        return [xy[1], xy[2]]\n    end\n    Jmat = ForwardDiff.jacobian(f, T[ξ, η])\n    dXdξ = Jmat[1, 1]\n    dXdη = Jmat[1, 2]\n    dYdξ = Jmat[2, 1]\n    dYdη = Jmat[2, 2]\n    detJ = dXdξ * dYdη - dXdη * dYdξ\n    return dXdξ, dXdη, dYdξ, dYdη, detJ\nend\n```"), (name = :polar_mesh, signature = "function polar_mesh(; cx::Real=0.0, cy::Real=0.0,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    polar_mesh(; cx=0, cy=0, r_inner, r_outer, n_theta, n_r,\n                 r_stretch=0, FT=Float64) -> CurvilinearMesh\n\nO-grid around a point at `(cx, cy)`, with `n_theta` cells azimuthally\n(periodic in ξ) and `n_r` nodes radially from `r_inner` to `r_outer`.\n\n`r_stretch ≥ 0` controls clustering near the inner wall. `r_stretch = 0`\ngives uniform radial spacing; larger values pack nodes near `r = r_inner`\nfollowing `tanh(r_stretch · t) / tanh(r_stretch)`.\n\nCoordinate convention: `ξ ∈ [0, 1)` maps to `θ ∈ [0, 2π)` (periodic),\n`η ∈ [0, 1]` maps to `r ∈ [r_inner, r_outer]`. The inner wall sits on\n`j = 1`, the far-field on `j = n_r`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    polar_mesh(; cx=0, cy=0, r_inner, r_outer, n_theta, n_r,\n                 r_stretch=0, FT=Float64) -> CurvilinearMesh\n\nO-grid around a point at `(cx, cy)`, with `n_theta` cells azimuthally\n(periodic in ξ) and `n_r` nodes radially from `r_inner` to `r_outer`.\n\n`r_stretch ≥ 0` controls clustering near the inner wall. `r_stretch = 0`\ngives uniform radial spacing; larger values pack nodes near `r = r_inner`\nfollowing `tanh(r_stretch · t) / tanh(r_stretch)`.\n\nCoordinate convention: `ξ ∈ [0, 1)` maps to `θ ∈ [0, 2π)` (periodic),\n`η ∈ [0, 1]` maps to `r ∈ [r_inner, r_outer]`. The inner wall sits on\n`j = 1`, the far-field on `j = n_r`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction polar_mesh(; cx::Real=0.0, cy::Real=0.0,\n                      r_inner::Real, r_outer::Real,\n                      n_theta::Int, n_r::Int,\n                      r_stretch::Real=0.0,\n                      FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    r_outer > r_inner > 0 || error(\"polar_mesh: require 0 < r_inner < r_outer\")\n    n_theta ≥ 8 || error(\"polar_mesh: n_theta must be ≥ 8\")\n    n_r ≥ 4 || error(\"polar_mesh: n_r must be ≥ 4\")\n    r_stretch ≥ 0 || error(\"polar_mesh: r_stretch must be ≥ 0\")\n\n    cxT, cyT = FT(cx), FT(cy)\n    rinT, routT = FT(r_inner), FT(r_outer)\n    sT = FT(r_stretch)\n    twoπ = FT(2π)\n\n    function mapping(ξ, η)\n        θ = twoπ * ξ\n        if iszero(sT)\n            r = rinT + (routT - rinT) * η\n        else\n            # Convex map η ∈ [0,1] → [0,1] that clusters near η = 0,\n            # so points pack near the inner wall (r_inner).\n            t = one(η) - tanh(sT * (one(η) - η)) / tanh(sT)\n            r = rinT + (routT - rinT) * t\n        end\n        return (cxT + r * cos(θ), cyT + r * sin(θ))\n    end\n\n    return build_mesh(mapping; Nξ=n_theta, Nη=n_r,\n                      periodic_ξ=true, periodic_η=false,\n                      type=:polar, FT=FT)\nend\n```"), (name = :stretched_box_mesh, signature = "function stretched_box_mesh(; x_min::Real, x_max::Real,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    stretched_box_mesh(; x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max, Nx, Ny,\n                         x_stretch=0, y_stretch=0,\n                         x_stretch_dir=:none, y_stretch_dir=:none,\n                         FT=Float64) -> CurvilinearMesh\n\nRectangular `Nx × Ny` mesh in `[x_min, x_max] × [y_min, y_max]` with\noptional one-dimensional `tanh` stretching along each axis.\n\n`x_stretch_dir ∈ (:none, :left, :right, :both)`: clustering toward the\n`x_min` wall, the `x_max` wall, both walls, or none. Same for\n`y_stretch_dir`. `x_stretch = 0` (or `:none` direction) gives uniform\nspacing.\n\nUseful for: Poiseuille (y_stretch_dir=:both), natural-convection cavity\n(x_stretch_dir=:both, y_stretch_dir=:both), boundary layers.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    stretched_box_mesh(; x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max, Nx, Ny,\n                         x_stretch=0, y_stretch=0,\n                         x_stretch_dir=:none, y_stretch_dir=:none,\n                         FT=Float64) -> CurvilinearMesh\n\nRectangular `Nx × Ny` mesh in `[x_min, x_max] × [y_min, y_max]` with\noptional one-dimensional `tanh` stretching along each axis.\n\n`x_stretch_dir ∈ (:none, :left, :right, :both)`: clustering toward the\n`x_min` wall, the `x_max` wall, both walls, or none. Same for\n`y_stretch_dir`. `x_stretch = 0` (or `:none` direction) gives uniform\nspacing.\n\nUseful for: Poiseuille (y_stretch_dir=:both), natural-convection cavity\n(x_stretch_dir=:both, y_stretch_dir=:both), boundary layers.\n\"\"\"\nfunction stretched_box_mesh(; x_min::Real, x_max::Real,\n                              y_min::Real, y_max::Real,\n                              Nx::Int, Ny::Int,\n                              x_stretch::Real=0.0, y_stretch::Real=0.0,\n                              x_stretch_dir::Symbol=:none,\n                              y_stretch_dir::Symbol=:none,\n                              FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    x_max > x_min || error(\"stretched_box_mesh: require x_max > x_min\")\n    y_max > y_min || error(\"stretched_box_mesh: require y_max > y_min\")\n    Nx ≥ 2 && Ny ≥ 2 || error(\"stretched_box_mesh: Nx, Ny must be ≥ 2\")\n    x_stretch_dir ∈ (:none, :left, :right, :both) ||\n        error(\"x_stretch_dir must be :none, :left, :right, or :both\")\n    y_stretch_dir ∈ (:none, :left, :right, :both) ||\n        error(\"y_stretch_dir must be :none, :left, :right, or :both\")\n\n    xminT, xmaxT = FT(x_min), FT(x_max)\n    yminT, ymaxT = FT(y_min), FT(y_max)\n    sxT, syT = FT(x_stretch), FT(y_stretch)\n\n    function mapping(ξ, η)\n        tx = _stretch(ξ, sxT, x_stretch_dir)\n        ty = _stretch(η, syT, y_stretch_dir)\n        return (xminT + (xmaxT - xminT) * tx,\n                yminT + (ymaxT - yminT) * ty)\n    end\n\n    return build_mesh(mapping; Nξ=Nx, Nη=Ny,\n                      periodic_ξ=false, periodic_η=false,\n                      type=:stretched_box, FT=FT)\nend\n```"), (name = :cartesian_mesh, signature = "function cartesian_mesh(; x_min::Real, x_max::Real,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    cartesian_mesh(; x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max, Nx, Ny, FT=Float64)\n\nConvenience: uniform Cartesian mesh exposed as a `CurvilinearMesh`. The\nmetric is the identity scaled by `(Δx, Δy)`. Useful for SLBM debugging\n(should reproduce standard LBM exactly) and as the default when no\n`Mesh` block is present in a `.krk` config.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    cartesian_mesh(; x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max, Nx, Ny, FT=Float64)\n\nConvenience: uniform Cartesian mesh exposed as a `CurvilinearMesh`. The\nmetric is the identity scaled by `(Δx, Δy)`. Useful for SLBM debugging\n(should reproduce standard LBM exactly) and as the default when no\n`Mesh` block is present in a `.krk` config.\n\"\"\"\nfunction cartesian_mesh(; x_min::Real, x_max::Real,\n                          y_min::Real, y_max::Real,\n                          Nx::Int, Ny::Int,\n                          FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    return stretched_box_mesh(; x_min=x_min, x_max=x_max,\n                                y_min=y_min, y_max=y_max,\n                                Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, FT=FT)\nend\n```"), (name = :cylinder_focused_mesh, signature = "function cylinder_focused_mesh(; x_min::Real, x_max::Real,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    cylinder_focused_mesh(; x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max, Nx, Ny,\n                            cx, cy, strength=1.0, FT=Float64)\n\nRectangular mesh with tanh-based concentration of cells around a point\n`(cx, cy)` in physical space (not at the domain boundaries).\n\nThe mapping is built piecewise: for each axis, a two-sided tanh collects\nnodes around the focus point while preserving the domain extremes.\n\nUseful for: cylinder flow where the body is NOT at the boundary.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    cylinder_focused_mesh(; x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max, Nx, Ny,\n                            cx, cy, strength=1.0, FT=Float64)\n\nRectangular mesh with tanh-based concentration of cells around a point\n`(cx, cy)` in physical space (not at the domain boundaries).\n\nThe mapping is built piecewise: for each axis, a two-sided tanh collects\nnodes around the focus point while preserving the domain extremes.\n\nUseful for: cylinder flow where the body is NOT at the boundary.\n\"\"\"\nfunction cylinder_focused_mesh(; x_min::Real, x_max::Real,\n                                 y_min::Real, y_max::Real,\n                                 Nx::Int, Ny::Int,\n                                 cx::Real, cy::Real,\n                                 strength::Real=1.0,\n                                 FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    xminT, xmaxT = FT(x_min), FT(x_max)\n    yminT, ymaxT = FT(y_min), FT(y_max)\n    cxT, cyT = FT(cx), FT(cy)\n    sT = FT(strength)\n    ξ_foc = (cxT - xminT) / (xmaxT - xminT)\n    η_foc = (cyT - yminT) / (ymaxT - yminT)\n\n    # Two-sided tanh: bunches nodes near t_foc while pinning t=0→0 and t=1→1\n    function focus_map(t, t_foc, s)\n        iszero(s) && return t\n        # Scale ξ so that ξ=t_foc maps to 0, then apply tanh, then renormalize\n        if t ≤ t_foc\n            # Left half: map [0, t_foc] → [0, t_foc] with tanh clustering at right end\n            ξ = t / t_foc  # ∈ [0, 1]\n            ξ_cluster = one(t) - tanh(s * (one(t) - ξ)) / tanh(s)\n            return t_foc * ξ_cluster\n        else\n            # Right half: map [t_foc, 1] → [t_foc, 1] with tanh clustering at left end\n            ξ = (t - t_foc) / (one(t) - t_foc)\n            ξ_cluster = tanh(s * ξ) / tanh(s)\n            return t_foc + (one(t) - t_foc) * ξ_cluster\n        end\n    end\n\n    function mapping(ξ, η)\n        tx = focus_map(ξ, ξ_foc, sT)\n        ty = focus_map(η, η_foc, sT)\n        return (xminT + (xmaxT - xminT) * tx,\n                yminT + (ymaxT - yminT) * ty)\n    end\n\n    return build_mesh(mapping; Nξ=Nx, Nη=Ny,\n                      periodic_ξ=false, periodic_η=false,\n                      type=:cylinder_focused, FT=FT)\nend\n```"), (name = :cell_area, signature = "", docstring = "", source_excerpt = ""), (name = :domain_extent, signature = "function domain_extent(mesh::CurvilinearMesh)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    domain_extent(mesh) -> (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)\n\nBounding box of the physical mesh nodes.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    domain_extent(mesh) -> (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)\n\nBounding box of the physical mesh nodes.\n\"\"\"\nfunction domain_extent(mesh::CurvilinearMesh)\n    return extrema(mesh.X)..., extrema(mesh.Y)...\nend\n```"), (name = :SLBMGeometry, signature = "struct SLBMGeometry{T<:AbstractFloat, AT3<:AbstractArray{T, 3}}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    SLBMGeometry{T, AT3, AT2}\n\nPrecomputed departure grid indices for semi-Lagrangian streaming on a\ncurvilinear mesh. Built once from a `CurvilinearMesh`; passed to the\nfused kernel at every timestep.\n\n# Fields\n- `i_dep, j_dep`: floating-point departure indices `[Nξ, Nη, 9]`. For\n  direction `q` at node `(i, j)`, the departure is\n  `(i_dep[i,j,q], j_dep[i,j,q])` in grid-index space.\n- `periodic_ξ, periodic_η`: mirror the parent mesh so the kernel can\n  wrap or clamp.\n- `Nξ, Nη`: logical grid extents.\n- `dx_ref`: physical distance per lattice unit (copied from mesh).\n\nFor a uniform Cartesian mesh with isotropic spacing, `i_dep[i,j,q] =\ni − c_qx` and `j_dep[i,j,q] = j − c_qy` exactly — SLBM reduces to\nstandard stream-collide.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    SLBMGeometry{T, AT3, AT2}\n\nPrecomputed departure grid indices for semi-Lagrangian streaming on a\ncurvilinear mesh. Built once from a `CurvilinearMesh`; passed to the\nfused kernel at every timestep.\n\n# Fields\n- `i_dep, j_dep`: floating-point departure indices `[Nξ, Nη, 9]`. For\n  direction `q` at node `(i, j)`, the departure is\n  `(i_dep[i,j,q], j_dep[i,j,q])` in grid-index space.\n- `periodic_ξ, periodic_η`: mirror the parent mesh so the kernel can\n  wrap or clamp.\n- `Nξ, Nη`: logical grid extents.\n- `dx_ref`: physical distance per lattice unit (copied from mesh).\n\nFor a uniform Cartesian mesh with isotropic spacing, `i_dep[i,j,q] =\ni − c_qx` and `j_dep[i,j,q] = j − c_qy` exactly — SLBM reduces to\nstandard stream-collide.\n\"\"\"\nstruct SLBMGeometry{T<:AbstractFloat, AT3<:AbstractArray{T, 3}}\n    i_dep::AT3\n    j_dep::AT3\n    Nξ::Int\n    Nη::Int\n    periodic_ξ::Bool\n    periodic_η::Bool\n    dx_ref::T\nend\n```"), (name = :build_slbm_geometry, signature = "function build_slbm_geometry(mesh::CurvilinearMesh{T};", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    build_slbm_geometry(mesh::CurvilinearMesh) -> SLBMGeometry\n\nPrecompute the grid-index departure points for every node and every\nD2Q9 direction. Linearises the mapping locally via the stored metric:\n\n    Δi = −dx_ref · denom_ξ · (dξ/dX · c_qx + dξ/dY · c_qy)\n    Δj = −dx_ref · denom_η · (dη/dX · c_qx + dη/dY · c_qy)\n\nwith the inverse Jacobian `dξ/dX = dY/dη / J`, etc.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    build_slbm_geometry(mesh::CurvilinearMesh) -> SLBMGeometry\n\nPrecompute the grid-index departure points for every node and every\nD2Q9 direction. Linearises the mapping locally via the stored metric:\n\n    Δi = −dx_ref · denom_ξ · (dξ/dX · c_qx + dξ/dY · c_qy)\n    Δj = −dx_ref · denom_η · (dη/dX · c_qx + dη/dY · c_qy)\n\nwith the inverse Jacobian `dξ/dX = dY/dη / J`, etc.\n\"\"\"\nfunction build_slbm_geometry(mesh::CurvilinearMesh{T};\n                              local_cfl::Bool=false,\n                              dx_ref::Real=0) where {T}\n    Nξ, Nη = mesh.Nξ, mesh.Nη\n    cx = velocities_x(D2Q9())\n    cy = velocities_y(D2Q9())\n\n    denom_ξ = T(mesh.periodic_ξ ? Nξ : Nξ - 1)\n    denom_η = T(mesh.periodic_η ? Nη : Nη - 1)\n    Δξ = one(T) / denom_ξ\n    Δη = one(T) / denom_η\n\n    i_dep = zeros(T, Nξ, Nη, 9)\n    j_dep = zeros(T, Nξ, Nη, 9)\n    dxr = dx_ref > 0 ? T(dx_ref) : mesh.dx_ref\n\n    @inbounds for j in 1:Nη, i in 1:Nξ\n        J = mesh.J[i, j]\n        dXdξ = mesh.dXdξ[i, j]\n        dXdη = mesh.dXdη[i, j]\n        dYdξ = mesh.dYdξ[i, j]\n        dYdη = mesh.dYdη[i, j]\n        ξx =  dYdη / J\n        ξy = -dXdη / J\n        ηx = -dYdξ / J\n        ηy =  dXdξ / J\n\n        if local_cfl\n            # Local cell size → CFL ≈ 1 per cell\n            lξ = sqrt(dXdξ^2 + dYdξ^2) * Δξ\n            lη = sqrt(dXdη^2 + dYdη^2) * Δη\n            dxr_local = sqrt(lξ * lη)\n        else\n            dxr_local = dxr\n        end\n\n        for q in 1:9\n            cqx = T(cx[q])\n            cqy = T(cy[q])\n            Δi = -dxr_local * denom_ξ * (ξx * cqx + ξy * cqy)\n            Δj = -dxr_local * denom_η * (ηx * cqx + ηy * cqy)\n            i_dep[i, j, q] = T(i) + Δi\n            j_dep[i, j, q] = T(j) + Δj\n        end\n    end\n\n    return SLBMGeometry{T, Array{T, 3}}(i_dep, j_dep, Nξ, Nη,\n                                         mesh.periodic_ξ, mesh.periodic_η, dxr)\nend\n```"), (name = :transfer_slbm_geometry, signature = "function transfer_slbm_geometry(geom::SLBMGeometry{T}, backend) where {T}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    transfer_slbm_geometry(geom::SLBMGeometry, backend) -> SLBMGeometry\n\nMove the precomputed departure arrays to the device backend\n(`KernelAbstractions.CPU()`, `CUDABackend()`, `MetalBackend()`).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    transfer_slbm_geometry(geom::SLBMGeometry, backend) -> SLBMGeometry\n\nMove the precomputed departure arrays to the device backend\n(`KernelAbstractions.CPU()`, `CUDABackend()`, `MetalBackend()`).\n\"\"\"\nfunction transfer_slbm_geometry(geom::SLBMGeometry{T}, backend) where {T}\n    i_dep_dev = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, size(geom.i_dep))\n    j_dep_dev = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, size(geom.j_dep))\n    copyto!(i_dep_dev, geom.i_dep)\n    copyto!(j_dep_dev, geom.j_dep)\n    return SLBMGeometry{T, typeof(i_dep_dev)}(i_dep_dev, j_dep_dev,\n                                                geom.Nξ, geom.Nη,\n                                                geom.periodic_ξ, geom.periodic_η,\n                                                geom.dx_ref)\nend\n```"), (name = :slbm_bgk_step!, signature = "function slbm_bgk_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    slbm_bgk_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid, geom, ω;\n                   interp=:bilinear)\n\nSingle fused kernel for semi-Lagrangian BGK on a curvilinear mesh:\ninterpolated streaming + bounce-back + collision + macroscopic moments.\n\n`interp ∈ (:bilinear, :biquadratic)`. Bilinear is O(Δx²), biquadratic\nis O(Δx³) on smooth fields — recommended on distorted meshes (Wilde\net al. 2020). Both reduce to pull-stream exactly on an isotropic\nCartesian mesh.\n\nArguments match `fused_bgk_step!` plus an `SLBMGeometry` carrying the\nprecomputed departure indices. `geom.i_dep`, `geom.j_dep` must live on\nthe same backend as `f_in` (use `transfer_slbm_geometry` if needed).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    slbm_bgk_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid, geom, ω;\n                   interp=:bilinear)\n\nSingle fused kernel for semi-Lagrangian BGK on a curvilinear mesh:\ninterpolated streaming + bounce-back + collision + macroscopic moments.\n\n`interp ∈ (:bilinear, :biquadratic)`. Bilinear is O(Δx²), biquadratic\nis O(Δx³) on smooth fields — recommended on distorted meshes (Wilde\net al. 2020). Both reduce to pull-stream exactly on an isotropic\nCartesian mesh.\n\nArguments match `fused_bgk_step!` plus an `SLBMGeometry` carrying the\nprecomputed departure indices. `geom.i_dep`, `geom.j_dep` must live on\nthe same backend as `f_in` (use `transfer_slbm_geometry` if needed).\n\"\"\"\nfunction slbm_bgk_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                        geom::SLBMGeometry, ω;\n                        interp::Symbol=:bilinear)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    ET = eltype(f_in)\n    kernel! = interp === :biquadratic ?\n              slbm_bgk_biquad_step_kernel!(backend) :\n              slbm_bgk_step_kernel!(backend)\n    kernel!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n            geom.i_dep, geom.j_dep,\n            geom.Nξ, geom.Nη, ET(ω),\n            geom.periodic_ξ, geom.periodic_η;\n            ndrange=(geom.Nξ, geom.Nη))\nend\n```"), (name = :slbm_bgk_moving_step!, signature = "function slbm_bgk_moving_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    slbm_bgk_moving_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                          uw_x, uw_y, geom, ω; interp=:bilinear)\n\nFused SLBM + BGK step with Ladd (1994) moving-wall bounce-back.\n`uw_x`, `uw_y` are per-cell prescribed wall velocities (nonzero only on\nsolid cells; ignored on fluid cells). `interp ∈ (:bilinear, :biquadratic)`.\nReduces to `slbm_bgk_step!` when both wall velocities are zero.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    slbm_bgk_moving_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                          uw_x, uw_y, geom, ω; interp=:bilinear)\n\nFused SLBM + BGK step with Ladd (1994) moving-wall bounce-back.\n`uw_x`, `uw_y` are per-cell prescribed wall velocities (nonzero only on\nsolid cells; ignored on fluid cells). `interp ∈ (:bilinear, :biquadratic)`.\nReduces to `slbm_bgk_step!` when both wall velocities are zero.\n\"\"\"\nfunction slbm_bgk_moving_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                                uw_x, uw_y, geom::SLBMGeometry, ω;\n                                interp::Symbol=:bilinear)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    ET = eltype(f_in)\n    kernel! = interp === :biquadratic ?\n              slbm_bgk_moving_biquad_step_kernel!(backend) :\n              slbm_bgk_moving_step_kernel!(backend)\n    kernel!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n            uw_x, uw_y,\n            geom.i_dep, geom.j_dep,\n            geom.Nξ, geom.Nη, ET(ω),\n            geom.periodic_ξ, geom.periodic_η;\n            ndrange=(geom.Nξ, geom.Nη))\nend\n```"), (name = :slbm_mrt_step!, signature = "function slbm_mrt_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    slbm_mrt_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid, geom, ν;\n                   s_e=1.4, s_eps=1.4, s_q=1.2)\n\nFused SLBM + MRT collision in one GPU dispatch. `ν` is the kinematic\nviscosity (lattice units); the stress rate is computed as\n`s_ν = 1/(3ν + 0.5)`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    slbm_mrt_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid, geom, ν;\n                   s_e=1.4, s_eps=1.4, s_q=1.2)\n\nFused SLBM + MRT collision in one GPU dispatch. `ν` is the kinematic\nviscosity (lattice units); the stress rate is computed as\n`s_ν = 1/(3ν + 0.5)`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction slbm_mrt_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                        geom::SLBMGeometry, ν;\n                        s_e=1.4, s_eps=1.4, s_q=1.2)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    ET = eltype(f_in)\n    s_nu = ET(1.0 / (3.0 * ν + 0.5))\n    kernel! = slbm_mrt_step_kernel!(backend)\n    kernel!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n            geom.i_dep, geom.j_dep,\n            geom.Nξ, geom.Nη,\n            ET(s_e), ET(s_eps), ET(s_q), s_nu,\n            geom.periodic_ξ, geom.periodic_η;\n            ndrange=(geom.Nξ, geom.Nη))\nend\n```"), (name = :slbm_trt_libb_step!, signature = "function slbm_trt_libb_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    slbm_trt_libb_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                         q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n                         geom, ν; Λ=3/16)\n\nFused SLBM + TRT + LI-BB step on a curvilinear mesh. Combines semi-\nLagrangian streaming, LI-BB pre-phase substitution on cut links, and\nTRT collision with magic parameter Λ.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    slbm_trt_libb_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                         q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n                         geom, ν; Λ=3/16)\n\nFused SLBM + TRT + LI-BB step on a curvilinear mesh. Combines semi-\nLagrangian streaming, LI-BB pre-phase substitution on cut links, and\nTRT collision with magic parameter Λ.\n\"\"\"\nfunction slbm_trt_libb_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                              q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n                              geom::SLBMGeometry, ν; Λ::Real=3/16)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    ET = eltype(f_in)\n    s_plus, s_minus = trt_rates(ν; Λ=Λ)\n    kernel! = slbm_trt_libb_step_kernel!(backend)\n    kernel!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n            q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n            geom.i_dep, geom.j_dep,\n            geom.Nξ, geom.Nη, ET(s_plus), ET(s_minus),\n            geom.periodic_ξ, geom.periodic_η;\n            ndrange=(geom.Nξ, geom.Nη))\nend\n```"), (name = :slbm_trt_libb_step_local_2d!, signature = "function slbm_trt_libb_step_local_2d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    slbm_trt_libb_step_local_2d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                                  q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n                                  geom, sp_field, sm_field)\n\nSLBM + TRT + LI-BB step (D2Q9) with PER-CELL relaxation rates from the\ndevice-side 2D arrays `sp_field[Nξ, Nη]` and `sm_field[Nξ, Nη]` (e.g.\nproduced by `compute_local_omega_2d` with `scaling=:quadratic` and\ncopied to the backend).
