Stores the\npopulations and macroscopic fields on an EXTENDED grid that includes\n`n_ghost` cells on every side. The physical interior is a view over\n`(n_ghost + 1 .. n_ghost + Nξ_phys, n_ghost + 1 .. n_ghost + Nη_phys)`.\n\nFields\n------\n- `f::AT3`           — populations, size `(Nξ_ext, Nη_ext, 9)`\n- `ρ::AT2`, `ux::AT2`, `uy::AT2` — macroscopic fields, `(Nξ_ext, Nη_ext)`\n- `Nξ_phys, Nη_phys::Int`   — physical grid dimensions\n- `n_ghost::Int`            — ghost-layer width (1 for D2Q9, 2 for higher stencils)\n\nAllocate via `allocate_block_state_2d(block; n_ghost=1, backend=CPU())`.\nThe allocator initialises `ρ ≡ 1`, `ux = uy ≡ 0`, `f = 0` (caller is\nexpected to overwrite `f` with equilibrium before the first step).\n\"\"\"\nmutable struct BlockState2D{T<:AbstractFloat, AT3<:AbstractArray{T, 3}, AT2<:AbstractArray{T, 2}}\n    f::AT3\n    ρ::AT2\n    ux::AT2\n    uy::AT2\n    const Nξ_phys::Int\n    const Nη_phys::Int\n    const n_ghost::Int\nend\n```"), (name = :allocate_block_state_2d, signature = "function allocate_block_state_2d(block::Block{T, AT2}; n_ghost::Int=1,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    allocate_block_state_2d(block::Block; n_ghost=1,\n                             backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU()) -> BlockState2D\n\nAllocate f / ρ / ux / uy of the extended size (Nξ_phys + 2·n_ghost) ×\n(Nη_phys + 2·n_ghost). `ρ` initialised to 1, velocities to 0, `f` to 0\n(caller seeds equilibrium before the first step).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    allocate_block_state_2d(block::Block; n_ghost=1,\n                             backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU()) -> BlockState2D\n\nAllocate f / ρ / ux / uy of the extended size (Nξ_phys + 2·n_ghost) ×\n(Nη_phys + 2·n_ghost). `ρ` initialised to 1, velocities to 0, `f` to 0\n(caller seeds equilibrium before the first step).\n\"\"\"\nfunction allocate_block_state_2d(block::Block{T, AT2}; n_ghost::Int=1,\n                                  backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU()) where {T, AT2}\n    Nx_ext = block.mesh.Nξ + 2 * n_ghost\n    Ny_ext = block.mesh.Nη + 2 * n_ghost\n    f  = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx_ext, Ny_ext, 9); fill!(f,  zero(T))\n    ρ  = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx_ext, Ny_ext);    fill!(ρ,  one(T))\n    ux = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx_ext, Ny_ext);    fill!(ux, zero(T))\n    uy = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx_ext, Ny_ext);    fill!(uy, zero(T))\n    return BlockState2D{T, typeof(f), typeof(ρ)}(f, ρ, ux, uy,\n                                                   block.mesh.Nξ, block.mesh.Nη, n_ghost)\nend\n```"), (name = :interior_f, signature = "", docstring = "", source_excerpt = ""), (name = :interior_macro, signature = "", docstring = "", source_excerpt = ""), (name = :ext_dims, signature = "", docstring = "", source_excerpt = ""), (name = :exchange_ghost_2d!, signature = "function exchange_ghost_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    exchange_ghost_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                        states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n\nFill the ghost rows of each block's `state.f` from the physical\ninterior of its neighbour across every declared interface. Must be\ncalled BEFORE the step kernel (reads `state.f` as `f_in`).\n\nPrecondition: all blocks share the same `n_ghost`.\n\nCall sequence per timestep:\n\n    exchange_ghost_2d!(mbm, states)                   # fill ghosts\n    for (k, blk) in enumerate(mbm.blocks)\n        Nx_ext, Ny_ext = ext_dims(states[k])\n        fused_bgk_step!(f_out[k], states[k].f, ...,   # step on extended size\n                          states[k].ρ, states[k].ux, states[k].uy,\n                          is_solid_ext[k], Nx_ext, Ny_ext, ω)\n    end\n    for (k, blk) in enumerate(mbm.blocks)\n        apply_bc_rebuild_2d!(interior_f(f_out[k]),    # physical BCs on interior view\n                              interior_f(states[k].f), bcspec[k], ν,\n                              states[k].Nξ_phys, states[k].Nη_phys)\n    end\n    # swap states[k].f ↔ f_out[k]  (handled by caller)\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    exchange_ghost_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                        states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n\nFill the ghost rows of each block's `state.f` from the physical\ninterior of its neighbour across every declared interface. Must be\ncalled BEFORE the step kernel (reads `state.f` as `f_in`).\n\nPrecondition: all blocks share the same `n_ghost`.\n\nCall sequence per timestep:\n\n    exchange_ghost_2d!(mbm, states)                   # fill ghosts\n    for (k, blk) in enumerate(mbm.blocks)\n        Nx_ext, Ny_ext = ext_dims(states[k])\n        fused_bgk_step!(f_out[k], states[k].f, ...,   # step on extended size\n                          states[k].ρ, states[k].ux, states[k].uy,\n                          is_solid_ext[k], Nx_ext, Ny_ext, ω)\n    end\n    for (k, blk) in enumerate(mbm.blocks)\n        apply_bc_rebuild_2d!(interior_f(f_out[k]),    # physical BCs on interior view\n                              interior_f(states[k].f), bcspec[k], ν,\n                              states[k].Nξ_phys, states[k].Nη_phys)\n    end\n    # swap states[k].f ↔ f_out[k]  (handled by caller)\n\"\"\"\nfunction exchange_ghost_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                             states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n    length(states) == length(mbm.blocks) ||\n        error(\"exchange_ghost_2d!: states has \$(length(states)) entries, \" *\n              \"mbm has \$(length(mbm.blocks)) blocks\")\n    # Consistency: all blocks must share n_ghost\n    ng = states[1].n_ghost\n    for k in 2:length(states)\n        states[k].n_ghost == ng ||\n            error(\"exchange_ghost_2d!: n_ghost mismatch (block 1: \$ng, block \$k: \$(states[k].n_ghost))\")\n    end\n    for iface in mbm.interfaces\n        a_idx = mbm.block_by_id[iface.from[1]]\n        b_idx = mbm.block_by_id[iface.to[1]]\n        _exchange_pair_ghost_2d!(states[a_idx], states[b_idx],\n                                  iface.from[2], iface.to[2];\n                                  mesh_a=mbm.blocks[a_idx].mesh,\n                                  mesh_b=mbm.blocks[b_idx].mesh)\n    end\n    return mbm\nend\n```"), (name = :exchange_ghost_shared_node_2d!, signature = "function exchange_ghost_shared_node_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    exchange_ghost_shared_node_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                                    states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n\nGhost-fill for the SHARED-NODE topology (gmsh's natural output: two\nadjacent blocks store the same interface column). Read the neighbour's\ninterior one column PAST the shared column (index `ng + 1 + k` instead\nof `ng + k`), so the ghost row represents the physical cell 1·dx\nbeyond the interface in the normal direction, just as the non-overlap\nexchange does. Call sequence is identical to `exchange_ghost_2d!`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    exchange_ghost_shared_node_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                                    states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n\nGhost-fill for the SHARED-NODE topology (gmsh's natural output: two\nadjacent blocks store the same interface column). Read the neighbour's\ninterior one column PAST the shared column (index `ng + 1 + k` instead\nof `ng + k`), so the ghost row represents the physical cell 1·dx\nbeyond the interface in the normal direction, just as the non-overlap\nexchange does. Call sequence is identical to `exchange_ghost_2d!`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction exchange_ghost_shared_node_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                                          states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n    length(states) == length(mbm.blocks) ||\n        error(\"exchange_ghost_shared_node_2d!: states has \$(length(states)) entries, \" *\n              \"mbm has \$(length(mbm.blocks)) blocks\")\n    ng = states[1].n_ghost\n    for k in 2:length(states)\n        states[k].n_ghost == ng ||\n            error(\"exchange_ghost_shared_node_2d!: n_ghost mismatch\")\n    end\n    for iface in mbm.interfaces\n        a_idx = mbm.block_by_id[iface.from[1]]\n        b_idx = mbm.block_by_id[iface.to[1]]\n        _exchange_pair_ghost_shared_node_2d!(states[a_idx], states[b_idx],\n                                               iface.from[2], iface.to[2])\n    end\n    return mbm\nend\n```"), (name = :fill_ghost_corners_2d!, signature = "function fill_ghost_corners_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    fill_ghost_corners_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                            states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n\nFill the 4 ghost-corner cells of each block by copying from the nearest\nghost-edge cell. Must be called AFTER edge exchange (both non-overlap\nand shared-node variants) and BEFORE `fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!`.\n\nFor a block of extended size `(Nxe, Nye)` with `ng=1`:\n- SW corner `f[1, 1, :]`       ← `f[2, 1, :]`  (from west ghost row at south ghost j)\n- SE corner `f[Nxe, 1, :]`     ← `f[Nxe-1, 1, :]`\n- NW corner `f[1, Nye, :]`     ← `f[2, Nye, :]`\n- NE corner `f[Nxe, Nye, :]`   ← `f[Nxe-1, Nye, :]`\n\nFills corners where at least one adjacent edge is `:interface`\n(pure wall-wall corners are handled by `fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!`).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    fill_ghost_corners_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                            states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n\nFill the 4 ghost-corner cells of each block by copying from the nearest\nghost-edge cell. Must be called AFTER edge exchange (both non-overlap\nand shared-node variants) and BEFORE `fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!`.\n\nFor a block of extended size `(Nxe, Nye)` with `ng=1`:\n- SW corner `f[1, 1, :]`       ← `f[2, 1, :]`  (from west ghost row at south ghost j)\n- SE corner `f[Nxe, 1, :]`     ← `f[Nxe-1, 1, :]`\n- NW corner `f[1, Nye, :]`     ← `f[2, Nye, :]`\n- NE corner `f[Nxe, Nye, :]`   ← `f[Nxe-1, Nye, :]`\n\nFills corners where at least one adjacent edge is `:interface`\n(pure wall-wall corners are handled by `fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!`).\n\"\"\"\nfunction fill_ghost_corners_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                                  states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n    for (k, blk) in enumerate(mbm.blocks)\n        st = states[k]\n        ng = st.n_ghost\n        Nxe, Nye = ext_dims(st)\n        tags = blk.boundary_tags\n        iW = tags.west  === INTERFACE_TAG\n        iE = tags.east  === INTERFACE_TAG\n        iS = tags.south === INTERFACE_TAG\n        iN = tags.north === INTERFACE_TAG\n        # Bilinear extrapolation: corner = edge_a + edge_b - interior\n        # SW corner\n        if iW || iS\n            @inbounds st.f[ng, ng, :] .= st.f[ng+1, ng, :] .+ st.f[ng, ng+1, :] .- st.f[ng+1, ng+1, :]\n        end\n        # SE corner\n        if iE || iS\n            @inbounds st.f[Nxe-ng+1, ng, :] .= st.f[Nxe-ng, ng, :] .+ st.f[Nxe-ng+1, ng+1, :] .- st.f[Nxe-ng, ng+1, :]\n        end\n        # NW corner\n        if iW || iN\n            @inbounds st.f[ng, Nye-ng+1, :] .= st.f[ng+1, Nye-ng+1, :] .+ st.f[ng, Nye-ng, :] .- st.f[ng+1, Nye-ng, :]\n        end\n        # NE corner\n        if iE || iN\n            @inbounds st.f[Nxe-ng+1, Nye-ng+1, :] .= st.f[Nxe-ng, Nye-ng+1, :] .+ st.f[Nxe-ng+1, Nye-ng, :] .- st.f[Nxe-ng, Nye-ng, :]\n        end\n    end\n    return nothing\nend\n```"), (name = :fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!, signature = "function fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                                  states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n\nPre-fill ghost rows of every non-`:interface` edge with a halfway-BB\nreflection of the physical boundary row. Skips edges already handled\nby `exchange_ghost_2d!` (tag == `INTERFACE_TAG`).\n\nCall sequence per timestep:\n\n    exchange_ghost_2d!(mbm, states)           # interface ghosts\n    fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!(mbm, states) # physical-wall ghosts\n    step_kernel!(...)                         # now reads valid ghosts\n    apply_bc_rebuild_2d!(interior_view, ...)  # post-step BC overwrite\n    swap f_in ↔ f_out\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                                  states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n\nPre-fill ghost rows of every non-`:interface` edge with a halfway-BB\nreflection of the physical boundary row. Skips edges already handled\nby `exchange_ghost_2d!` (tag == `INTERFACE_TAG`).\n\nCall sequence per timestep:\n\n    exchange_ghost_2d!(mbm, states)           # interface ghosts\n    fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!(mbm, states) # physical-wall ghosts\n    step_kernel!(...)                         # now reads valid ghosts\n    apply_bc_rebuild_2d!(interior_view, ...)  # post-step BC overwrite\n    swap f_in ↔ f_out\n\"\"\"\nfunction fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                                        states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n    length(states) == length(mbm.blocks) ||\n        error(\"fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!: states has \$(length(states)) entries, \" *\n              \"mbm has \$(length(mbm.blocks)) blocks\")\n    for (k, blk) in enumerate(mbm.blocks)\n        st = states[k]\n        for edge in EDGE_SYMBOLS_2D\n            tag = getproperty(blk.boundary_tags, edge)\n            tag === INTERFACE_TAG && continue\n            _fill_wall_ghost_edge_2d!(st, edge)\n        end\n    end\n    return mbm\nend\n```"), (name = :fill_slbm_wall_ghost_2d!, signature = "function fill_slbm_wall_ghost_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    fill_slbm_wall_ghost_2d!(mbm, states)\n\nPre-fill ALL 9 populations at each physical-wall ghost for SLBM on\ncurvilinear meshes, where oblique departure points may read any\npopulation from the ghost region.\n\n- **Wall/cylinder edges**: boundary-row copy (zeroth-order extrapolation).\n- **Inlet/outlet edges**: linear extrapolation `ghost = 2·boundary − interior`\n  to avoid a feedback loop through the BC-reconstructed boundary row.\n\nSkips `:interface` edges (handled by the exchange). Must be called\nBEFORE `fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!`, which then overwrites the 3\nreflected populations with more accurate halfway-BB values.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    fill_slbm_wall_ghost_2d!(mbm, states)\n\nPre-fill ALL 9 populations at each physical-wall ghost for SLBM on\ncurvilinear meshes, where oblique departure points may read any\npopulation from the ghost region.\n\n- **Wall/cylinder edges**: boundary-row copy (zeroth-order extrapolation).\n- **Inlet/outlet edges**: linear extrapolation `ghost = 2·boundary − interior`\n  to avoid a feedback loop through the BC-reconstructed boundary row.\n\nSkips `:interface` edges (handled by the exchange). Must be called\nBEFORE `fill_physical_wall_ghost_2d!`, which then overwrites the 3\nreflected populations with more accurate halfway-BB values.\n\"\"\"\nfunction fill_slbm_wall_ghost_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                                    states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n    for (k, blk) in enumerate(mbm.blocks)\n        st = states[k]\n        ng = st.n_ghost; Nxp = st.Nξ_phys; Nyp = st.Nη_phys\n        Nxe = Nxp + 2 * ng; Nye = Nyp + 2 * ng\n        backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(st.f)\n        for edge in EDGE_SYMBOLS_2D\n            tag = getproperty(blk.boundary_tags, edge)\n            tag === INTERFACE_TAG && continue\n            # Zeroth-order copy for all physical edges (wall, inlet, outlet).\n            # Linear extrapolation at inlet/outlet was unstable with SLBM\n            # because ZouHe-reconstructed boundary pops create non-physical\n            # gradients that the extrapolation amplifies.\n            if edge === :west || edge === :east\n                i_ghost = edge === :west ? ng      : ng + Nxp + 1\n                i_bd    = edge === :west ? ng + 1  : ng + Nxp\n                kernel = _copy_col_kernel_2d!(backend)\n                kernel(st.f, i_ghost, i_bd; ndrange=(Nye, 9))\n            else\n                j_ghost = edge === :south ? ng     : ng + Nyp + 1\n                j_bd    = edge === :south ? ng + 1 : ng + Nyp\n                kernel = _copy_row_kernel_2d!(backend)\n                kernel(st.f, j_ghost, j_bd; ndrange=(Nxe, 9))\n            end\n        end\n        KernelAbstractions.synchronize(backend)\n    end\n    return mbm\nend\n```"), (name = :load_gmsh_multiblock_2d, signature = "function load_gmsh_multiblock_2d(path::AbstractString;", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    load_gmsh_multiblock_2d(path; FT=Float64, layout=:auto,\n                             interface_names=(\"interface\",), tol=1e-9)\n        -> (mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D, groups::GmshPhysicalGroups)\n\nLoad every 2D surface from a gmsh file into a `MultiBlockMesh2D`. Each\nphysical surface becomes a `Block`; inter-block `Interface`s are\nauto-detected from shared curves or from curves tagged with a name in\n`interface_names`.\n\nArguments:\n- `path`: `.geo` (re-meshed on the fly) or `.msh` file path.\n- `FT`: element type for the mesh coordinates (default Float64).\n- `layout`: per-surface layout strategy. `:axis_aligned`, `:topological`,\n  or `:auto` (try axis-aligned, fall back to topological).\n- `interface_names`: tuple of physical-line names that mark an edge as\n  a multi-block interface. Default: `(\"interface\",)`.\n- `tol`: absolute tolerance used by the corner-matching step.\n\nReturns `(mbm, groups)` where `mbm` carries the blocks + interfaces and\n`groups` is the `GmshPhysicalGroups` map of the whole model (same form\nas `load_gmsh_mesh_2d`).\n\nThe returned `mbm` has NOT been passed through `sanity_check_multiblock`;\nrun it before launching a simulation.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    load_gmsh_multiblock_2d(path; FT=Float64, layout=:auto,\n                             interface_names=(\"interface\",), tol=1e-9)\n        -> (mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D, groups::GmshPhysicalGroups)\n\nLoad every 2D surface from a gmsh file into a `MultiBlockMesh2D`. Each\nphysical surface becomes a `Block`; inter-block `Interface`s are\nauto-detected from shared curves or from curves tagged with a name in\n`interface_names`.\n\nArguments:\n- `path`: `.geo` (re-meshed on the fly) or `.msh` file path.\n- `FT`: element type for the mesh coordinates (default Float64).\n- `layout`: per-surface layout strategy. `:axis_aligned`, `:topological`,\n  or `:auto` (try axis-aligned, fall back to topological).\n- `interface_names`: tuple of physical-line names that mark an edge as\n  a multi-block interface. Default: `(\"interface\",)`.\n- `tol`: absolute tolerance used by the corner-matching step.\n\nReturns `(mbm, groups)` where `mbm` carries the blocks + interfaces and\n`groups` is the `GmshPhysicalGroups` map of the whole model (same form\nas `load_gmsh_mesh_2d`).\n\nThe returned `mbm` has NOT been passed through `sanity_check_multiblock`;\nrun it before launching a simulation.\n\"\"\"\nfunction load_gmsh_multiblock_2d(path::AbstractString;\n                                   FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64,\n                                   layout::Symbol=:auto,\n                                   interface_names=(\"interface\",),\n                                   tol::Real=1e-9)\n    gmsh.initialize()\n    try\n        gmsh.option.setNumber(\"General.Terminal\", 0)\n        if endswith(lowercase(path), \".geo\")\n            gmsh.open(path)\n            gmsh.model.mesh.generate(2)\n        else\n            gmsh.open(path)\n        end\n        return _load_multiblock_2d_open(; FT=FT, layout=layout,\n                                          interface_names=interface_names,\n                                          tol=FT(tol))\n    finally\n        gmsh.finalize()\n    end\nend\n```"), (name = :reorient_block, signature = "function reorient_block(block::Block{T, AT};", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    reorient_block(block::Block; flip_ξ=false, flip_η=false, transpose=false)\n        -> Block\n\nReturn a new `Block` whose mesh has been transformed by the requested\ncombination of flips and/or a transpose (ξ↔η swap). Both mesh arrays\n(`X, Y`, metric, Jacobian) and the `boundary_tags` NamedTuple are\nupdated consistently. The underlying spline-based metric is recomputed\non the transformed node coordinates.\n\nOperations (applied in order: transpose → flip_ξ → flip_η):\n\n- `transpose=true` : `X_new[i, j] = X[j, i]` — swap logical axes. Tags\n  rotate `west ↔ south` and `east ↔ north`. Changes the block shape\n  from `(Nξ, Nη)` to `(Nη, Nξ)`.\n- `flip_ξ=true`    : mirror along ξ. Tags rotate `west ↔ east`.\n- `flip_η=true`    : mirror along η. Tags rotate `south ↔ north`.\n\nCombinations span the full dihedral group of 8 orientations, which\ncovers every per-block reorientation the multi-block loader can\nproduce from the gmsh topological walker.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    reorient_block(block::Block; flip_ξ=false, flip_η=false, transpose=false)\n        -> Block\n\nReturn a new `Block` whose mesh has been transformed by the requested\ncombination of flips and/or a transpose (ξ↔η swap). Both mesh arrays\n(`X, Y`, metric, Jacobian) and the `boundary_tags` NamedTuple are\nupdated consistently. The underlying spline-based metric is recomputed\non the transformed node coordinates.\n\nOperations (applied in order: transpose → flip_ξ → flip_η):\n\n- `transpose=true` : `X_new[i, j] = X[j, i]` — swap logical axes. Tags\n  rotate `west ↔ south` and `east ↔ north`. Changes the block shape\n  from `(Nξ, Nη)` to `(Nη, Nξ)`.\n- `flip_ξ=true`    : mirror along ξ. Tags rotate `west ↔ east`.\n- `flip_η=true`    : mirror along η. Tags rotate `south ↔ north`.\n\nCombinations span the full dihedral group of 8 orientations, which\ncovers every per-block reorientation the multi-block loader can\nproduce from the gmsh topological walker.\n\"\"\"\nfunction reorient_block(block::Block{T, AT};\n                         flip_ξ::Bool=false, flip_η::Bool=false,\n                         transpose::Bool=false) where {T, AT}\n    (!flip_ξ && !flip_η && !transpose) && return block\n    mesh = block.mesh\n    Nξ_src, Nη_src = mesh.Nξ, mesh.Nη\n    if transpose\n        Nξ_new, Nη_new = Nη_src, Nξ_src\n    else\n        Nξ_new, Nη_new = Nξ_src, Nη_src\n    end\n    X_new = Matrix{T}(undef, Nξ_new, Nη_new)\n    Y_new = Matrix{T}(undef, Nξ_new, Nη_new)\n    @inbounds for j in 1:Nη_new, i in 1:Nξ_new\n        i0, j0 = transpose ? (j, i) : (i, j)\n        ii = flip_ξ ? (Nξ_src + 1 - i0) : i0\n        jj = flip_η ? (Nη_src + 1 - j0) : j0\n        # After transpose, flip_ξ acts on the NEW ξ (= old η), so swap\n        # the interpretation: when transpose=true, flip_ξ means flip the\n        # ORIGINAL η direction, and flip_η the ORIGINAL ξ.\n        if transpose\n            ii_orig = flip_η ? (Nξ_src + 1 - i0) : i0\n            jj_orig = flip_ξ ? (Nη_src + 1 - j0) : j0\n            X_new[i, j] = mesh.X[ii_orig, jj_orig]\n            Y_new[i, j] = mesh.Y[ii_orig, jj_orig]\n        else\n            X_new[i, j] = mesh.X[ii, jj]\n            Y_new[i, j] = mesh.Y[ii, jj]\n        end\n    end\n    new_mesh = CurvilinearMesh(X_new, Y_new;\n                                 periodic_ξ=mesh.periodic_ξ,\n                                 periodic_η=mesh.periodic_η,\n                                 type=mesh.type, FT=T)\n    # Permute tags: transpose first (swaps w↔s, e↔n), then flips.\n    w, e, s, n = block.boundary_tags.west, block.boundary_tags.east,\n                 block.boundary_tags.south, block.boundary_tags.north\n    if transpose\n        w, s = s, w\n        e, n = n, e\n    end\n    if flip_ξ\n        w, e = e, w\n    end\n    if flip_η\n        s, n = n, s\n    end\n    return Block(block.id, new_mesh; west=w, east=e, south=s, north=n)\nend\n```"), (name = :autoreorient_blocks, signature = "function autoreorient_blocks(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D; verbose::Bool=false,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    autoreorient_blocks(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D; verbose=false,\n                        respect_physical_tags=true)\n        -> MultiBlockMesh2D\n\nWalk the interface graph and orient each block so that every traversed\n`Interface` ends up as an aligned opposite-normal pair\n(`:east ↔ :west` or `:north ↔ :south`, with the edge coordinates\nrunning in the same direction on both sides).\n\nWhen `respect_physical_tags=true` (default), tags with established\nglobal direction semantics are constrained to their canonical logical\nedges:\n\n- `:inlet` → `:west`\n- `:outlet` → `:east`\n- `:wall_bot`, `:wall_bottom`, `:bottom` → `:south`\n- `:wall_top`, `:wall_upper`, `:top` → `:north`\n\nThis avoids a subtle failure mode where the interface is canonical but\na physical inlet/outlet migrated to a north/south logical edge, causing\nthe boundary-condition rebuild to impose the wrong velocity component.\n\nThe block indices and `id` symbols are preserved; only the underlying\nmesh arrays and `boundary_tags` of non-root blocks may change.\n`Interface` entries are left untouched — they still reference the\nsame `(block_id, edge_symbol)` pairs, but after reorientation those\nedge symbols point to the newly-aligned edges.\n\nReturns a brand-new `MultiBlockMesh2D` (the input is not mutated).\nRaises `ErrorException` if no consistent flip assignment exists (the\ntopology is genuinely twisted and needs a transpose or human review).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    autoreorient_blocks(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D; verbose=false,\n                        respect_physical_tags=true)\n        -> MultiBlockMesh2D\n\nWalk the interface graph and orient each block so that every traversed\n`Interface` ends up as an aligned opposite-normal pair\n(`:east ↔ :west` or `:north ↔ :south`, with the edge coordinates\nrunning in the same direction on both sides).\n\nWhen `respect_physical_tags=true` (default), tags with established\nglobal direction semantics are constrained to their canonical logical\nedges:\n\n- `:inlet` → `:west`\n- `:outlet` → `:east`\n- `:wall_bot`, `:wall_bottom`, `:bottom` → `:south`\n- `:wall_top`, `:wall_upper`, `:top` → `:north`\n\nThis avoids a subtle failure mode where the interface is canonical but\na physical inlet/outlet migrated to a north/south logical edge, causing\nthe boundary-condition rebuild to impose the wrong velocity component.\n\nThe block indices and `id` symbols are preserved; only the underlying\nmesh arrays and `boundary_tags` of non-root blocks may change.\n`Interface` entries are left untouched — they still reference the\nsame `(block_id, edge_symbol)` pairs, but after reorientation those\nedge symbols point to the newly-aligned edges.\n\nReturns a brand-new `MultiBlockMesh2D` (the input is not mutated).\nRaises `ErrorException` if no consistent flip assignment exists (the\ntopology is genuinely twisted and needs a transpose or human review).\n\"\"\"\nfunction autoreorient_blocks(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D; verbose::Bool=false,\n                              respect_physical_tags::Bool=true,\n                              physical_tag_edges=_DEFAULT_PHYSICAL_TAG_EDGES)\n    blocks = collect(mbm.blocks)\n    n_blocks = length(blocks)\n    n_blocks == 0 && return mbm\n    orient_options = [(fξ, fη, tr) for tr in (false, true)\n                                   for fη in (false, true)\n                                   for fξ in (false, true)]\n    # Per-block cumulative orientation state (flip_ξ, flip_η, transpose).\n    # (false, false, false) = identity. Applied in order:\n    # transpose → flip_ξ → flip_η, matching reorient_block.\n    orient_state = fill((false, false, false), n_blocks)\n    root_orient = _choose_root_orientation(blocks[1], orient_options;\n                                           respect_physical_tags=respect_physical_tags,\n                                           physical_tag_edges=physical_tag_edges)\n    if root_orient !== (false, false, false)\n        fξ, fη, tr = root_orient\n        verbose && println(\"  autoreorient: root block :\$(blocks[1].id) orient=\$(root_orient)\")\n        blocks[1] = reorient_block(blocks[1]; flip_ξ=fξ, flip_η=fη, transpose=tr)\n        orient_state[1] = root_orient\n    end\n    visited = falses(n_blocks)\n    visited[1] = true\n    queue = [1]\n    while !isempty(queue)\n        a_idx = popfirst!(queue)\n        a_id = blocks[a_idx].id\n        for iface in mbm.interfaces\n            other = _other_endpoint(iface, a_id)\n            other === nothing && continue\n            b_id, b_edge_original = other\n            b_idx = get(mbm.block_by_id, b_id, 0)\n            b_idx == 0 && continue\n            visited[b_idx] && continue\n            a_edge_original = (iface.from[1] === a_id ? iface.from[2] : iface.to[2])\n            a_edge_current = _apply_orient_to_edge(a_edge_original, orient_state[a_idx])\n            best = nothing\n            for (fξ, fη, tr) in orient_options\n                candidate_b = reorient_block(blocks[b_idx];\n                                               flip_ξ=fξ, flip_η=fη, transpose=tr)\n                if respect_physical_tags &&\n                   !_physical_tags_aligned(candidate_b, physical_tag_edges)\n                    continue\n                end\n                b_edge_after = _apply_orient_to_edge(b_edge_original, (fξ, fη, tr))\n                ok = _is_canonical_pair(blocks[a_idx], a_edge_current,\n                                          candidate_b, b_edge_after)\n                if ok\n                    best = (candidate_b, (fξ, fη, tr), b_edge_after)\n                    verbose && println(\"  autoreorient: \$(b_id) orient=\$((fξ, fη, tr)) \" *\n                                        \"→ \$(a_id).\$a_edge_current ↔ \$(b_id).\$b_edge_after canonical\")\n                    break\n                end\n            end\n            best === nothing &&\n                error(\"autoreorient_blocks: no consistent orientation for block :\$b_id \" *\n                      \"relative to :\$a_id via interface \" *\n                      \"(\$a_id.\$a_edge_original ↔ \$b_id.\$b_edge_original). \" *\n                      \"Tried all 8 flips × transpose combinations.\")\n            blocks[b_idx] = best[1]\n            orient_state[b_idx] = best[2]\n            visited[b_idx] = true\n            push!(queue, b_idx)\n        end\n    end\n    any(.!visited) &&\n        @warn \"autoreorient_blocks: \$(sum(.!visited)) block(s) not reached by BFS\"\n    updated_ifaces = Interface[]\n    for iface in mbm.interfaces\n        from_id, from_edge = iface.from\n        to_id,   to_edge   = iface.to\n        from_idx = mbm.block_by_id[from_id]\n        to_idx   = mbm.block_by_id[to_id]\n        push!(updated_ifaces,\n              Interface(; from=(from_id, _apply_orient_to_edge(from_edge, orient_state[from_idx])),\n                          to=(to_id,   _apply_orient_to_edge(to_edge,   orient_state[to_idx]))))\n    end\n    return MultiBlockMesh2D(blocks; interfaces=updated_ifaces)\nend\n```"), (name = :transpose_multiblock, signature = Useful after `autoreorient_blocks`\nto move the outer boundary from north to east on O-grid topologies.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    transpose_multiblock(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D) -> MultiBlockMesh2D\n\nTranspose every block (swap ξ↔η) and update interface face labels\naccordingly (west↔south, east↔north). Useful after `autoreorient_blocks`\nto move the outer boundary from north to east on O-grid topologies.\n\"\"\"\nfunction transpose_multiblock(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D)\n    new_blocks = [reorient_block(b; transpose=true) for b in mbm.blocks]\n    new_ifaces = map(mbm.interfaces) do iface\n        f1 = (iface.from[1], _TRANSPOSE_FACE[iface.from[2]])\n        f2 = (iface.to[1],   _TRANSPOSE_FACE[iface.to[2]])\n        Interface(from=f1, to=f2)\n    end\n    return MultiBlockMesh2D(new_blocks; interfaces=new_ifaces)\nend\n```"), (name = :extend_mesh_2d, signature = "function extend_mesh_2d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh{T, AT};", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    extend_mesh_2d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh; n_ghost=1) -> CurvilinearMesh\n\nLinearly extrapolate `mesh.X, mesh.Y` by `n_ghost` rows/columns on all\nfour sides, returning a new `CurvilinearMesh` of size\n`(mesh.Nξ + 2n_ghost, mesh.Nη + 2n_ghost)` whose interior matches the\ninput.\n\nExtrapolation is piecewise-linear in the logical direction: the two\ninnermost interior nodes define the extrapolation slope, which is\nstepped outward by `Δξ` (resp. `Δη`) per ghost layer. For a uniform\nCartesian mesh this reproduces the natural uniform extension. For a\nstretched mesh the extension preserves the local cell spacing at the\nboundary — cells outside grow at the same rate as the last interior\ncell's spacing.\n\nThe metric (derivatives, Jacobian, `dx_ref`) is RECOMPUTED on the\nextended grid by refitting cubic B-splines. Because the extrapolation\nis purely linear the resulting metric remains well-defined, but the\nextrapolated cells may be slightly distorted compared to an\nanalytically-defined mesh — safe for ghost-layer use where the kernel\nwrites but the exchange overwrites before the next read.\n\nFor meshes whose boundary follows a circular arc (e.g. an O-grid ring\nblock around a cylinder), Cartesian linear extrapolation folds the\nJacobian near the arc corners because the chord through two adjacent\ninterior nodes does NOT track the arc curvature. Pass\n`curved_edges=(:south,)` (or any subset of `(:west, :east, :south,\n:north)`) with `curved_center=(cx, cy)` to compute the ghost for that\nedge via LINEAR EXTRAPOLATION IN POLAR COORDINATES `(r, θ)` relative\nto `curved_center`. This produces ghost cells that ride the arc\ninstead of its tangent chord.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    extend_mesh_2d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh; n_ghost=1) -> CurvilinearMesh\n\nLinearly extrapolate `mesh.X, mesh.Y` by `n_ghost` rows/columns on all\nfour sides, returning a new `CurvilinearMesh` of size\n`(mesh.Nξ + 2n_ghost, mesh.Nη + 2n_ghost)` whose interior matches the\ninput.\n\nExtrapolation is piecewise-linear in the logical direction: the two\ninnermost interior nodes define the extrapolation slope, which is\nstepped outward by `Δξ` (resp. `Δη`) per ghost layer. For a uniform\nCartesian mesh this reproduces the natural uniform extension. For a\nstretched mesh the extension preserves the local cell spacing at the\nboundary — cells outside grow at the same rate as the last interior\ncell's spacing.\n\nThe metric (derivatives, Jacobian, `dx_ref`) is RECOMPUTED on the\nextended grid by refitting cubic B-splines. Because the extrapolation\nis purely linear the resulting metric remains well-defined, but the\nextrapolated cells may be slightly distorted compared to an\nanalytically-defined mesh — safe for ghost-layer use where the kernel\nwrites but the exchange overwrites before the next read.\n\nFor meshes whose boundary follows a circular arc (e.g. an O-grid ring\nblock around a cylinder), Cartesian linear extrapolation folds the\nJacobian near the arc corners because the chord through two adjacent\ninterior nodes does NOT track the arc curvature. Pass\n`curved_edges=(:south,)` (or any subset of `(:west, :east, :south,\n:north)`) with `curved_center=(cx, cy)` to compute the ghost for that\nedge via LINEAR EXTRAPOLATION IN POLAR COORDINATES `(r, θ)` relative\nto `curved_center`. This produces ghost cells that ride the arc\ninstead of its tangent chord.\n\"\"\"\nfunction extend_mesh_2d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh{T, AT};\n                         n_ghost::Int=1,\n                         curved_edges::Tuple{Vararg{Symbol}}=(),\n                         curved_center::Tuple{<:Real,<:Real}=(0, 0)) where {T, AT}\n    n_ghost ≥ 0 || error(\"extend_mesh_2d: n_ghost must be ≥ 0\")\n    n_ghost == 0 && return mesh\n    Nξ, Nη = mesh.Nξ, mesh.Nη\n    Nξ_ext = Nξ + 2 * n_ghost\n    Nη_ext = Nη + 2 * n_ghost\n    X_ext = Matrix{T}(undef, Nξ_ext, Nη_ext)\n    Y_ext = similar(X_ext)\n    cx_c = T(curved_center[1]); cy_c = T(curved_center[2])\n\n    curved_w = :west in curved_edges\n    curved_e = :east in curved_edges\n    curved_s = :south in curved_edges\n    curved_n = :north in curved_edges\n\n    # Helper: linear extrapolate (x, y) by k steps past ref1 using\n    # (ref1 - ref2) displacement in POLAR coords about (cx_c, cy_c).\n    function _polar_extrap(x1, y1, x2, y2, k::Int)\n        r1 = sqrt((x1 - cx_c)^2 + (y1 - cy_c)^2)\n        r2 = sqrt((x2 - cx_c)^2 + (y2 - cy_c)^2)\n        θ1 = atan(y1 - cy_c, x1 - cx_c)\n        θ2 = atan(y2 - cy_c, x2 - cx_c)\n        Δθ = θ2 - θ1\n        Δθ > π  && (Δθ -= 2π)\n        Δθ < -π && (Δθ += 2π)\n        r_g = r1 - k * (r2 - r1)\n        θ_g = θ1 - k * Δθ\n        return (cx_c + r_g * cos(θ_g), cy_c + r_g * sin(θ_g))\n    end\n\n    # Pass 1: interior (copy) + west/east ghost rows (extrapolate in ξ).\n    @inbounds for j in 1:Nη\n        j_ext = j + n_ghost\n        # Interior\n        for i in 1:Nξ\n            i_ext = i + n_ghost\n            X_ext[i_ext, j_ext] = mesh.X[i, j]\n            Y_ext[i_ext, j_ext] = mesh.Y[i, j]\n        end\n        if curved_w\n            for k in 1:n_ghost\n                xg, yg = _polar_extrap(mesh.X[1, j], mesh.Y[1, j],\n                                         mesh.X[2, j], mesh.Y[2, j], k)\n                X_ext[n_ghost - k + 1, j_ext] = xg\n                Y_ext[n_ghost - k + 1, j_ext] = yg\n            end\n        else\n            dXw = mesh.X[2, j] - mesh.X[1, j]\n            dYw = mesh.Y[2, j] - mesh.Y[1, j]\n            for k in 1:n_ghost\n                X_ext[n_ghost - k + 1, j_ext] = mesh.X[1, j] - k * dXw\n                Y_ext[n_ghost - k + 1, j_ext] = mesh.Y[1, j] - k * dYw\n            end\n        end\n        if curved_e\n            for k in 1:n_ghost\n                xg, yg = _polar_extrap(mesh.X[Nξ, j], mesh.Y[Nξ, j],\n                                         mesh.X[Nξ - 1, j], mesh.Y[Nξ - 1, j], k)\n                X_ext[Nξ + n_ghost + k, j_ext] = xg\n                Y_ext[Nξ + n_ghost + k, j_ext] = yg\n            end\n        else\n            dXe = mesh.X[Nξ, j] - mesh.X[Nξ - 1, j]\n            dYe = mesh.Y[Nξ, j] - mesh.Y[Nξ - 1, j]\n            for k in 1:n_ghost\n                X_ext[Nξ + n_ghost + k, j_ext] = mesh.X[Nξ, j] + k * dXe\n                Y_ext[Nξ + n_ghost + k, j_ext] = mesh.Y[Nξ, j] + k * dYe\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    # Pass 2: south/north ghost rows (extrapolate in η over ALL\n    # columns, including the west/east ghosts filled by Pass 1).\n    @inbounds for i_ext in 1:Nξ_ext\n        j1 = n_ghost + 1\n        j2 = n_ghost + 2\n        if curved_s\n            for k in 1:n_ghost\n                xg, yg = _polar_extrap(X_ext[i_ext, j1], Y_ext[i_ext, j1],\n                                         X_ext[i_ext, j2], Y_ext[i_ext, j2], k)\n                X_ext[i_ext, n_ghost - k + 1] = xg\n                Y_ext[i_ext, n_ghost - k + 1] = yg\n            end\n        else\n            dXs = X_ext[i_ext, j2] - X_ext[i_ext, j1]\n            dYs = Y_ext[i_ext, j2] - Y_ext[i_ext, j1]\n            for k in 1:n_ghost\n                X_ext[i_ext, n_ghost - k + 1] = X_ext[i_ext, j1] - k * dXs\n                Y_ext[i_ext, n_ghost - k + 1] = Y_ext[i_ext, j1] - k * dYs\n            end\n        end\n        jN  = Nη + n_ghost\n        jNm = jN - 1\n        if curved_n\n            for k in 1:n_ghost\n                xg, yg = _polar_extrap(X_ext[i_ext, jN], Y_ext[i_ext, jN],\n                                         X_ext[i_ext, jNm], Y_ext[i_ext, jNm], k)\n                X_ext[i_ext, jN + k] = xg\n                Y_ext[i_ext, jN + k] = yg\n            end\n        else\n            dXn = X_ext[i_ext, jN] - X_ext[i_ext, jNm]\n            dYn = Y_ext[i_ext, jN] - Y_ext[i_ext, jNm]\n            for k in 1:n_ghost\n                X_ext[i_ext, jN + k] = X_ext[i_ext, jN] + k * dXn\n                Y_ext[i_ext, jN + k] = Y_ext[i_ext, jN] + k * dYn\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    # Note on dx_ref: the extended mesh's default dx_ref is the\n    # minimum physical edge across the FULL grid. On a stretched mesh\n    # with the smallest cell at the block edge, the extension adds\n    # cells of the same size → dx_ref unchanged. On a uniform mesh,\n    # dx_ref is identical to the original.\n    #\n    # skip_validate=true: the ghost-corner cells produced by the\n    # two-pass linear extrapolation can have ill-defined spline-fit\n    # Jacobians at the extended (1,1), (1,Nye), (Nxe,1), (Nxe,Nye)\n    # double-ghost corners — especially on curved-boundary blocks\n    # (O-grid ring blocks). These cells are not read by the SLBM\n    # kernel (the kernel only accesses physical interior + 1-ghost\n    # rows adjacent to it). Skipping validation avoids false positives.\n    # Preserve the original mesh's dx_ref: the extended mesh adds ghost-\n    # corner cells whose spline-fit edge lengths can collapse to ~1e-9\n    # (spurious cusps where ξ- and η-extrapolated ghost corners meet).\n    # `dx_ref` is used downstream to scale τ and drag norms, so a\n    # polluted dx_ref from a ghost corner would break the SLBM physics.\n    return CurvilinearMesh(X_ext, Y_ext;\n                             periodic_ξ=false, periodic_η=false,\n                             type=Symbol(string(mesh.type) * \"_ext\"),\n                             dx_ref=mesh.dx_ref,\n                             skip_validate=true,\n                             FT=T)\nend\n```"), (name = :build_block_slbm_geometry_extended, signature = "function build_block_slbm_geometry_extended(block::Block;", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    build_block_slbm_geometry_extended(block::Block; n_ghost=1,\n                                        local_cfl::Bool=true)\n        -> (mesh_ext::CurvilinearMesh, geom::SLBMGeometry)\n\nConvenience: build the extended mesh for a `Block` (via\n`extend_mesh_2d`) and its `SLBMGeometry`. The returned geometry has\nshape-compatible arrays so `slbm_trt_libb_step!` /\n`slbm_trt_libb_step_local_2d!` can run directly on the block's\nextended `(Nξ + 2Ng, Nη + 2Ng, 9)` state array.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    build_block_slbm_geometry_extended(block::Block; n_ghost=1,\n                                        local_cfl::Bool=true)\n        -> (mesh_ext::CurvilinearMesh, geom::SLBMGeometry)\n\nConvenience: build the extended mesh for a `Block` (via\n`extend_mesh_2d`) and its `SLBMGeometry`. The returned geometry has\nshape-compatible arrays so `slbm_trt_libb_step!` /\n`slbm_trt_libb_step_local_2d!` can run directly on the block's\nextended `(Nξ + 2Ng, Nη + 2Ng, 9)` state array.\n\"\"\"\nfunction build_block_slbm_geometry_extended(block::Block;\n                                              n_ghost::Int=1,\n                                              local_cfl::Bool=true,\n                                              curved_edges::Tuple{Vararg{Symbol}}=(),\n                                              curved_center::Tuple{<:Real,<:Real}=(0, 0),\n                                              dx_ref::Real=0)\n    mesh_ext = extend_mesh_2d(block.mesh; n_ghost=n_ghost,\n                                curved_edges=curved_edges,\n                                curved_center=curved_center)\n    geom = build_slbm_geometry(mesh_ext; local_cfl=local_cfl, dx_ref=dx_ref)\n    return mesh_ext, geom\nend\n```"), (name = :extend_interior_field_2d, signature = "function extend_interior_field_2d(field::AbstractArray{T, N},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    extend_interior_field_2d(field_interior::AbstractArray,\n                              n_ghost::Int; pad_value=zero(eltype(field_interior)))\n        -> AbstractArray\n\nCopy a `(Nξ, Nη)` or `(Nξ, Nη, 9)` interior field into the interior of\nan extended array of size `(Nξ + 2Ng, Nη + 2Ng)` or\n`(Nξ + 2Ng, Nη + 2Ng, 9)`. Nη_ext, Q)\n        out[(n_ghost + 1):(n_ghost + Nξ), (n_ghost + 1):(n_ghost + Nη), :] .= field\n        return out\n    else\n        error(\"extend_interior_field_2d: unsupported ndims \$N (expected cells = ConservativeTreeCell2D[]\n    children = NTuple{4,Int}[]\n    key_to_id = Dict{Tuple{Int,Int,Int},Int}()\n    for j in 1:Ny_i, i in 1:Nx_i\n        _push_conservative_tree_cell_2d!(\n            cells, children, key_to_id, 0, i, j, true, 0, Float64(coarse_volume))\n    end\n\n    refine_parent = Dict{String,String}()\n    refine_level = Dict{String,Int}()\n    refine_i_range =                                      parent=raw_block.parent)\n        haskey(refine_level, block.name) &&\n            throw(ArgumentError(\"duplicate refine block name '\$(block.name)'\"))\n\n        parent_name = block.parent\n        parent_level = _validate_conservative_tree_refine_parent_2d(\n            block, parent_name, refine_level, refine_i_range, refine_j_range)\n        _check_refine_block_domain_2d(block, Nx_i, Ny_i, parent_level)\n\n        for j in block.j_range, i in block.i_range\n            _refine_conservative_tree_parent_cell_2d!(\n                cells, children, key_to_id, parent_level, i, j,\n                Float64(coarse_volume))\n        end\n\n        child_level = parent_level + 1\n        refine_parent[block.name] = parent_name\n        refine_level[block.name] = child_level\n        refine_i_range[block.name] = _conservative_tree_child_range_2d(block.i_range)\n        refine_j_range[block.name] = j_ranges[nlevels] = target_j_range\n        for k in (nlevels - 1):-1:1\n            child_level = parent_level + k\n            child_nx = _conservative_tree_level_size_2d(Nx, child_level)\n = refine_j_range[parent]\n            first(i_ranges[1]) >= first(parent_i) &&\n                last(i_ranges[1]) <= last(parent_i) ||\n                throw(ArgumentError(\"Refine \$name is outside block_name == \"base\" &&\n                throw(ArgumentError(\"Refine name 'base' is reserved\"))\n            haskey(refine_level, block_name) &&\n                throw(ArgumentError(\"duplicate create_conservative_tree_route_table_2d(spec; periodic_x=false)\n\nBuild a static packet route table for every active leaf and D2Q9 population in\na nested conservative-tree spec. Routes are generated by leaf-equivalent\nsampling on the finest level of the tree, then mapped back to the active leaf\nthat owns each sample.\n\nUsing the global finest level is more expensive than local one-level sampling,\nbut it is the conservative-tree reference path: the active leaves form an exact\npartition at that level, which keeps closed rest states well-balanced through\nnested refinement.\n\nWhen `periodic_x=true`, sampled routes that leave the x-domain are wrapped\nbefore the active-leaf lookup. The y-domain remains physical and still\nproduces `ROUTE_BOUNDARY` routes for wall/open-boundary closures.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    create_conservative_tree_route_table_2d(spec; periodic_x=false)\n\nBuild a static packet route table for every active leaf and D2Q9 population in\na nested conservative-tree spec. Routes are generated by leaf-equivalent\nsampling on the finest level of the tree, then mapped back to the active leaf\nthat owns each sample.\n\nUsing the global finest level is more expensive than local one-level sampling,\nbut it is the conservative-tree reference path: the active leaves form an exact\npartition at that level, which keeps closed rest states well-balanced through\nnested refinement.\n\nWhen `periodic_x=true`, sampled routes that leave the x-domain are wrapped\nbefore the active-leaf lookup. The y-domain remains physical and still\nproduces `ROUTE_BOUNDARY` routes for wall/open-boundary closures.\n\"\"\"\nfunction create_conservative_tree_route_table_2d(spec::ConservativeTreeSpec2D;\n                                                 periodic_x::Bool=false)\n    links = ConservativeTreeLink2D[]\n    routes = ConservativeTreeRoute2D[]\n    same_level_links = Int[]\n    coarse_to_fine_links = Int[]\n    fine_to_coarse_links = Int[]\n    boundary_links = Int[]\n    direct_routes = Int[]\n    interface_routes = Int[]\n    boundary_routes = Int[]\n    link_hint = 9 * length(spec.active_cells)\n    sizehint!(links, link_hint)\n    sizehint!(same_level_links, link_hint)\n    sizehint!(direct_routes, link_hint)\n\n    dsts = Int[]\n    weights = Float64[]\n    kinds = RouteKind[]\n    sizehint!(dsts, 8)\n    sizehint!(weights, 8)\n    sizehint!(kinds, 8)\n\n    for src_id in spec.active_cells\n        for q in 1:9\n            _route_specs_for_active_cell_2d!(\n                dsts, weights, kinds, spec, src_id, q;\n                periodic_x=periodic_x)\n            _push_multilevel_link_routes_2d!(\n                links, routes, same_level_links, coarse_to_fine_links,\n                fine_to_coarse_links, boundary_links, direct_routes,\n                interface_routes, boundary_routes, src_id, q,\n                dsts, weights, kinds)\n        end\n    end\n\n    direct_ranges = _partition_route_ids_by_source_level_2d!(\n        direct_routes, spec, routes)\n    boundary_ranges = _partition_route_ids_by_source_level_2d!(\n        boundary_routes, spec, routes)\n    split_ranges, coalesce_ranges =\n        _partition_interface_route_ids_by_level_2d!(\n            interface_routes, spec, routes)\n\n    return ConservativeTreeRouteTable2D(\n        links, routes, same_level_links, coarse_to_fine_links,\n        fine_to_coarse_links, boundary_links, direct_routes, interface_routes,\n        boundary_routes, direct_ranges, boundary_ranges,\n        split_ranges, coalesce_ranges)\nend\n```"), (name = :coalesce_patch_to_shadow_F_2d!, signature = "function :active_momentum_F, signature = "function active_momentum_F(coarse_F::AbstractArray{<:Any,3},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    active_momentum_F(coarse_F, patch)\n\nMomentum of a composite fixed-tree state, _check_composite_coarse_layout(coarse_F, patch)\n\n    mx = zero(coarse_F[begin, begin, 1] + patch.fine_F[begin, begin, 1])\n    my = zero(coarse_F[begin, begin, 1] + patch.fine_F[begin, begin, 1])\n direct_routes = Int[]\n    interface_routes = Int[]\n    boundary_routes = Int[]\n\n    for route in topology.routes\n        src_block = logical_cell_to_block[route.src]\n        src_local = logical_cell_to_local[route.src]\n        src_block > 0 || throw(ArgumentError(\"route source is not an active packed cell\"))\n\n        if route.kind == ROUTE_BOUNDARY\n            dst_block = 0\n conservative_tree_indicator_patch_range_2d(\n        indicator::AbstractArray{<:Real,2};\n        threshold::Real,\n        pad::Int=1)\n    nx = size(indicator, 1)\n    ny = size(indicator, 2)\n    nx > 0 && ny > 0 || throw(ArgumentError(\"indicator must be nonempty\"))\n    isfinite(threshold) || throw(ArgumentError(\"threshold must be finite\"))\n    threshold >= 0 || throw(ArgumentError(\"threshold must be nonnegative\"))\n    pad >= 0 || throw(ArgumentError(\"pad must be nonnegative\"))\n\n    i_min_hit = typemax(Int)\n    i_max_hit = typemin(Int)\n    j_min_hit = typemax(Int)\n    j_max_hit = typemin(Int)\n    hit = false\n    @inbounds for j in axes(indicator, 2), i in axes(indicator, 1)\n        value = indicator[i, j]\n        isfinite(value) || throw(ArgumentError(\"indicator contains non-finite values\"))\n        if abs(value) > threshold\n            hit = true\n            i_min_hit = min(i_min_hit, i)\n            i_max_hit = max(i_max_hit, i)\n            j_min_hit = min(j_min_hit, j)\n            j_max_hit = max(j_max_hit, j)\n        end\n    end\n    hit || throw(ArgumentError(\"indicator has no cells above threshold\"))\n\n    i_min = max(1, i_min_hit - pad)\n    i_max = min(nx, i_max_hit + pad)\n    j_min = max(1, j_min_hit - pad)\n    j_max = min(ny, j_max_hit + pad)\n    return (i_range=i_min:i_max, argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.conservative_tree_gradient_indicator_2d)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    conservative_tree_gradient_indicator_2d(field::AbstractArray{<:Real,2})\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.conservative_tree_gradient_indicator_2d)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction conservative_tree_gradient_indicator_2d(field::AbstractArray{<:Real,2})\n    nx = size(field, 1)\n    ny = size(field, 2)\n    nx > 0 && ny > 0 || throw(ArgumentError(\"field must be nonempty\"))\n    T = promote_type(Float64, eltype(field))\n    indicator = zeros(T, nx, ny)\n\n    @inbounds for j in axes(field, 2), i in axes(field, 1)\n        isfinite(field[i, j]) || throw(ArgumentError(\"field contains non-finite values\"))\n        if nx == 1\n            dx = zero(T)\n        elseif i == first(axes(field, 1))\n            dx = T(field[i + 1, j] - field[i, j])\n        elseif i == last(axes(field, 1))\n            dx = T(field[i, j] - field[i - 1, j])\n        else\n            dx = T(field[i + 1, j] - field[i - 1, j]) / T(2)\n        end\n\n        if ny == 1\n            dy = zero(T)\n        elseif j == first(axes(field, 2))\n            dy = T(field[i, j + 1] - field[i, j])\n        elseif j == last(axes(field, 2))\n            dy = T(field[i, j] - field[i, j - 1])\n        else\n            dy = T(field[i, j + 1] - field[i, j - 1]) / T(2)\n        end\n        indicator[i, j] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)\n    end\n    return indicator\nend\n```"), (name =   current_j_range::AbstractUnitRange{<:Integer},\n        target_i_range::AbstractUnitRange{<:Integer},\n        target_j_range::AbstractUnitRange{<:Integer};\n        shrink_margin::Int=1)\n    isempty(current_i_range) && throw(ArgumentError(\"current_i_range must be nonempty\"))\n    isempty(current_j_range) && throw(ArgumentError(\"current_j_range must be nonempty\"))\n    isempty(target_i_range) && throw(ArgumentError(\"target_i_range must be nonempty\"))\n    isempty(target_j_range) && throw(ArgumentError(\"target_j_range must be nonempty\"))\n    shrink_margin >= 0 grows = first(target_i) < first(current_i) ||\n            last(target_i) > last(current_i) ||\n            first(target_j) < first(current_j) ||\n            last(target_j) > last(current_j)\n    if last(target_i) <= last(current_i) - shrink_margin\n    can_shrink_j = first(target_j) >= first(current_j) + shrink_margin &&\n                   last(target_j) <= last(current_j) - shrink_margin\n    if can_shrink_i && can_shrink_j\n        return (i_range=target_i, j_range=target_j)\n    end\n    return (i_range=current_i, j_range=current_j)\nend\n```"), (name = the domain, expanded to minimum patch\nsize, growth-limited per side, then passed through range hysteresis.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    conservative_tree_adaptation_plan_2d(Nx, Ny, current_i, current_j,\n                                         requested_i, requested_j; policy, reason)\n\nBuild a bounded adaptation plan for a single ratio-2 conservative-tree patch.\nThe requested range is padded, clamped to the domain, expanded to minimum patch\nsize, growth-limited per side, then passed through range hysteresis.\n\"\"\"\nfunction conservative_tree_adaptation_plan_2d(\n        Nx::Integer,\n        Ny::Integer,\n        current_i_range::AbstractUnitRange{<:Integer},\n        current_j_range::AbstractUnitRange{<:Integer},\n        requested_i_range::AbstractUnitRange{<:Integer},\n        requested_j_range::AbstractUnitRange{<:Integer};\n        policy::ConservativeTreeAdaptationPolicy2D=ConservativeTreeAdaptationPolicy2D(),\n        reason::Symbol=:manual)\n    nx = Int(Nx)\n    ny = Int(Ny)\n    _check_multipatch_domain_2d(nx, ny)\n    current_i = _normalize_parent_range_2d(current_i_range, \"current_i_range\")\n    current_j = _normalize_parent_range_2d(current_j_range, \"current_j_range\")\n    requested_i = _normalize_parent_range_2d(requested_i_range, \"requested_i_range\")\n    requested_j = _normalize_parent_range_2d(requested_j_range, \"requested_j_range\")\n    _check_range_inside_domain_2d(current_i, nx, \"current_i_range\")\n    _check_range_inside_domain_2d(current_j, ny, \"current_j_range\")\n\n    i_range = _pad_and_clamp_range_2d(requested_i, policy.pad_parent, nx)\n    j_range = _pad_and_clamp_range_2d(requested_j, policy.pad_parent, ny)\n    i_range = _expand_range_to_min_cells_2d(i_range, policy.min_i_cells, nx)\n    j_range = _expand_range_to_min_cells_2d(j_range, policy.min_j_cells, ny)\n    i_range = _limit_growth_range_2d(current_i, i_range, policy.max_growth)\n    j_range = _limit_growth_range_2d(current_j, j_range, policy.max_growth)\n\n    selected = conservative_tree_hysteresis_patch_range_2d(\n        current_i, current_j, i_range, j_range;\n        shrink_margin=policy.shrink_margin)\n    changed = selected.i_range != current_i || selected.j_range != current_j\n    return ConservativeTreeAdaptationPlan2D(\n        current_i, current_j, requested_i, requested_j,\n        selected.i_range, selected.j_range, reason, changed)\nend\n```"), (name = :conservative_tree_adaptation_plan_from_proposal_2d, signature = "function conservative_tree_patch_proposals_from_krk_2d(setup)\n\nConvert parsed `.krk` `Refine` blocks to named parent-grid patch proposals.\nThe same conservative-tree guardrails as the patch-set helper apply: D2Q9,\n2D base-grid `Refine`, and `ratio = 2`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction conservative_tree_patch_proposals_from_krk_2d(setup)\n    getproperty(setup, :lattice) == :D2Q9 ||\n conservative_tree_patch_ranges_from_krk_refines_2d(domain, refinements)\n    proposals = ConservativeTreePatchProposal2D[]\n    for (ref, range_pair) in zip(refinements, ranges)\n        push!(proposals, ConservativeTreePatchProposal2D(\n            range_pair[1], range_pair[2];\n            name=getproperty(ref, :name), reason=:krk_refine))\n    end\n    return proposals\nend\n```"), _check_composite_coarse_layout(coarse_F, patch)\n    patch.parent_i_range == plan.current_i_range &&\n        patch.parent_j_range == plan.current_j_range ||\n        throw(ArgumentError(\"plan = "\"\"\"\n    pack_conservative_tree_gpu_routes_2d(topology; cells_per_block=128, T=Float32)\n\nConvert a conservative-tree topology into primitive route arrays suitable for\nGPU transfer. Route destinations use packed-cell index `0` for boundaries.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    pack_conservative_tree_gpu_routes_2d(topology; cells_per_block=128, T=Float32)\n\nConvert a conservative-tree topology into primitive route arrays suitable for\nGPU transfer. Route destinations use packed-cell index `0` for boundaries.\n\"\"\"\nfunction pack_conservative_tree_gpu_routes_2d(\n        topology::ConservativeTreeTopology2D;\n        cells_per_block::Integer=128,\n        T::Type{<:Real}=Float32)\n    packed = pack_conservative_tree_topology_2d(topology;\n                                                cells_per_block=cells_per_block)\n    logical_to_packed = _logical_to_packed_index_2d(packed)\n\n    block_level = UInt8[UInt8(block.level) for block in packed.blocks]\n    block_first_cell = Int32[Int32(block.first_cell) for block in packed.blocks]\n    block_count = Int32[Int32(block.count) for block in packed.blocks]\n\n    cell_logical_id = Int32[Int32(id) for id in packed.packed_cell_ids]\n    cell_level = Vector{UInt8}(undef, length(packed.packed_cell_ids))\n    cell_i = Vector{Int32}(undef, length(packed.packed_cell_ids))\n    cell_j = Vector{Int32}(undef, length(packed.packed_cell_ids))\n    @inbounds for (packed_index, logical_id) in pairs(packed.packed_cell_ids)\n        cell = topology.cells[logical_id]\n        cell_level[packed_index] = UInt8(cell.level)\n        cell_i[packed_index] = Int32(cell.i)\n        cell_j[packed_index] = Int32(cell.j)\n    end\n\n    n_routes = length(topology.routes)\n    route_src = Vector{Int32}(undef, n_routes)\n    route_dst = Vector{Int32}(undef, n_routes)\n    route_q = Vector{UInt8}(undef, n_routes)\n    route_kind = Vector{UInt8}(undef, n_routes)\n    route_weight = Vector{T}(undef, n_routes)\n\n    @inbounds for (route_index, route) in pairs(topology.routes)\n        src = logical_to_packed[route.src]\n        src > 0 || throw(ArgumentError(\"route source is not packed\"))\n        route_src[route_index] = src\n        route_dst[route_index] =\n            route.kind == ROUTE_BOUNDARY ? Int32(0) : logical_to_packed[route.dst]\n        route_q[route_index] = UInt8(route.q)\n        route_kind[route_index] = UInt8(route.kind)\n        route_weight[route_index] = T(route.weight)\n    end\n\n    return ConservativeTreeGPURoutePack2D{T}(\n        Int32(packed.cells_per_block),\n        block_level, block_first_cell, block_count,\n        cell_logical_id, cell_level, cell_i, cell_j,\n        route_src, route_dst, route_q, route_kind, route_weight,\n        Int32.(packed.direct_routes),\n        Int32.(packed.interface_routes),\n        Int32.(packed.boundary_routes))\nend\n```"), (name = :conservative_tree_gpu_route_weight_sums_2d, signature = "function conservative_tree_gpu_route_weight_sums_2d(", docstring = "\"\"\"\n pack.route_q[route_index])\n        sums[key] = get(sums, key, zero(T)) + pack.route_weight[route_index]\n    end\n    return sums\nend\n```"), (name = :ConservativeTreeAdaptiveRun2D, signature = "function composite_leaf_mean_ux_profile(coarse_F::AbstractArray{T,3},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    composite_leaf_mean_ux_profile(coarse_F::AbstractArray{T,3},\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.composite_leaf_mean_ux_profile)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction composite_leaf_mean_ux_profile(coarse_F::AbstractArray{T,3},\n                                        patch::ConservativeTreePatch2D{T};\n                                        volume_leaf::T=T(0.25),\n                                        force_x::T=zero(T)) where T\n    leaf = zeros(T, 2 * size(coarse_F, 1), 2 * size(coarse_F, 2), 9)\n    composite_to_leaf_F_2d!(leaf, coarse_F, patch)\n\n    profile = zeros(T, size(leaf, 2))\n    @inbounds for j in axes(leaf, 2)\n        ux_sum = zero(T)\n        for i in axes(leaf, 1)\n            cell = @view leaf[i, j, :]\n            rho = mass_F(cell) / volume_leaf\n            ux_sum += (momentum_F(cell)[1] / volume_leaf + force_x / 2) / rho\n        end\n        profile[j] = ux_sum / T(size(leaf, 1))\n    end\n    return profile\nend\n```"), (name = :composite_leaf_velocity_field_2d, signature = "function composite_leaf_velocity_field_2d(coarse_F::AbstractArray{T,3},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    composite_leaf_velocity_field_2d(coarse_F::AbstractArray{T,3},\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.composite_leaf_velocity_field_2d)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction composite_leaf_velocity_field_2d(coarse_F::AbstractArray{T,3},\n                                          patch::ConservativeTreePatch2D{T};\n                                          volume_leaf::T=T(0.25),\n                                          force_x::T=zero(T),\n                                          force_y::T=zero(T)) where T\n    leaf = zeros(T, 2 * size(coarse_F, 1), 2 * size(coarse_F, 2), 9)\n    composite_to_leaf_F_2d!(leaf, coarse_F, patch)\n\n    ux = zeros(T, size(leaf, 1), size(leaf, 2))\n    uy = similar(ux)\n    @inbounds for j in axes(leaf, 2), i in axes(leaf, 1)\n        cell = @view leaf[i, j, :]\n        rho = mass_F(cell) / volume_leaf\n        rho > zero(T) || throw(ArgumentError(\"leaf cell density must be positive\"))\n        mx, my = momentum_F(cell)\n        ux[i, j] = (mx / volume_leaf + force_x / 2) / rho\n        uy[i, j] = (my / volume_leaf + force_y / 2) / rho\n    end\n    return (ux=ux, uy=uy)\nend\n```"), (name = :couette_analytic_profile_2d, signature = "function couette_analytic_profile_2d(ny::Int, U)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.couette_analytic_profile_2d)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction couette_analytic_profile_2d(ny::Int, U)\n    ny >= 2 || throw(ArgumentError(\"ny must be >= 2\"))\n    T = typeof(float(U))\n    return [T(U) * T(j - 1) / T(ny - 1) for j in 1:ny]\nend\n```"), (name = :poiseuille_analytic_profile_2d, signature = "function poiseuille_analytic_profile_2d(ny::Int, Fx, omega; rho=1)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    poiseuille_analytic_profile_2d(ny::Int, Fx, omega; rho=1)\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.poiseuille_analytic_profile_2d)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    poiseuille_analytic_profile_2d(ny::Int, Fx, omega; rho=1)\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.poiseuille_analytic_profile_2d)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction poiseuille_analytic_profile_2d(ny::Int, Fx, omega; rho=1)\n    ny >= 2 || throw(ArgumentError(\"ny must be >= 2\"))\n    T = promote_type(typeof(float(Fx)), typeof(float(omega)), typeof(float(rho)))\n    nu = (one(T) / T(omega) - T(0.5)) / T(3)\n    H = T(ny)\n    return [\n        T(Fx) / (T(2) * T(rho) * nu) *\n        (T(j) - T(0.5)) * (H + T(0.5) - T(j))\n        for j in 1:ny\n    ]\nend\n```"), (name = :validate_conservative_tree_route_native_phase_p_2d, Nx=size(couette_route.coarse_F, 1),\n        Ny=size(couette_route.coarse_F, 2),\n        patch_i_range=couette_route.patch.parent_i_range,\n        patch_j_range=couette_route.patch.parent_j_range,\n The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.initialize_conservative_tree_equilibrium_F_2d!)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction initialize_conservative_tree_equilibrium_F_2d!(\n        F::AbstractMatrix,\n        spec::ConservativeTreeSpec2D;\n        rho=1,\n        ux=0,\n        uy=0)\n    _check_conservative_tree_F_2d(F, spec)\n    fill!(F, zero(eltype(F)))\n    T = promote_type(eltype(F), typeof(float(rho)), typeof(float(ux)),\n                     typeof(float(uy)))\n    @inbounds for cell_id in spec.active_cells\n        volume = T(spec.cells[cell_id].metrics.volume)\n        for q in 1:9\n            F[cell_id, q] = volume * equilibrium(\n                D2Q9(), T(rho), T(ux), T(uy), q)\n        end\n    end\n    return F\nend\n```"), (name = :conservative_tree_leaf_mean_ux_profile_2d, signature = "function conservative_tree_leaf_mean_ux_profile_2d(", docstring = "\"\"\"\n backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.conservative_tree_leaf_mean_ux_profile_2d)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    conservative_tree_leaf_mean_ux_profile_2d(\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.conservative_tree_leaf_mean_ux_profile_2d)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction conservative_tree_leaf_mean_ux_profile_2d(\n        F::AbstractMatrix,\n        spec::ConservativeTreeSpec2D;\n        force_x=0,\n        level_scaled_force::Bool=false)\n    _check_conservative_tree_F_2d(F, spec)\n    leaf_ny = _conservative_tree_level_size_2d(spec.Ny, spec.max_level)\n    row_mass = zeros(eltype(F), leaf_ny)\n    row_ux_mass = zeros(eltype(F), leaf_ny)\n\n    @inbounds for cell_id in spec.active_cells\n        cell = spec.cells[cell_id]\n        scale = 1 << (spec.max_level - cell.level)\n        mass = zero(eltype(F))\n        mx = zero(eltype(F))\n        for q in 1:9\n            Fq = F[cell_id, q]\n            mass += Fq\n            mx += d2q9_cx(q) * Fq\n        end\n        volume = eltype(F)(cell.metrics.volume)\n        rho = mass / volume\n        fx = level_scaled_force ?\n             conservative_tree_leaf_equivalent_force_2d(force_x, spec,\n                                                        cell.level) :\n             force_x\n        ux = (mx / volume + fx / 2) / rho\n        row_packet = mass / scale\n        for sj in 1:scale\n            jf = (cell.j - 1) * scale + sj\n            row_mass[jf] += row_packet\n            row_ux_mass[jf] += row_packet * ux\n        end\n    end\n\n    profile = similar(row_ux_mass)\n    @inbounds for j in eachindex(profile)\n        profile[j] = row_ux_mass[j] / row_mass[j]\n    end\n    return profile\nend\n```"), (name = below.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nKraken.RefinementPatch3D\n```\n\"\"\"\nstruct RefinementPatch3D{T}\n    name::String\n    level::Int\n    ratio::Int\n    Nx::Int; Ny::Int; Nz::Int               # Total dimensions (including ghosts)\n    Nx_inner::Int; Ny_inner::Int; Nz_inner::Int  # Inner dimensions (no ghosts)\n    dx::T\n    x_min::T; y_min::T; z_min::T\n    x_max::T; y_max::T; z_max::T\n    parent_i_range::UnitRange{Int}\n    parent_j_range::UnitRange{Int}\n    parent_k_range::UnitRange{Int}\n    n_ghost::Int                              # Ghost width (2 for D3Q19)\n    f_in::AbstractArray{T, 4}                 # [Nx, Ny, Nz, 19]\n    f_out::AbstractArray{T, 4}\n    rho::AbstractArray{T, 3}\n    ux::AbstractArray{T, 3}\n    uy::AbstractArray{T, 3}\n patches::Vector{RefinementPatch3D{T}}\nend\n```"), (name = :create_patch_3d, signature = "function create_patch_3d(name::String, level::Int, ratio::Int,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    create_patch_3d(name::String, level::Int, ratio::Int,\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.create_patch_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    create_patch_3d(name::String, level::Int, ratio::Int,\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.create_patch_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction create_patch_3d(name::String, level::Int, ratio::Int,\n                          region::NTuple{6, Float64},  # (x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1)\n                          parent_Nx::Int, parent_Ny::Int, parent_Nz::Int,\n                          parent_dx::Float64, parent_omega::Float64,\n                          ::Type{T}; backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU()) where T\n    x_min, y_min, z_min, x_max, y_max, z_max = region\n    n_ghost = 2  # Same as 2D\n\n    # Map physical region to parent cell indices\n    i_start = max(1, floor(Int, x_min / parent_dx) + 1)\n    j_start = max(1, floor(Int, y_min / parent_dx) + 1)\n    k_start = max(1, floor(Int, z_min / parent_dx) + 1)\n    i_end = min(parent_Nx, ceil(Int, x_max / parent_dx))\n    j_end = min(parent_Ny, ceil(Int, y_max / parent_dx))\n    k_end = min(parent_Nz, ceil(Int, z_max / parent_dx))\n\n    parent_i_range = i_start:i_end\n    parent_j_range = j_start:j_end\n    parent_k_range = k_start:k_end\n\n    Nx_inner = (i_end - i_start + 1) * ratio\n    Ny_inner = (j_end - j_start + 1) * ratio\n    Nz_inner = (k_end - k_start + 1) * ratio\n    Nx = Nx_inner + 2 * n_ghost\n    Ny = Ny_inner + 2 * n_ghost\n    Nz = Nz_inner + 2 * n_ghost\n\n    dx_fine = parent_dx / ratio\n    omega_fine = T(rescaled_omega(parent_omega, ratio))\n\n    # Snapped physical extent\n    x_min_snap = (i_start - 1) * parent_dx\n    y_min_snap = (j_start - 1) * parent_dx\n    z_min_snap = (k_start - 1) * parent_dx\n    x_max_snap = i_end * parent_dx\n    y_max_snap = j_end * parent_dx\n    z_max_snap = k_end * parent_dx\n\n    # Allocate arrays\n    f_in  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    f_out = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    rho   = KernelAbstractions.ones(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    ux    = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    uy    = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    uz    = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    is_solid = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, Bool, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n\n    # Initialize f to equilibrium (ρ=1, u=0)\n    w = weights(D3Q19())\n    f_cpu = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    for q in 1:19\n        f_cpu[:, :, :, q] .= T(w[q])\n    end\n    copyto!(f_in, f_cpu)\n    copyto!(f_out, f_cpu)\n\n    # Temporal buffers (+1 margin on each side for trilinear stencil)\n    n_pi = length(parent_i_range) + 2\n    n_pj = length(parent_j_range) + 2\n    n_pk = length(parent_k_range) + 2\n    rho_prev = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, n_pi, n_pj, n_pk)\n    ux_prev  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, n_pi, n_pj, n_pk)\n    uy_prev  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, n_pi, n_pj, n_pk)\n    uz_prev  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, n_pi, n_pj, n_pk)\n    f_prev   = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, n_pi, n_pj, n_pk, 19)\n\n    return RefinementPatch3D{T}(\n        name, level, ratio, Nx, Ny, Nz, Nx_inner, Ny_inner, Nz_inner,\n        T(dx_fine),\n        T(x_min_snap), T(y_min_snap), T(z_min_snap),\n        T(x_max_snap), T(y_max_snap), T(z_max_snap),\n        parent_i_range, parent_j_range, parent_k_range,\n        n_ghost, f_in, f_out, rho, ux, uy, uz, is_solid, omega_fine,\n        rho_prev, ux_prev, uy_prev, uz_prev, f_prev)\nend\n```"), (name = :create_refined_domain_3d, signature = "function create_refined_domain_3d(Nx, Ny, Nz, dx, omega, patches)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    create_refined_domain_3d(Nx, Ny, Nz, dx, omega, patches)\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.create_refined_domain_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    create_refined_domain_3d(Nx, Ny, Nz, dx, expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.create_refined_domain_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction create_refined_domain_3d(Nx, Ny, Nz, dx, omega, patches)\n    T = isempty(patches) ? Float64 : eltype(patches[1].dx)\n    return RefinedDomain3D{T}(Nx, Ny, Nz, Float64(dx), Float64(omega), patches)\nend\n```"), (name = :advance_refined_step_3d!, signature = "function advance_refined_step_3d!(domain::RefinedDomain3D{T},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    advance_refined_step_3d!(domain::RefinedDomain3D{T},\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations. The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.advance_refined_step_3d!)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    advance_refined_step_3d!(domain::RefinedDomain3D{T},\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations. The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.advance_refined_step_3d!)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction advance_refined_step_3d!(domain::RefinedDomain3D{T},\n                                    f_in, f_out, rho, ux, uy, uz, is_solid;\n                                    stream_fn, collide_fn, macro_fn,\n                                    bc_base_fn=nothing,\n                                    bc_patch_fns=nothing,\n                                    bc_coarse_fn=nothing,\n                                    patch_collide_fns=nothing) where T\n    Nx = domain.base_Nx; Ny = domain.base_Ny; Nz = domain.base_Nz\n\n    # 1. Save coarse state at time n\n    for patch in domain.patches\n        save_coarse_state_3d!(patch, f_in, rho, ux, uy, uz)\n    end\n\n    # 2. Advance coarse grid one step\n    stream_fn(f_out, f_in, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    bc_base_fn !== nothing && bc_base_fn(f_out)\n    collide_fn(f_out, is_solid)\n    macro_fn(rho, ux, uy, uz, f_out)\n    f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n\n    # 3. Sub-cycle each patch\n    for (pidx, patch) in enumerate(domain.patches)\n        ratio = patch.ratio\n        coll_fn = patch_collide_fns !== nothing ?\n            get(patch_collide_fns, pidx, nothing) : nothing\n\n        for sub_step in 1:ratio\n            t_frac = T((sub_step - 1) / ratio)\n\n            fill_ghost_temporal_3d!(patch, f_in, rho, ux, uy, uz,\n                                    domain.base_omega, Nx, Ny, Nz, t_frac)\n\n            stream_3d!(patch.f_out, patch.f_in, patch.Nx, patch.Ny, patch.Nz)\n\n            if bc_patch_fns !== nothing\n                bc_fn = get(bc_patch_fns, pidx, nothing)\n                bc_fn !== nothing && bc_fn(patch.f_out, patch.Nx, patch.Ny, patch.Nz)\n            end\n\n            if coll_fn !== nothing\n                coll_fn(patch.f_out, patch.is_solid)\n            else\n                collide_3d!(patch.f_out, patch.is_solid, patch.omega)\n            end\n            compute_macroscopic_3d!(patch.rho, patch.ux, patch.uy, patch.uz, patch.f_out)\n\n            copyto!(patch.f_in, patch.f_out)\n        end\n    end\n\n    # 4. Restrict fine → coarse\n    for patch in domain.patches\n        restrict_to_coarse_3d!(patch, f_in, rho, ux, uy, uz, domain.base_omega)\n    end\n\n    # 5. Re-apply coarse BCs (restriction may overwrite wall cells)\n    if bc_coarse_fn !== nothing\n        bc_coarse_fn(f_in, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    end\n    compute_macroscopic_3d!(rho, ux, uy, uz, f_in)\n\n    return f_in, f_out\nend\n```"), (name = :prolongate_f_rescaled_3d!, signature = "function prolongate_f_rescaled_3d!(f_fine, f_coarse, rho_c, ux_c, uy_c, uz_c,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    prolongate_f_rescaled_3d!(f_fine, f_coarse, rho_c, ux_c, uy_c, uz_c,\n\nPublic function in the kernel-level LBM operation.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.
