The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.restrict_f_rescaled_3d!)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction restrict_f_rescaled_3d!(f_coarse, rho_c, ux_c, uy_c, uz_c,\n                                  f_fine, rho_f, ux_f, uy_f, uz_f,\n                                  ratio, n_ghost, i_c_start, j_c_start, k_c_start,\n                                  Nx_overlap, Ny_overlap, Nz_overlap,\n                                  omega_c, omega_f)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_coarse)\n    kernel! = restrict_f_rescaled_3d_kernel!(backend)\n    FT = eltype(f_coarse)\n    kernel!(f_coarse, rho_c, ux_c, uy_c, uz_c,\n            f_fine, rho_f, ux_f, uy_f, uz_f,\n            ratio, n_ghost, i_c_start, j_c_start, k_c_start,\n            FT(omega_c), FT(omega_f);\n            ndrange=(Nx_overlap, Ny_overlap, Nz_overlap))\nend\n```"), (name = :ThermalPatchArrays3D, signature = "struct ThermalPatchArrays3D{T}", docstring = "", source_excerpt = "```julia\nstruct ThermalPatchArrays3D{T}\n    g_in::AbstractArray{T, 4}       # [Nx, Ny, Nz, 19]\n    g_out::AbstractArray{T, 4}\n    Temp::AbstractArray{T, 3}\n    omega_T::T\n    # Temporal interpolation buffers (parent overlap + 1-cell margin)\n    Temp_prev::AbstractArray{T, 3}\n    g_prev::AbstractArray{T, 4}\nend\n```"), (name = :create_thermal_patch_arrays_3d, signature = "function create_thermal_patch_arrays_3d(patch::RefinementPatch3D{T},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    create_thermal_patch_arrays_3d(patch::RefinementPatch3D{T},\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.create_thermal_patch_arrays_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    create_thermal_patch_arrays_3d(patch::RefinementPatch3D{T},\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.create_thermal_patch_arrays_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction create_thermal_patch_arrays_3d(patch::RefinementPatch3D{T},\n                                         omega_T_parent::Real;\n                                         T_init::Real=0.5,\n                                         backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU()) where T\n    Nx, Ny, Nz = patch.Nx, patch.Ny, patch.Nz\n\n    omega_T_fine = T(rescaled_omega(omega_T_parent, patch.ratio))\n\n    g_in  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    g_out = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    Temp  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n\n    # Initialize g to equilibrium at T_init (g_eq = w_q * T for u=0)\n    w = weights(D3Q19())\n    g_cpu = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    for q in 1:19\n        g_cpu[:, :, :, q] .= T(w[q]) * T(T_init)\n    end\n    copyto!(g_in, g_cpu)\n    copyto!(g_out, g_cpu)\n\n    # Temporal buffers (same parent-region size as flow patch)\n    n_pi = size(patch.rho_prev, 1)\n    n_pj = size(patch.rho_prev, 2)\n    n_pk = size(patch.rho_prev, 3)\n    Temp_prev = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, n_pi, n_pj, n_pk)\n    g_prev    = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, n_pi, n_pj, n_pk, 19)\n\n    return ThermalPatchArrays3D{T}(g_in, g_out, Temp, omega_T_fine,\n                                    Temp_prev, g_prev)\nend\n```"), (name = :advance_thermal_refined_step_3d!, signature = "function advance_thermal_refined_step_3d!(domain::RefinedDomain3D{T},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    advance_thermal_refined_step_3d!(domain::RefinedDomain3D{T},\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations. The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.advance_thermal_refined_step_3d!)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    advance_thermal_refined_step_3d!(domain::RefinedDomain3D{T},\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations. The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.advance_thermal_refined_step_3d!)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction advance_thermal_refined_step_3d!(domain::RefinedDomain3D{T},\n                                            thermals::Vector{ThermalPatchArrays3D{T}},\n                                            f_in, f_out, g_in, g_out,\n                                            rho, ux, uy, uz, Temp, is_solid;\n                                            fused_step_fn,\n                                            omega_T_coarse::Real,\n                                            β_g::Real=zero(T),\n                                            T_ref_buoy::Real=zero(T),\n                                            bc_thermal_patch_fns=nothing,\n                                            bc_flow_patch_fns=nothing,\n                                            bc_coarse_fn=nothing) where T\n    Nx = domain.base_Nx; Ny = domain.base_Ny; Nz = domain.base_Nz\n\n    # 1. Save coarse state at time n (flow + thermal)\n    for (pidx, patch) in enumerate(domain.patches)\n        save_coarse_state_3d!(patch, f_in, rho, ux, uy, uz)\n        save_thermal_coarse_state_3d!(patch, thermals[pidx], g_in, Temp)\n    end\n\n    # 2. Advance coarse grid one step (fused kernel)\n    fused_step_fn(f_out, f_in, g_out, g_in, Temp, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n    g_in, g_out = g_out, g_in\n\n    # Restore patch-covered cells from saved state\n    for (pidx, patch) in enumerate(domain.patches)\n        _restore_coarse_overlap_3d!(f_in, g_in, patch, thermals[pidx])\n    end\n\n    # Recover macroscopic on coarse for ghost fill\n    compute_macroscopic_3d!(rho, ux, uy, uz, f_in)\n    compute_temperature_3d!(Temp, g_in)\n\n    # 3. Sub-cycle each patch\n    for (pidx, patch) in enumerate(domain.patches)\n        thermal = thermals[pidx]\n        ratio = patch.ratio\n\n        for sub_step in 1:ratio\n            t_frac = T((sub_step - 1) / ratio)\n\n            # Flow ghost fill: temporal interpolation with FH rescaling\n            fill_ghost_temporal_3d!(patch, f_in, rho, ux, uy, uz,\n                                    domain.base_omega, Nx, Ny, Nz, t_frac)\n            # Thermal ghost fill: trilinear temporal (no FH)\n            fill_thermal_ghost_3d!(patch, thermal, g_in, Nx, Ny, Nz;\n                                    t_frac=t_frac)\n\n            # Stream both f and g on patch\n            stream_3d!(patch.f_out, patch.f_in, patch.Nx, patch.Ny, patch.Nz)\n            stream_3d!(thermal.g_out, thermal.g_in, patch.Nx, patch.Ny, patch.Nz)\n\n            # Flow BCs on patch\n            if bc_flow_patch_fns !== nothing\n                bc_f_fn = get(bc_flow_patch_fns, pidx, nothing)\n                if bc_f_fn !== nothing\n                    bc_f_fn(patch.f_out, patch.Nx, patch.Ny, patch.Nz)\n                end\n            end\n\n            # Thermal BCs on patch\n            if bc_thermal_patch_fns !== nothing\n                bc_fn = get(bc_thermal_patch_fns, pidx, nothing)\n                if bc_fn !== nothing\n                    bc_fn(thermal.g_out, patch.Nx, patch.Ny, patch.Nz)\n                end\n            end\n\n            # Recover temperature and macroscopic flow\n            compute_temperature_3d!(thermal.Temp, thermal.g_out)\n            compute_macroscopic_3d!(patch.rho, patch.ux, patch.uy, patch.uz, patch.f_out)\n\n            # Collide thermal (BGK on g)\n            collide_thermal_3d!(thermal.g_out, patch.ux, patch.uy, patch.uz, thermal.omega_T)\n            # Collide flow with Boussinesq (acoustic scaling: β_g / ratio)\n            collide_boussinesq_3d!(patch.f_out, thermal.Temp, patch.is_solid,\n                                    patch.omega, T(β_g) / T(patch.ratio),\n                                    T(T_ref_buoy))\n\n            # Swap for next sub-step\n            copyto!(patch.f_in, patch.f_out)\n            copyto!(thermal.g_in, thermal.g_out)\n        end\n    end\n\n    # 4. Restrict fine results back to coarse\n    for (pidx, patch) in enumerate(domain.patches)\n        thermal = thermals[pidx]\n        restrict_to_coarse_3d!(patch, f_in, rho, ux, uy, uz, domain.base_omega)\n        restrict_thermal_to_coarse_3d!(patch, thermal, g_in, Temp)\n    end\n\n    # 5. Re-apply coarse BCs (restriction may overwrite wall values)\n    if bc_coarse_fn !== nothing\n        bc_coarse_fn(f_in, g_in, Temp, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    end\n    compute_macroscopic_3d!(rho, ux, uy, uz, f_in)\n    compute_temperature_3d!(Temp, g_in)\n\n    return f_in, f_out, g_in, g_out\nend\n```"), (name = :build_patch_thermal_bcs_3d, signature = "function build_patch_thermal_bcs_3d(patches::Vector{RefinementPatch3D{T}},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    build_patch_thermal_bcs_3d(patches, Lx, Ly, Lz, Nx, temp_bcs)\n\nBuild BC closures for 3D patch faces that touch domain walls with Dirichlet\ntemperature BCs. `temp_bcs` is a Dict mapping face symbols to wall temperatures,\ne.g. `Dict(:west => 1.0, :east => 0.0)`.\n\nReturns Dict{Int, Function} mapping patch index → BC closure `(g, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p) -> ...`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    build_patch_thermal_bcs_3d(patches, Lx, Ly, Lz, Nx, temp_bcs)\n\nBuild BC closures for 3D patch faces that touch domain walls with Dirichlet\ntemperature BCs. `temp_bcs` is a Dict mapping face symbols to wall temperatures,\ne.g. `Dict(:west => 1.0, :east => 0.0)`.\n\nReturns Dict{Int, Function} mapping patch index → BC closure `(g, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p) -> ...`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction build_patch_thermal_bcs_3d(patches::Vector{RefinementPatch3D{T}},\n                                     Lx, Ly, Lz, Nx,\n                                     temp_bcs::Dict{Symbol, <:Real}) where T\n    tol = Lx / Nx * 0.01\n\n    # Map face symbol to apply function — each BC has a different signature:\n    #   west:   (g, T_wall, Ny, Nz)        east:   (g, T_wall, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    #   south:  (g, T_wall, Nx, Nz)        north:  (g, T_wall, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    #   bottom: (g, T_wall, Nx, Ny)        top:    (g, T_wall, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    face_fns = Dict{Symbol, Function}(\n        :west   => (g, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p, Tw) -> apply_fixed_temp_west_3d!(g, Tw, Ny_p, Nz_p),\n        :east   => (g, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p, Tw) -> apply_fixed_temp_east_3d!(g, Tw, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p),\n        :south  => (g, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p, Tw) -> apply_fixed_temp_south_3d!(g, Tw, Nx_p, Nz_p),\n        :north  => (g, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p, Tw) -> apply_fixed_temp_north_3d!(g, Tw, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p),\n        :bottom => (g, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p, Tw) -> apply_fixed_temp_bottom_3d!(g, Tw, Nx_p, Ny_p),\n        :top    => (g, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p, Tw) -> apply_fixed_temp_top_3d!(g, Tw, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p),\n    )\n\n    face_checks = [\n        (:west,   p -> Float64(p.x_min) <= tol),\n        (:east,   p -> Float64(p.x_max) >= Lx - tol),\n        (:south,  p -> Float64(p.y_min) <= tol),\n        (:north,  p -> Float64(p.y_max) >= Ly - tol),\n        (:bottom, p -> Float64(p.z_min) <= tol),\n        (:top,    p -> Float64(p.z_max) >= Lz - tol),\n    ]\n\n    patch_bcs = Dict{Int, Function}()\n    for (pidx, patch) in enumerate(patches)\n        closures = Function[]\n\n        for (face, check_fn) in face_checks\n            check_fn(patch) || continue\n            haskey(temp_bcs, face) || continue\n            let f_sym = face, Tw = T(temp_bcs[face]), fn = face_fns[face]\n                push!(closures, (g, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p) -> fn(g, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p, Tw))\n            end\n        end\n\n        if !isempty(closures)\n            let cls = closures\n                patch_bcs[pidx] = (g, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p) -> begin\n                    for cl in cls\n                        cl(g, Nx_p, Ny_p, Nz_p)\n                    end\n                end\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    return patch_bcs\nend\n```"), (name = :fill_thermal_full_3d!, signature = "function fill_thermal_full_3d!(patch::RefinementPatch3D{T},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n :precompute_q_wall_from_stl_2d, signature = "function precompute_q_wall_from_stl_2d(mesh::STLMesh{T},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_from_stl_2d(mesh, Nx, Ny, dx, dy;\n                                   z_slice=0.0, FT=Float64,\n                                   sub_cell=true)\n        -> (q_wall, is_solid)\n\nVoxelise `mesh` at z = z_slice and compute the LI-BB cut-fraction\nfield. Each fluid cell whose link q points into the solid mask gets\n`q_wall[i,j,q] = q_w` where:\n\n- `sub_cell = true`: `q_w` is the distance (in units of the link\n  length) from the fluid node to the first intersection with the STL\n  slice segments. Gives Bouzidi sub-cell precision.\n- `sub_cell = false`: `q_w = 0.5` (halfway-BB default).\n\nReturns a `(Nx, Ny, 9)` cut-fraction array + a `(Nx, Ny)` bool mask.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_from_stl_2d(mesh, Nx, Ny, dx, dy;\n                                   z_slice=0.0, FT=Float64,\n                                   sub_cell=true)\n        -> (q_wall, is_solid)\n\nVoxelise `mesh` at z = z_slice and compute the LI-BB cut-fraction\nfield. Each fluid cell whose link q points into the solid mask gets\n`q_wall[i,j,q] = q_w` where:\n\n- `sub_cell = true`: `q_w` is the distance (in units of the link\n  length) from the fluid node to the first intersection with the STL\n  slice segments. Gives Bouzidi sub-cell precision.\n- `sub_cell = false`: `q_w = 0.5` (halfway-BB default).\n\nReturns a `(Nx, Ny, 9)` cut-fraction array + a `(Nx, Ny)` bool mask.\n\"\"\"\nfunction precompute_q_wall_from_stl_2d(mesh::STLMesh{T},\n                                        Nx::Int, Ny::Int,\n                                        dx::Real, dy::Real;\n                                        z_slice::Real=0.0,\n                                        FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64,\n                                        sub_cell::Bool=true) where {T}\n    is_solid = voxelize_2d(mesh, Nx, Ny, dx, dy; z_slice=z_slice)\n    q_wall = zeros(FT, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    cxs = velocities_x(D2Q9())\n    cys = velocities_y(D2Q9())\n    half = FT(0.5)\n\n    # Slice once for sub-cell queries.\n    segments = sub_cell ? _slice_mesh_z(mesh, T(z_slice)) : nothing\n\n    @inbounds for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        is_solid[i, j] && continue\n        # Fluid node position in the same coords as the voxelizer:\n        # cell center at ((i - 0.5)*dx, (j - 0.5)*dy).\n        xf = FT((i - 0.5) * dx)\n        yf = FT((j - 0.5) * dy)\n        for q in 2:9\n            ni = i + Int(cxs[q])\n            nj = j + Int(cys[q])\n            (1 <= ni <= Nx && 1 <= nj <= Ny) || continue\n            is_solid[ni, nj] || continue\n\n            qw = half\n            if sub_cell && !isnothing(segments) && !isempty(segments)\n                # Ray from (xf, yf) in direction (cxs[q]*dx, cys[q]*dy).\n                # Link length = |c_q| · √(dx² + dy²)... for integer\n                # c_q with dx=dy: link length = |c_q|·dx in axis,\n                # √2·dx in diagonals. q_w is the fraction of that\n                # link inside the fluid ⇒ t from the ray parameter\n                # (since the ray length is exactly one link) gives q_w.\n                ddx = FT(Int(cxs[q]) * dx)\n                ddy = FT(Int(cys[q]) * dy)\n                t_best = FT(Inf)\n                for seg in segments\n                    # Seg stored as (NTuple{2,T}, NTuple{2,T})\n                    p1 = (FT(seg[1][1]), FT(seg[1][2]))\n                    p2 = (FT(seg[2][1]), FT(seg[2][2]))\n                    t = _ray_seg_intersect_t(xf, yf, ddx, ddy, p1, p2)\n                    (t > zero(FT) && t < t_best) && (t_best = t)\n                end\n                if t_best ≤ one(FT) && t_best > zero(FT)\n                    qw = t_best\n                end\n            end\n            q_wall[i, j, q] = qw\n        end\n    end\n    return q_wall, is_solid\nend\n```"), (name = :precompute_q_wall_from_stl_3d, signature = "function precompute_q_wall_from_stl_3d(mesh::STLMesh{T},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_from_stl_3d(mesh, Nx, Ny, Nz, dx, dy, dz;\n                                   FT=Float64, sub_cell=false)\n        -> (q_wall, is_solid)\n\n3D version. With `sub_cell=false` (default, halfway-BB), every cut\nlink gets `q_w = 0.5`. With `sub_cell=true`, each cut link is queried\nagainst all STL triangles (Möller-Trumbore) and `q_w` is set to the\nfraction of the link length from the fluid node to the first\nintersection — full Bouzidi precision on arbitrary STL surfaces.\n\nComplexity is `O(N_fluid_boundary · N_triangles)` which is fine for\nmoderate meshes (~thousands of triangles) but can be accelerated\nwith a BVH for very large meshes (future work).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_from_stl_3d(mesh, Nx, Ny, Nz, dx, dy, dz;\n                                   FT=Float64, sub_cell=false)\n        -> (q_wall, is_solid)\n\n3D version. With `sub_cell=false` (default, halfway-BB), every cut\nlink gets `q_w = 0.5`. With `sub_cell=true`, each cut link is queried\nagainst all STL triangles (Möller-Trumbore) and `q_w` is set to the\nfraction of the link length from the fluid node to the first\nintersection — full Bouzidi precision on arbitrary STL surfaces.\n\nComplexity is `O(N_fluid_boundary · N_triangles)` which is fine for\nmoderate meshes (~thousands of triangles) but can be accelerated\nwith a BVH for very large meshes (future work).\n\"\"\"\nfunction precompute_q_wall_from_stl_3d(mesh::STLMesh{T},\n                                        Nx::Int, Ny::Int, Nz::Int,\n                                        dx::Real, dy::Real, dz::Real;\n                                        FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64,\n                                        sub_cell::Bool=false) where {T}\n    is_solid = voxelize_3d(mesh, Nx, Ny, Nz, dx, dy, dz)\n    q_wall = zeros(FT, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    cxs = velocities_x(D3Q19())\n    cys = velocities_y(D3Q19())\n    czs = velocities_z(D3Q19())\n    half = FT(0.5)\n    @inbounds for k in 1:Nz, j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        is_solid[i, j, k] && continue\n        # Fluid node position — cell-centre convention matching voxelize_3d.\n        xf = FT((i - 0.5) * dx)\n        yf = FT((j - 0.5) * dy)\n        zf = FT((k - 0.5) * dz)\n        for q in 2:19\n            ni = i + Int(cxs[q])\n            nj = j + Int(cys[q])\n            nk = k + Int(czs[q])\n            (1 <= ni <= Nx && 1 <= nj <= Ny && 1 <= nk <= Nz) || continue\n            is_solid[ni, nj, nk] || continue\n            qw = half\n            if sub_cell\n                # Ray along the link. Link length = |c_q| · Δx (axis) or\n                # √2·Δx (edges in D3Q19 — no body diagonals). Since we\n                # solve for t with the ray parameter, q_w = t directly\n                # when the ray direction equals the link vector scaled\n                # to unit link length.\n                ddx = FT(Int(cxs[q]) * dx)\n                ddy = FT(Int(cys[q]) * dy)\n                ddz = FT(Int(czs[q]) * dz)\n                origin = (xf, yf, zf)\n                dir    = (ddx, ddy, ddz)\n                t_best = FT(Inf)\n                for tri in mesh.triangles\n                    t = _ray_tri_intersect_t(origin, dir,\n                                              (FT(tri.v1[1]), FT(tri.v1[2]), FT(tri.v1[3])),\n                                              (FT(tri.v2[1]), FT(tri.v2[2]), FT(tri.v2[3])),\n                                              (FT(tri.v3[1]), FT(tri.v3[2]), FT(tri.v3[3])))\n                    (t > zero(FT) && t < t_best) && (t_best = t)\n                end\n                if t_best > zero(FT) && t_best ≤ one(FT)\n                    qw = t_best\n                end\n            end\n            q_wall[i, j, k, q] = qw\n        end\n    end\n    return q_wall, is_solid\nend\n```"), (name = :FVFDDomainBC2D, signature = FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64,\n    level::Integer=0,\n    solid_tolerance=nothing,\n)\n    embedded = fvfd_embedded_boundary_from_halfplane_2d(\n        Nx, Ny, nx, ny, offset; FT,\n    )\n    tol = solid_tolerance === nothing ? sqrt(eps(FT)) : FT(solid_tolerance)\n    is_solid = embedded.cell_fraction .<= tol\n    patch = FVFDPatch2D(FT(dx), FT(dy); level)\n    return = "```julia\nfunction fvfd_embedded_boundary_from_circle_2d(\n    Nx::Integer, Ny::Integer, cx::Real, cy::Real, radius::Real;\n    FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64,\n    samples::Integer=16,\n)\n    radius_ft = FT(radius)\n    radius_ft > zero(FT) || throw(ArgumentError(\"circle radius must be positive\"))\n    samples > 0 || throw(ArgumentError(\"samples must be positive\"))\n    Nx_i = Int(Nx)\n    Ny_i = Int(Ny)\n    cx_ft = FT(cx)\n    cy_ft = FT(cy)\n\n    wall_nx = zeros(FT, Nx_i, Ny_i)\n    wall_ny = zeros(FT, Nx_i, Ny_i)\n    wall_inv_distance = zeros(FT, Nx_i, Ny_i)\n    wall_distance = zeros(FT, Nx_i, Ny_i)\n    wall_inv_distance_to_center = zeros(FT, Nx_i, Ny_i)\n    cell_fraction = ones(FT, Nx_i, Ny_i)\n    wall_fraction = zeros(FT, Nx_i, Ny_i)\n    west_fraction = ones(FT, Nx_i, Ny_i)\n    east_fraction = ones(FT, Nx_i, Ny_i)\n    south_fraction = ones(FT, Nx_i, Ny_i)\n    north_fraction = ones(FT, Nx_i, Ny_i)\n    cut_count = zeros(UInt8, Nx_i, Ny_i)\n    tol = sqrt(eps(FT))\n\n    @inbounds for j in 1:Ny_i, i in 1:Nx_i\n        x0 = FT(i - 1)\n        x1 = FT(i)\n        y0 = FT(j - 1)\n        y1 = FT(j)\n        west = _fvfd_circle_vertical_face_fraction_2d(\n            x0, y0, y1, cx_ft, cy_ft, radius_ft, FT,\n        )\n        east = _fvfd_circle_vertical_face_fraction_2d(\n            x1, y0, y1, cx_ft, cy_ft, radius_ft, FT,\n        )\n        south = _fvfd_circle_horizontal_face_fraction_2d(\n            y0, x0, x1, cx_ft, cy_ft, radius_ft, FT,\n        )\n        north = _fvfd_circle_horizontal_face_fraction_2d(\n            y1, x0, x1, cx_ft, cy_ft, radius_ft, FT,\n        )\n        sampled = _fvfd_circle_cell_fluid_moments_sampled_2d(\n            x0, y0, cx_ft, cy_ft, radius_ft, samples, FT,\n        )\n        cell = sampled.cell_fraction\n        west_fraction[i, j] = west\n        east_fraction[i, j] = east\n        south_fraction[i, j] = south\n        north_fraction[i, j] = north\n        cell_fraction[i, j] = cell\n\n        area_x = west - east\n        area_y = south - north\n        length = hypot(area_x, area_y)\n        wall_fraction[i, j] = length\n        if length > tol && tol < cell < one(FT) - tol\n            wall_nx[i, j] = -area_x / length\n            wall_ny[i, j] = -area_y / length\n            x_center = (x0 + x1) / FT(2)\n            y_center = (y0 + y1) / FT(2)\n            signed_center_distance = hypot(x_center - cx_ft, y_center - cy_ft) - radius_ft\n            distance = signed_center_distance +\n                       wall_nx[i, j] * (sampled.centroid_x - x_center) +\n                       wall_ny[i, j] * (sampled.centroid_y - y_center)\n            distance = max(distance, eps(FT))\n            wall_distance[i, j] = distance\n            wall_inv_distance[i, j] = inv(max(distance, eps(FT)))\n            wall_inv_distance_to_center[i, j] = inv(max(distance, eps(FT)))\n            cut_count[i, j] = UInt8(1)\n        end\n    end\n\n    return FVFDEmbeddedBoundary2D(\n        wall_nx, wall_ny, wall_inv_distance, wall_distance,\n        wall_inv_distance_to_center, cell_fraction, wall_fraction,\n        west_fraction, east_fraction, south_fraction, north_fraction, cut_count,\n    )\nend\n```"), (name = :fvfd_geometry_from_circle_2d, signature = "function fvfd_geometry_from_circle_2d(", docstring = "", source_excerpt = "```julia\nfunction fvfd_geometry_from_circle_2d(\n    Nx::Integer, Ny::Integer, dx::Real, dy::Real,\n    bc::FVFDDomainBC2D, cx::Real, cy::Real, radius::Real;\n must equal Nx\"))\n    sides.north !== nothing && length(sides.north) == Nx ||\n        sides.north === nothing || throw(DimensionMismatch(\"north profile length must equal Nx\"))\n    sides.east !== StepChannelGeometry2D{T<:AbstractFloat,A3<:AbstractArray{T,3},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    StepChannelGeometry2D\n\nPrecomputed axis-aligned step/channel geometry for Cartesian LI-BB runs.\n\nFields StepChannelGeometry2D\n\nPrecomputed axis-aligned step/channel geometry for Cartesian LI-BB runs.\n\nFields carry both the solid/cut-link geometry (`is_solid`, `q_wall`) and the\nmasked inlet/outlet faces needed by step cases with partial openings.\n\"\"\"\nstruct StepChannelGeometry2D{T<:AbstractFloat,A3<:AbstractArray{T,3},\n                             A2<:AbstractArray{Bool,2},V<:AbstractArray{Bool,1}}\n    name::Symbol\n    Nx::Int\n    Ny::Int\n    i_step::Int\n    inlet_open::UnitRange{Int}\n    outlet_open::UnitRange{Int}\n    H_ref::Int\n    H_in::Int\n    H_out::Int\n    q_wall::A3\n    is_solid::A2\n    west_hydro_mask::V\n    east_hydro_mask::V\n    west_conformation_mask::V\n    east_conformation_mask::V\nend\n```"), (name = :step_channel_geometry_2d, signature = "function step_channel_geometry_2d(name::Symbol;", docstring = "", source_excerpt = "```julia\nfunction step_channel_geometry_2d(name::Symbol;\n                                  is_solid::AbstractMatrix{Bool},\n                                  i_step::Int,\n                                  inlet_open::UnitRange{Int},\n                                  outlet_open::UnitRange{Int},\n                                  H_ref::Int,\n                                  H_in::Int=length(inlet_open),\n                                  H_out::Int=length(outlet_open),\n                                  include_y_domain_walls::Bool=true,\n                                  FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    Nx, Ny = size(is_solid)\n    1 <= i_step <= Nx || error(\"i_step out of [1, Nx]\")\n    1 <= first(inlet_open) <= last(inlet_open) <= Ny ||\n        error(\"inlet_open must be inside [1, Ny]\")\n    1 <= first(outlet_open) <= last(outlet_open) <= Ny ||\n        error(\"outlet_open must be inside [1, Ny]\")\n\n    q_wall = _q_wall_from_solid_mask_2d(is_solid;\n        include_y_domain_walls=include_y_domain_walls, FT=FT)\n    west_hydro_mask = _mask_from_range(Ny, inlet_open; interior_only=true)\n    east_hydro_mask = _mask_from_range(Ny, outlet_open; interior_only=true)\n    west_conformation_mask = _mask_from_range(Ny, inlet_open; interior_only=false)\n    east_conformation_mask = _mask_from_range(Ny, outlet_open; interior_only=false)\n\n    return StepChannelGeometry2D{FT,Array{FT,3},Matrix{Bool},Vector{Bool}}(\n        name, Nx, Ny, i_step, inlet_open, outlet_open, H_ref, H_in, H_out,\n        q_wall, Matrix{Bool}(is_solid),\n        west_hydro_mask, east_hydro_mask,\n        west_conformation_mask, east_conformation_mask)\nend\n```"), (name = :contraction_step_geometry_2d, signature = "function contraction_step_geometry_2d(; H_out::Int=20, β_c::Int=4,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    contraction_step_geometry_2d(; H_out=20, β_c=4, L_up=20, L_down=50, FT=Float64)\n\nBuild a symmetric planar sudden contraction geometry. `H_out` is the\ndownstream opening height and `β_c = H_in/H_out`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    contraction_step_geometry_2d(; H_out=20, β_c=4, L_up=20, L_down=50, FT=Float64)\n\nBuild a symmetric planar sudden contraction geometry. `H_out` is the\ndownstream opening height and `β_c = H_in/H_out`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction contraction_step_geometry_2d(; H_out::Int=20, β_c::Int=4,\n                                      L_up::Int=20, L_down::Int=50,\n                                      FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    Nx = (L_up + L_down) * H_out\n    Ny = β_c * H_out\n    i_step = L_up * H_out + 1\n    j_low = (Ny - H_out) ÷ 2 + 1\n    j_high = j_low + H_out - 1\n    isodd(Ny - H_out) && @warn \"(Ny − H_out) odd → 1-cell asymmetric outlet\" Ny H_out j_low j_high\n\n    is_solid = zeros(Bool, Nx, Ny)\n    @inbounds for j in 1:Ny, i in i_step:Nx\n        if j < j_low || j > j_high\n            is_solid[i, j] = true\n        end\n    end\n\n    return step_channel_geometry_2d(:contraction;\n        is_solid, i_step, inlet_open=1:Ny, outlet_open=j_low:j_high,\n        H_ref=H_out, H_in=Ny, H_out=H_out, FT=FT)\nend\n```"), (name = :backward_facing_step_geometry_2d, signature = "function backward_facing_step_geometry_2d(; H_in::Int=16, expansion_ratio::Int=2,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    backward_facing_step_geometry_2d(; H_in=16, expansion_ratio=2,\n                                      L_up=4, L_down=12, FT=Float64)\n\nBuild a top-aligned backward-facing step: the top wall is horizontal, the\nupstream inlet occupies the upper `H_in` rows, and the bottom block ends at\n`i_step`. No dedicated BFS solver is needed; this is another\n`StepChannelGeometry2D` spec.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    backward_facing_step_geometry_2d(; H_in=16, expansion_ratio=2,\n                                      L_up=4, L_down=12, FT=Float64)\n\nBuild a top-aligned backward-facing step: the top wall is horizontal, the\nupstream inlet occupies the upper `H_in` rows, and the bottom block ends at\n`i_step`. No dedicated BFS solver is needed; this is another\n`StepChannelGeometry2D` spec.\n\"\"\"\nfunction backward_facing_step_geometry_2d(; H_in::Int=16, expansion_ratio::Int=2,\n                                          L_up::Int=4, L_down::Int=12,\n                                          FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    H_out = expansion_ratio * H_in\n    Nx = (L_up + L_down) * H_in\n    Ny = H_out\n    i_step = L_up * H_in + 1\n    j_low = Ny - H_in + 1\n    inlet_open = j_low:Ny\n    outlet_open = 1:Ny\n\n    is_solid = zeros(Bool, Nx, Ny)\n    @inbounds for j in 1:(j_low - 1), i in 1:(i_step - 1)\n        is_solid[i, j] = true\n    end\n\n    return step_channel_geometry_2d(:backward_facing_step;\n        is_solid, i_step, inlet_open, outlet_open,\n        H_ref=H_in, H_in=H_in, H_out=H_out, FT=FT)\nend\n```"), (name = :square_obstacle_channel_geometry_2d, signature = "function square_obstacle_channel_geometry_2d(; H::Int=32, side::Int=8,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    square_obstacle_channel_geometry_2d(; H=32, side=8, L_up=4, L_down=8, FT=Float64)\n\nBuild a straight channel with a centered axis-aligned square obstacle. This is\nthe intermediate Cartesian-obstacle case between step geometries and curved\ncylinders: same `StepChannelGeometry2D` driver, no curved cut-links.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    square_obstacle_channel_geometry_2d(; H=32, side=8, L_up=4, L_down=8, FT=Float64)\n\nBuild a straight channel with a centered axis-aligned square obstacle. This is\nthe intermediate Cartesian-obstacle case between step geometries and curved\ncylinders: same `StepChannelGeometry2D` driver, no curved cut-links.\n\"\"\"\nfunction square_obstacle_channel_geometry_2d(; H::Int=32, side::Int=8,\n                                             L_up::Int=4, L_down::Int=8,\n                                             FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    H >= side + 4 || error(\"H must leave at least two fluid rows on each side\")\n    side >= 2 || error(\"side must be at least 2\")\n    Nx = (L_up + L_down) * side + side\n    Ny = H\n    i_step = L_up * side + 1\n    i_last = i_step + side - 1\n    j_low = (Ny - side) ÷ 2 + 1\n    j_high = j_low + side - 1\n    isodd(Ny - side) && @warn \"(Ny − side) odd → 1-cell asymmetric square obstacle\" Ny side j_low j_high\n\n    is_solid = zeros(Bool, Nx, Ny)\n    @inbounds for j in j_low:j_high, i in i_step:i_last\n        is_solid[i, j] = true\n    end\n\n    return step_channel_geometry_2d(:square_obstacle;\n        is_solid, i_step, inlet_open=1:Ny, outlet_open=1:Ny,\n        H_ref=side, H_in=Ny, H_out=Ny, FT=FT)\nend\n```"), (name = :transfer_step_geometry_2d, signature = "function transfer_step_geometry_2d(geom::StepChannelGeometry2D{T}, backend) where {T}", docstring = "", source_excerpt = "```julia\nfunction transfer_step_geometry_2d(geom::StepChannelGeometry2D{T}, backend) where {T}\n    q_wall = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, geom.Nx, geom.Ny, 9)\n    is_solid = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Bool, geom.Nx, geom.Ny)\n    west_hydro_mask = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Bool, geom.Ny)\n    east_hydro_mask = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Bool, geom.Ny)\n    west_conformation_mask = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Bool, geom.Ny)\n    east_conformation_mask = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Bool, geom.Ny)\n\n    copyto!(q_wall, geom.q_wall)\n    copyto!(is_solid, geom.is_solid)\n    copyto!(west_hydro_mask, geom.west_hydro_mask)\n    copyto!(east_hydro_mask, geom.east_hydro_mask)\n    copyto!(west_conformation_mask, geom.west_conformation_mask)\n    copyto!(east_conformation_mask, geom.east_conformation_mask)\n\n    return StepChannelGeometry2D{T,typeof(q_wall),typeof(is_solid),typeof(west_hydro_mask)}(\n        geom.name, geom.Nx, geom.Ny, geom.i_step, geom.inlet_open,\n        geom.outlet_open, geom.H_ref, geom.H_in, geom.H_out,\n        q_wall, is_solid, west_hydro_mask, east_hydro_mask,\n        west_conformation_mask, east_conformation_mask)\nend\n```"), (name = :parabolic_face_profile_2d, signature = "function parabolic_face_profile_2d(geom::StepChannelGeometry2D;", docstring = "", source_excerpt = "```julia\nfunction parabolic_face_profile_2d(geom::StepChannelGeometry2D;\n                                   face::Symbol=:west,\n                                   mean_velocity,\n                                   FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    open = face === :west ? geom.inlet_open :\n           face === :east ? geom.outlet_open :\n           error(\"face must be :west or :east\")\n    H = length(open)\n    H >= 2 || error(\"open face must contain at least two rows\")\n    u_max = FT(1.5) * FT(mean_velocity)\n    profile = zeros(FT, geom.Ny)\n    denom = FT(H - 1)^2\n    @inbounds for (k, j) in enumerate(open)\n        y_node = FT(k - 1)\n        profile[j] = FT(4) * u_max * y_node * FT(H - k) / denom\n    end\n    return profile\nend\n```"), (name = :oldroydb_inlet_conformation_profile_2d, signature = "function oldroydb_inlet_conformation_profile_2d(geom::StepChannelGeometry2D;", docstring = "", source_excerpt = "```julia\nfunction oldroydb_inlet_conformation_profile_2d(geom::StepChannelGeometry2D;\n                                                face::Symbol=:west,\n                                                mean_velocity,\n                                                λ,\n                                                log_formulation::Bool=false,\n                                                FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    open = face === :west ? geom.inlet_open :\n           face === :east ? geom.outlet_open :\n           error(\"face must be :west or :east\")\n    H = length(open)\n    H >= 2 || error(\"open face must contain at least two rows\")\n    u_max = FT(1.5) * FT(mean_velocity)\n    C_xx = ones(FT, geom.Ny)\n    C_xy = zeros(FT, geom.Ny)\n    C_yy = ones(FT, geom.Ny)\n    H_chan = FT(H)\n    @inbounds for (k, j) in enumerate(open)\n        y = FT(k) - FT(0.5)\n        dudy = u_max * FT(4) * (H_chan - FT(2) * y) / (H_chan * H_chan)\n        C_xy[j] = FT(λ) * dudy\n        C_xx[j] = FT(1) + FT(2) * (FT(λ) * dudy)^2\n        if log_formulation\n            C_xx[j], C_xy[j], C_yy[j] =\n                _log_sym2x2_components(C_xx[j], C_xy[j], C_yy[j], FT)\n        end\n    end\n    return C_xx, C_xy, C_yy\nend\n```"), (name = :default_step_bcspec_2d, signature = "function default_step_bcspec_2d(geom::StepChannelGeometry2D, u_profile, ρ_out)", docstring = "", source_excerpt = "```julia\nfunction default_step_bcspec_2d(geom::StepChannelGeometry2D, u_profile, ρ_out)\n    if geom.inlet_open == 1:geom.Ny && geom.outlet_open == 1:geom.Ny\n        return BCSpec2D(;\n            west = ZouHeVelocity(u_profile),\n            east = ZouHePressure(ρ_out))\n    end\n    throw(ArgumentError(\n        \"default_step_bcspec_2d requires masked Zou-He BC support for partial openings\"))\nend\n```"), (name = :AbstractPolymerModel, signature = "", docstring = "", source_excerpt = ""), (name = :LogConfOldroydB, signature = "struct LogConfOldroydB{T<:AbstractFloat} <: AbstractPolymerModel", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    LogConfOldroydB(; G, λ)\n\nOldroyd-B evolved in the log-conformation variable Ψ = log(C) (Fattal\n& Kupferman 2004). Preserves positive-definiteness of C exactly at the\ndiscrete level — required for stability at high Weissenberg numbers\nwhere direct-C schemes blow up in extensional regions.\n\nStress reconstruction: C = exp(Ψ), τ_p = G · (C − I).\n\nUse `collide_logconf_2d!` in place of `collide_conformation_2d!` in\nthe driver time loop when this model is active.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    LogConfOldroydB(; G, λ)\n\nOldroyd-B evolved in the log-conformation variable Ψ = log(C) (Fattal\n& Kupferman 2004). Preserves positive-definiteness of C exactly at the\ndiscrete level — required for stability at high Weissenberg numbers\nwhere direct-C schemes blow up in extensional regions.\n\nStress reconstruction: C = exp(Ψ), τ_p = G · (C − I).\n\nUse `collide_logconf_2d!` in place of `collide_conformation_2d!` in\nthe driver time loop when this model is active.\n\"\"\"\nstruct LogConfOldroydB{T<:AbstractFloat} <: AbstractPolymerModel\n    G::T\n    λ::T\nend\n```"), (name = :update_polymer_stress!, signature = "function update_polymer_stress!(τ_p_xx, τ_p_xy, τ_p_yy,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    update_polymer_stress!(τ_p_xx, τ_p_xy, τ_p_yy, C_xx, C_xy, C_yy, model)\n\nIn-place update τ_p ← f(C) from the constitutive closure.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    update_polymer_stress!(τ_p_xx, τ_p_xy, τ_p_yy, C_xx, C_xy, C_yy, model)\n\nIn-place update τ_p ← f(C) from the constitutive closure.\n\"\"\"\nfunction update_polymer_stress!(τ_p_xx, τ_p_xy, τ_p_yy,\n                                  C_xx, C_xy, C_yy,\n                                  m::OldroydB)\n    G = eltype(τ_p_xx)(m.G)\n    if iszero(G)\n        fill!(τ_p_xx, zero(eltype(τ_p_xx)))\n        fill!(τ_p_xy, zero(eltype(τ_p_xy)))\n        fill!(τ_p_yy, zero(eltype(τ_p_yy)))\n        return nothing\n    end\n    @. τ_p_xx = G * (C_xx - 1)\n    @. τ_p_xy = G * C_xy\n    @. τ_p_yy = G * (C_yy - 1)\n    return nothing\nend\n```"), (name = :uses_log_conformation, signature = "uses_log_conformation(::AbstractPolymerModel) = false", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    uses_log_conformation(model) -> Bool\n\nDispatch hook: `true` if the driver must evolve Ψ = log(C) instead of\nC, and reconstruct C via `psi_to_C_2d!` before computing τ_p.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    uses_log_conformation(model) -> Bool\n\nDispatch hook: `true` if the driver must evolve Ψ = log(C) instead of\nC, and reconstruct C via `psi_to_C_2d!` before computing τ_p.\n\"\"\"\nuses_log_conformation(::AbstractPolymerModel) = false\n```"), (name = :AbstractPolymerWallBC, signature = "", docstring = "", source_excerpt = ""), (name = :CNEBB, signature = "struct CNEBB <: AbstractPolymerWallBC end", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    CNEBB()\n\nConservative non-equilibrium bounce-back (Yu et al. 2025, Eqs. 38-40).\nThis is the strict halfway/staircase formulation: `q_wall` is ignored even\nwhen the driver provides cut-link fractions.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    CNEBB()\n\nConservative non-equilibrium bounce-back (Yu et al. 2025, Eqs. 38-40).\nThis is the strict halfway/staircase formulation: `q_wall` is ignored even\nwhen the driver provides cut-link fractions.\n\"\"\"\nstruct CNEBB <: AbstractPolymerWallBC end\n```"), (name = :CNEBBQAware, signature = "struct CNEBBQAware <: AbstractPolymerWallBC end", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    CNEBBQAware()\n\nDiagnostic hybrid boundary condition: Yu-style NEBB macro recovery with the\nexperimental `q_wall` reconstruction branch. This is not the Yu et al. 2025\nCNEBB formula; keep it explicit for audit comparisons only.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    CNEBBQAware()\n\nDiagnostic hybrid boundary condition: Yu-style NEBB macro recovery with the\nexperimental `q_wall` reconstruction branch.   :postprocess => [(name = :extract_line, signature = "function extract_line(result::NamedTuple, field::Symbol, axis::Symbol; at::Real=0.5)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    extract_line(result, field, axis; at=0.5)\n\nExtract a 1D profile from a 2D simulation result.\n\n- `field`: field name (`:ux`, `:uy`, `:rho`)\n- `axis`: axis along which to extract (`:x` or `:y`)\n- `at`: position on the perpendicular axis, in physical units or as a\n  fraction of the domain if `0 < at ≤ 1` and `at` is given without units.\n\nReturns a NamedTuple `(coord, values)`.\n\n# Example\n```julia\nresult = run_simulation(\"couette.krk\")\nprof = extract_line(result, :ux, :y; at=0.5)\nlines(prof.values, prof.coord)  # plot profile\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    extract_line(result, field, axis; at=0.5)\n\nExtract a 1D profile from a 2D simulation result.\n\n- `field`: field name (`:ux`, `:uy`, `:rho`)\n- `axis`: axis along which to extract (`:x` or `:y`)\n- `at`: position on the perpendicular axis, in physical units or as a\n  fraction of the domain if `0 < at ≤ 1` and `at` is given without units.\n\nReturns a NamedTuple `(coord, values)`.\n\n# Example\n```julia\nresult = run_simulation(\"couette.krk\")\nprof = extract_line(result, :ux, :y; at=0.5)\nlines(prof.values, prof.coord)  # plot profile\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction extract_line(result::NamedTuple, field::Symbol, axis::Symbol; at::Real=0.5)\n    data = getfield(result, field)\n    setup = result.setup\n    Nx, Ny = setup.domain.Nx, setup.domain.Ny\n    dx = setup.domain.Lx / Nx\n    dy = setup.domain.Ly / Ny\n\n    if axis == :y\n        # Profile along y at fixed x\n        x_pos = _resolve_position(at, setup.domain.Lx)\n        i = clamp(round(Int, x_pos / dx + 0.5), 1, Nx)\n        coord = [(j - 0.5) * dy for j in 1:Ny]\n        values = data[i, :]\n        return (coord=coord, values=values, axis=:y, at_x=x_pos, index=i)\n    elseif axis == :x\n        # Profile along x at fixed y\n        y_pos = _resolve_position(at, setup.domain.Ly)\n        j = clamp(round(Int, y_pos / dy + 0.5), 1, Ny)\n        coord = [(i - 0.5) * dx for i in 1:Nx]\n        values = data[:, j]\n        return (coord=coord, values=values, axis=:x, at_y=y_pos, index=j)\n    else\n        throw(ArgumentError(\"axis must be :x or :y, got :\$axis\"))\n    end\nend\n```"), (name = :field_error, signature = "function field_error(result::NamedTuple, field::Symbol, analytical::AbstractString;", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    field_error(result, field, analytical; norm=:L2)\n\nCompute the error between a simulation field and an analytical expression.\n\n- `field`: field name (`:ux`, `:uy`, `:rho`)\n- `analytical`: expression string using `x`, `y`, and any `Define` variables\n  from the `.krk` file (e.g. `\"u_wall * y / H\"`)\n- `norm`: `:L2`, `:Linf`, or `:L1`\n\nReturns a NamedTuple `(error, norm, analytical_field)`.\n\n# Example\n```julia\nresult = run_simulation(\"couette.krk\")\nerr = field_error(result, :ux, \"u_wall * (y - 0.5*dy) / (Ny*dy - dy)\")\nerr.error  # L2 relative error\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    field_error(result, field, analytical; norm=:L2)\n\nCompute the error between a simulation field and an analytical expression.\n\n- `field`: field name (`:ux`, `:uy`, `:rho`)\n- `analytical`: expression string using `x`, `y`, and any `Define` variables\n  from the `.krk` file (e.g. `\"u_wall * y / H\"`)\n- `norm`: `:L2`, `:Linf`, or `:L1`\n\nReturns a NamedTuple `(error, norm, analytical_field)`.\n\n# Example\n```julia\nresult = run_simulation(\"couette.krk\")\nerr = field_error(result, :ux, \"u_wall * (y - 0.5*dy) / (Ny*dy - dy)\")\nerr.error  # L2 relative error\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction field_error(result::NamedTuple, field::Symbol, analytical::AbstractString;\n                     norm::Symbol=:L2)\n    data = getfield(result, field)\n    setup = result.setup\n    Nx, Ny = setup.domain.Nx, setup.domain.Ny\n    dx = setup.domain.Lx / Nx\n    dy = setup.domain.Ly / Ny\n\n    # Parse analytical expression with user variables\n    expr = parse_kraken_expr(analytical, setup.user_vars)\n\n    # Evaluate on the grid\n    ana = zeros(Nx, Ny)\n    for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        x = (i - 0.5) * dx\n        y = (j - 0.5) * dy\n        ana[i, j] = evaluate(expr; x=x, y=y,\n                             Lx=setup.domain.Lx, Ly=setup.domain.Ly,\n                             Nx=Float64(Nx), Ny=Float64(Ny),\n                             dx=dx, dy=dy)\n    end\n\n    diff = data .- ana\n    err = _compute_norm(diff, ana, norm)\n\n    return (error=err, norm=norm, analytical_field=ana)\nend\n```"), (name = :probe, signature = "function probe(result::NamedTuple, field::Symbol, x::Real, y::Real)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    probe(result, field, x, y)\n\nSample a field at a physical location `(x, y)` using nearest-node interpolation.\n\n# Example\n```julia\nresult = run_simulation(\"cavity.krk\")\nprobe(result, :ux, 0.5, 0.5)  # velocity at domain center\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    probe(result, field, x, y)\n\nSample a field at a physical location `(x, y)` using nearest-node interpolation.\n\n# Example\n```julia\nresult = run_simulation(\"cavity.krk\")\nprobe(result, :ux, 0.5, 0.5)  # velocity at domain center\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction probe(result::NamedTuple, field::Symbol, x::Real, y::Real)\n    data = getfield(result, field)\n    setup = result.setup\n    dx = setup.domain.Lx / setup.domain.Nx\n    dy = setup.domain.Ly / setup.domain.Ny\n    i = clamp(round(Int, x / dx + 0.5), 1, setup.domain.Nx)\n    j = clamp(round(Int, y / dy + 0.5), 1, setup.domain.Ny)\n    return data[i, j]\nend\n```"), (name = :domain_stats, signature = "function domain_stats(result::NamedTuple)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    domain_stats(result)\n\nCompute global statistics of the simulation result.\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with `max_u`, `mean_rho`, `mass_error`, `max_ux`, `max_uy`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    domain_stats(result)\n\nCompute global statistics of the simulation result.\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with `max_u`, `mean_rho`, `mass_error`, `max_ux`, `max_uy`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction domain_stats(result::NamedTuple)\n    Nx, Ny = result.setup.domain.Nx, result.setup.domain.Ny\n    umag = @. sqrt(result.ux^2 + result.uy^2)\n    mean_rho = sum(result.ρ) / (Nx * Ny)\n    return (\n        max_u      = maximum(umag),\n        max_ux     = maximum(abs.(result.ux)),\n        max_uy     = maximum(abs.(result.uy)),\n        mean_rho   = mean_rho,\n        mass_error = abs(mean_rho - 1.0),\n    )\nend\n```"), (name = :load_basilisk_interfaces, signature = "function load_basilisk_interfaces(filepath::String)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    load_basilisk_interfaces(filepath::String)\n\nLoad a Basilisk interface file (gnuplot segment format).\nReturns a vector of segments, each segment being a pair of (z, r) points.\n\nFile format: pairs of `z r` lines separated by blank lines.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    load_basilisk_interfaces(filepath::String)\n\nLoad a Basilisk interface file (gnuplot segment format).\nReturns a vector of segments, each segment being a pair of (z, r) points.\n\nFile format: pairs of `z r` lines separated by blank lines.\n\"\"\"\nfunction load_basilisk_interfaces(filepath::String)\n    segments = Vector{NTuple{2, NTuple{2, Float64}}}()\n    pts = NTuple{2, Float64}[]\n\n    for line in eachline(filepath)\n        stripped = strip(line)\n        if isempty(stripped)\n            if length(pts) == 2\n                push!(segments, (pts[1], pts[2]))\n            end\n            empty!(pts)\n        else\n            vals = split(stripped)\n            if length(vals) >= 2\n                z = parse(Float64, vals[1])\n                r = parse(Float64, vals[2])\n                push!(pts, (z, r))\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    # Handle last segment (no trailing blank line)\n    if length(pts) == 2\n        push!(segments, (pts[1], pts[2]))\n    end\n    return segments\nend\n```"), (name = :load_basilisk_interface_contour, signature = "function load_basilisk_interface_contour(filepath::String)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    load_basilisk_interface_contour(filepath::String)\n\nLoad a Basilisk interface file and return a sorted (z, r) contour.\nExtracts midpoints of each segment and sorts by z coordinate.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    load_basilisk_interface_contour(filepath::String)\n\nLoad a Basilisk interface file and return a sorted (z, r) contour.\nExtracts midpoints of each segment and sorts by z coordinate.\n\"\"\"\nfunction load_basilisk_interface_contour(filepath::String)\n    segments = load_basilisk_interfaces(filepath)\n    contour = NTuple{2, Float64}[]\n    for ((z1, r1), (z2, r2)) in segments\n        push!(contour, ((z1 + z2) / 2, (r1 + r2) / 2))\n    end\n    sort!(contour, by=first)\n    return contour\nend\n```"), (name = :find_basilisk_snapshot, signature = "function find_basilisk_snapshot(data_dir::String, Re::Real, Amp::Real, t_phys::Real; tol=0.5)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    find_basilisk_snapshot(data_dir, Re, Amp, t_phys; tol=0.1)\n\nFind the Basilisk interface file closest to physical time `t_phys`.\nReturns the filepath or `nothing` if not found.\n\n`data_dir` should point to the ds_num/ directory.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    find_basilisk_snapshot(data_dir, Re, Amp, t_phys; tol=0.1)\n\nFind the Basilisk interface file closest to physical time `t_phys`.\nReturns the filepath or `nothing` if not found.\n\n`data_dir` should point to the ds_num/ directory.\n\"\"\"\nfunction find_basilisk_snapshot(data_dir::String, Re::Real, Amp::Real, t_phys::Real; tol=0.5)\n    folder = joinpath(data_dir, \"\$(Int(Re))_\$(lpad(string(Amp), 5, '0'))\")\n    if !isdir(folder)\n        # Try with different formatting\n        for d in readdir(data_dir)\n            parts = split(d, \"_\")\n            if length(parts) == 2\n                re_str, amp_str = parts\n                re_val = tryparse(Int, re_str)\n                amp_val = tryparse(Float64, amp_str)\n                if re_val == Int(Re) && amp_val !== nothing && abs(amp_val - Amp) < 1e-6\n                    folder = joinpath(data_dir, d)\n                    break\n                end\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    !isdir(folder) && return nothing\n\n    best_file = nothing\n    best_dt = Inf\n    for f in readdir(folder)\n        startswith(f, \"interfaces_\") && endswith(f, \".dat\") || continue\n        # Parse time from filename: interfaces_Re_Amp_Time.dat\n        m = match(r\"interfaces_[\\d.]+_[\\d.]+_([\\d.]+)\\.dat\", f)\n        m === nothing && continue\n        t = parse(Float64, m.captures[1])\n        dt = abs(t - t_phys)\n        if dt < best_dt\n            best_dt = dt\n            best_file = joinpath(folder, f)\n        end\n    end\n    best_dt > tol ? nothing : best_file\nend\n```"), (name = :compare_interfaces, signature = "function compare_interfaces(kraken_pts::Vector{<:NTuple{2}}, basilisk_contour, R0_lb::Real)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    compare_interfaces(kraken_pts, basilisk_contour, R0_lb)\n\nCompare Kraken interface points with Basilisk contour.\nKraken points are in lattice units; Basilisk in physical units (R₀=1).\n\nReturns (z_krak, r_krak, z_bas, r_bas) all in physical units (normalized by R₀).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    compare_interfaces(kraken_pts, basilisk_contour, R0_lb)\n\nCompare Kraken interface points with Basilisk contour.\nKraken points are in lattice units; Basilisk in physical units (R₀=1).\n\nReturns (z_krak, r_krak, z_bas, r_bas) all in physical units (normalized by R₀).\n\"\"\"\nfunction compare_interfaces(kraken_pts::Vector{<:NTuple{2}}, basilisk_contour, R0_lb::Real)\n    z_krak = [p[1] / R0_lb for p in kraken_pts]\n    r_krak = [p[2] / R0_lb for p in kraken_pts]\n    z_bas = [p[1] for p in basilisk_contour]\n    r_bas = [p[2] for p in basilisk_contour]\n    return (z_krak=z_krak, r_krak=r_krak, z_bas=z_bas, r_bas=r_bas)\nend\n```")]
  :config => [(name = :LBMConfig, signature = "struct LBMConfig{L <: AbstractLattice}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    LBMConfig{L <: AbstractLattice}\n\nConfiguration for an LBM simulation.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    LBMConfig{L <: AbstractLattice}\n\nConfiguration for an LBM simulation.\n\"\"\"\nstruct LBMConfig{L <: AbstractLattice}\n    lattice::L\n    Nx::Int\n    Ny::Int\n    Nz::Int          # 1 for 2D\n    ν::Float64       # kinematic viscosity (lattice units)\n    u_lid::Float64   # lid velocity (cavity)\n    max_steps::Int\n    output_interval::Int\nend\n```"), (name = :omega, signature = "omega(config::LBMConfig) = 1.0 / (3.0 * config.ν + 0.5)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    omega(config::LBMConfig) -> Float64\n\nCompute BGK relaxation parameter from viscosity: ω = 1 / (3ν + 0.5).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    omega(config::LBMConfig) -> Float64\n\nCompute BGK relaxation parameter from viscosity: ω = 1 / (3ν + 0.5).\n\"\"\"\nomega(config::LBMConfig) = 1.0 / (3.0 * config.ν + 0.5)\n```"), (name = :reynolds, signature = "function reynolds(config::LBMConfig)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    reynolds(config::LBMConfig) -> Float64\n\nEffective Reynolds number: Re = u_lid · N / ν.\nUses Ny for 2D, Nz for 3D (cavity height).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    reynolds(config::LBMConfig) -> Float64\n\nEffective Reynolds number: Re = u_lid · N / ν.\nUses Ny for 2D, Nz for 3D (cavity height).\n\"\"\"\nfunction reynolds(config::LBMConfig)\n    L = lattice_dim(config.lattice) == 2 ? config.Ny : config.Nz\n    return config.u_lid * L / config.ν\nend\n```"), (name = :initialize_2d, signature = "function initialize_2d(config::LBMConfig{D2Q9}, ::Type{T}=Float64;", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    initialize_2d(config::LBMConfig{D2Q9}, T=Float64; backend=CPU())\n\nCreate initial LBM state for 2D simulation. Populations set to equilibrium\nwith ρ=1, u=0.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    initialize_2d(config::LBMConfig{D2Q9}, T=Float64; backend=CPU())\n\nCreate initial LBM state for 2D simulation. Populations set to equilibrium\nwith ρ=1, u=0.\n\"\"\"\nfunction initialize_2d(config::LBMConfig{D2Q9}, ::Type{T}=Float64;\n                        backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU()) where T\n    Nx, Ny = config.Nx, config.Ny\n\n    # Allocate on the desired backend\n    f_in  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    f_out = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    ρ     = KernelAbstractions.ones(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    ux    = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    uy    = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    is_solid = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, Bool, Nx, Ny)\n\n    # Initialize to equilibrium (ρ=1, u=0 → f_eq = w_q)\n    w = weights(D2Q9())\n    f_cpu = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    for q in 1:9\n        f_cpu[:, :, q] .= T(w[q])\n    end\n    copyto!(f_in, f_cpu)\n    copyto!(f_out, f_cpu)\n\n    return (f_in=f_in, f_out=f_out, ρ=ρ, ux=ux, uy=uy, is_solid=is_solid)\nend\n```"), (name = :initialize_3d, signature = "function initialize_3d(config::LBMConfig{D3Q19}, ::Type{T}=Float64;", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    initialize_3d(config::LBMConfig{D3Q19}, T=Float64;   :drivers => [(name = :run_cavity_2d, signature = "function run_cavity_2d(config::LBMConfig{D2Q9};", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    run_cavity_2d(config::LBMConfig{D2Q9}; backend=CPU(), T=Float64)\n\nRun a 2D lid-driven cavity simulation using D2Q9 BGK-LBM.\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with final fields (ρ, ux, uy) on CPU.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    run_cavity_2d(config::LBMConfig{D2Q9}; backend=CPU(), T=Float64)\n\nRun a 2D lid-driven cavity simulation using D2Q9 BGK-LBM.\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with final fields (ρ, ux, uy) on CPU.\n\"\"\"\nfunction run_cavity_2d(config::LBMConfig{D2Q9};\n                        backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), T=Float64)\n    state = initialize_2d(config, T; backend=backend)\n    f_in, f_out = state.f_in, state.f_out\n    ρ, ux, uy = state.ρ, state.ux, state.uy\n    is_solid = state.is_solid\n    Nx, Ny = config.Nx, config.Ny\n    ω = T(omega(config))\n\n    for step in 1:config.max_steps\n        # 1. N=64, ν=0.01, u0=0.01, backend, T)\n\nInitialize populations to equilibrium with Taylor-Green velocity field.\n\"\"\"\nfunction initialize_taylor_green_2d(; N=64, nu=nothing, ν=0.01, u0=0.01,\n                                     backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), T=Float64)\n    !isnothing(nu) && (ν = nu)\n    config = LBMConfig(D2Q9(); Nx=N, Ny=N, ν=ν, u_lid=0.0, max_steps=0)\n    Nx, Ny = N, N\n    k = T(2π / N)\n\n    f_in  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    f_out = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    ρ_arr = KernelAbstractions.ones(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    ux    = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    uy    = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    is_solid = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, Bool, Nx, Ny)\n\n    w = weights(D2Q9())\n    f_cpu = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        x = T(i - 1)\n        y = T(j - 1)\n        ux_tg = -T(u0) * cos(k * x) * sin(k * y)\n        uy_tg =  T(u0) * sin(k * x) * cos(k * y)\n        ρ_tg = one(T) - T(3) * T(u0)^2 / T(4) * (cos(T(2) * k * x) + cos(T(2) * k * y))\n        for q in 1:9\n            f_cpu[i, j, q] = equilibrium(D2Q9(), ρ_tg, ux_tg, uy_tg, q)\n        end\n    end\n    copyto!(f_in, f_cpu)\n    copyto!(f_out, f_cpu)\n\n    return (f_in=f_in, f_out=f_out, ρ=ρ_arr, ux=ux, uy=uy, is_solid=is_solid,\n            config=config, u0=u0, k=k)\nend\n```"), (name = :run_taylor_green_2d, signature = "function run_taylor_green_2d(; Nx=200, Ny=50, cx=Nx÷4, cy=Ny÷2, radius=10,\n                            u_in=0.05, ν=0.05, backend, T)\n\nInitialize a channel with a circular cylinder obstacle.\n\"\"\"\nfunction initialize_cylinder_2d(;
